import AspisV8R19.R442RejectionAlphabet

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R443BoundedRejectionMass
open OracleResampling
noncomputable section

variable {p : Nat}

abbrev Tape (p n : Nat) := Fin n → Option (Fin p)

def splitTape (p n : Nat) : Tape p (n+1) ≃ (Option (Fin p) × Tape p n) where
  toFun t := (t 0, fun i => t i.succ)
  invFun q := Fin.cases q.1 q.2
  left_inv t := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  right_inv q := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; rfl

def run : (n : Nat) → Tape p n → Option (Fin p)
  | 0, _ => none
  | n+1, t => match t 0 with
    | none => run n (fun i => t i.succ)
    | some a => some a

theorem mean_option (f : Option (Fin p) → ℚ) :
    mean f = (f none + ∑ a : Fin p, f (some a)) / (p+1 : ℚ) := by
  simp [mean, Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.card_option]

theorem mean_step (n : Nat) (f : Option (Fin p) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun t : Tape p (n+1) => f (run (n+1) t)) =
      (mean (fun t : Tape p n => f (run n t)) + ∑ a : Fin p, f (some a)) /
        (p+1 : ℚ) := by
  let g : Option (Fin p) → ℚ := fun w => match w with
    | none => mean (fun t : Tape p n => f (run n t))
    | some a => f (some a)
  calc
    _ = mean (fun q : Option (Fin p) × Tape p n =>
          f (run (n+1) ((splitTape p n).symm q))) :=
      (mean_equiv (splitTape p n).symm
        (fun t : Tape p (n+1) => f (run (n+1) t))).symm
    _ = mean (fun w : Option (Fin p) => mean (fun t : Tape p n =>
          f (run (n+1) ((splitTape p n).symm (w,t))))) :=
      mean_prod (fun (w : Option (Fin p)) (t : Tape p n) =>
        f (run (n+1) ((splitTape p n).symm (w,t))))
    _ = mean g := by
      apply mean_congr
      intro w
      cases w with
      | none => rfl
      | some a => exact mean_const (f (some a))
    _ = _ := mean_option g

def failureMass (p n : Nat) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun t : Tape p n => if run n t = none then 1 else 0)

def valueMass (p n : Nat) (a : Fin p) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun t : Tape p n => if run n t = some a then 1 else 0)

theorem failure_mass (p n : Nat) :
    failureMass p n = (1 / (p+1 : ℚ)) ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [failureMass, run, mean_const]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [failureMass, mean_step n (fun x => if x = none then (1 : ℚ) else 0)]
    simp only [Option.some_ne_none, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    change failureMass p n / (p+1 : ℚ) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ]
    ring

theorem value_mass (p n : Nat) (a : Fin p) :
    valueMass p n a = (1 - (1 / (p+1 : ℚ)) ^ n) / p := by
  have hp : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show p ≠ 0 by have := a.isLt; omega)
  have hm : (p+1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [valueMass, run, mean_const]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [valueMass, mean_step n (fun x => if x = some a then (1 : ℚ) else 0)]
    simp only [Option.some.injEq]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
    change (valueMass p n a + 1) / (p+1 : ℚ) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ]
    field_simp
    ring

#print axioms mean_step
#print axioms failure_mass
#print axioms value_mass
end
end AspisV8R19.R443BoundedRejectionMass

import AspisV8R19.R421UniformMasked31Block

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R442RejectionAlphabet

def alphabetDecode (p : Nat) (w : Fin (p + 1)) : Option (Fin p) :=
  if h : w.val < p then some ⟨w.val, h⟩ else none

def alphabetEncode (p : Nat) : Option (Fin p) → Fin (p + 1)
  | none => ⟨p, by omega⟩
  | some a => a.castSucc

/-- The accepted alphabet has `p` values and one explicit rejection sentinel. -/
def alphabetEquiv (p : Nat) : Fin (p + 1) ≃ Option (Fin p) where
  toFun := alphabetDecode p
  invFun := alphabetEncode p
  left_inv w := by
    apply Fin.ext
    by_cases h : w.val < p
    · simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode, h]
    · have hp : w.val = p := by omega
      simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode, h, hp]
  right_inv o := by
    cases o with
    | none =>
        simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode]
    | some a =>
        simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode, a.isLt]

/-- Return the first accepted value, skipping rejection sentinels. -/
def firstAccepted {p : Nat} : List (Option (Fin p)) → Option (Fin p)
  | [] => none
  | none :: xs => firstAccepted xs
  | some a :: _ => some a

theorem firstAccepted_map {p : Nat} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p))
    (xs : List (Option (Fin p))) :
    firstAccepted (xs.map (Option.map σ)) =
      Option.map σ (firstAccepted xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head tail ih =>
      cases head with
      | none => exact ih
      | some a => rfl

#print axioms alphabetEquiv
#print axioms firstAccepted_map

end AspisV8R19.R442RejectionAlphabet

import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

Uniformity of the source's masked 31-bit word block under the uniform 32-byte
tape model. This draft only transports a finite mean along explicit
bijections; it does not assert independence or freshness for a shared oracle.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R421UniformMasked31Block

open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep SamplerWords OracleResampling
open R406SamplerWordDistribution
noncomputable section

/-- Split a 32-bit word into its high bit and low 31 bits. -/
def splitWord31Equiv : Fin (2^32) ≃ (Fin 2 × Fin (2^31)) :=
  (finProdFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 2^31)).symm

def distribute31 : (Fin 8 → Fin 2 × Fin (2^31)) ≃
    ((Fin 8 → Fin 2) × (Fin 8 → Fin (2^31))) where
  toFun f := (fun j => (f j).1, fun j => (f j).2)
  invFun p j := (p.1 j, p.2 j)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def splitBlock31Equiv : State ≃
    ((Fin 8 → Fin 2) × (Fin 8 → Fin (2^31))) :=
  (blockWordEquiv.trans (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ => splitWord31Equiv))).trans distribute31

theorem masked31_value (block : State) (j : Fin 8) :
    ((splitBlock31Equiv block).2 j).val = masked 31 (word block j) := by
  change (blockWordEquiv block j).val % 2^31 = _
  rw [word_value, masked_eq_mod]

theorem words31_value (block : State) :
    words 31 block = List.ofFn (fun j => ((splitBlock31Equiv block).2 j).val) := by
  unfold words
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact (masked31_value block j).symm

theorem uniform_masked31_block (f : List Nat → ℚ) :
    mean (fun out : State => f (words 31 out)) =
      mean (fun x : Fin 8 → Fin (2^31) =>
        f (List.ofFn (fun j => (x j).val))) := by
  simp_rw [words31_value]
  rw [mean_equiv splitBlock31Equiv
    (fun p => f (List.ofFn (fun j => (p.2 j).val)))]
  rw [mean_prod (fun (_ : Fin 8 → Fin 2) (x : Fin 8 → Fin (2^31)) =>
    f (List.ofFn (fun j => (x j).val)))]
  exact mean_const _

#print axioms masked31_value
#print axioms words31_value
#print axioms uniform_masked31_block

end
end AspisV8R19.R421UniformMasked31Block

/-! # The duplex instance of v2: addresses, samplers, decoder, collision event

Addresses are byte strings of bounded length `L`, stored padded so the index
type is the finite `List.Vector (Option Byte) L`; the frames are those of
`AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames`.  A round absorbs the message into the current
state (`absorb`), then squeezes the challenge material and advances the
state from the absorbed state (`squeeze`, `advance`), read in either order.
The challenge type carries the next state.

The decoder parses the absorb address, walks the table back from the
absorbed state to the initial state through the `advance` and `absorb`
cells, and completes the prefix; the challenge cells still missing from the
table are read by the completing sampler.

The collision event: some first read's fresh state equals the initial state,
equals an earlier output, or is a 32-byte prefix of an address read so far
(including the current one).  Its mass is bounded by v1's Lemma A with
density `2·Q_tot / 2^256` per first read: `κ(Q_tot) = 2·Q_tot² / 2^256`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FS2.Duplex

open FS FS2 AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open AspisV8PairedCommitment AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.UniformStateFirstHit
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-! ## Bounded byte addresses -/

/-- Padded byte strings of length at most `L`. -/
abbrev Addr (L : Nat) := List.Vector (Option Byte) L

namespace Addr
variable {L : Nat}

def ofBytes (b : Bytes) (h : b.length ≤ L) : Addr L :=
  ⟨b.map some ++ List.replicate (L - b.length) none, by simp; omega⟩

def toBytes (a : Addr L) : Bytes := a.toList.filterMap id

theorem toBytes_ofBytes (b : Bytes) (h : b.length ≤ L) : toBytes (ofBytes b h) = b := by
  simp [toBytes, ofBytes, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_map, List.filterMap_replicate]

theorem ofBytes_injective (b b' : Bytes) (h : b.length ≤ L) (h' : b'.length ≤ L)
    (e : ofBytes b h = ofBytes b' h') : b = b' := by
  have := congrArg toBytes e
  rwa [toBytes_ofBytes, toBytes_ofBytes] at this

end Addr

/-! ## Frames -/

instance : Inhabited State := ⟨fun _ => 0⟩

/-- The duplex parameters: address bound, message encoding, labels, the
per-round challenge map from squeezed states, the initial state. -/
structure Params (M Cv : Type) (L : Nat) where
  D : Nat
  hL : 34 + D ≤ L
  enc : M → Bytes
  encLen : ∀ m, (enc m).length ≤ D
  dec : Bytes → Option M
  decEnc : ∀ m, dec (enc m) = some m
  lbl : Nat → Byte
  σ : Nat → State → Cv
  iv : State
  /-- number of challenge rounds (the decoder's walk fuel) -/
  rounds : Nat

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

def absorbA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) (l : Byte) (data : Bytes) (h : data.length ≤ p.D) :
    Addr L :=
  Addr.ofBytes (absorb (bytes s) l data) (by
    simp [absorb, bytes_length]; have := p.hL; omega)

def squeezeA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) : Addr L :=
  Addr.ofBytes (squeeze (bytes s)) (by simp [squeeze, bytes_length]; have := p.hL; omega)

def advanceA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) : Addr L :=
  Addr.ofBytes (advance (bytes s)) (by simp [advance, bytes_length]; have := p.hL; omega)

theorem squeezeA_ne_advanceA' (p : Params M Cv L) (s t : State) : squeezeA p s ≠ advanceA p t := by
  intro h
  exact cross_disjoint _ _ (Addr.ofBytes_injective _ _ _ _ h)

theorem squeezeA_ne_advanceA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) : squeezeA p s ≠ advanceA p s :=
  squeezeA_ne_advanceA' p s s

theorem squeezeA_injective (p : Params M Cv L) : Function.Injective (squeezeA p) := by
  intro s s' h
  exact bytes_injective (squeeze_injective (Addr.ofBytes_injective _ _ _ _ h))

theorem advanceA_injective (p : Params M Cv L) : Function.Injective (advanceA p) := by
  intro s s' h
  exact bytes_injective (advance_injective (Addr.ofBytes_injective _ _ _ _ h))

theorem toBytes_squeezeA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) :
    (squeezeA p s).toBytes.take 32 = bytes s := by
  rw [squeezeA, Addr.toBytes_ofBytes, squeeze, List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [bytes_length]),
    List.take_of_length_le (by rw [bytes_length])]

theorem toBytes_advanceA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) :
    (advanceA p s).toBytes.take 32 = bytes s := by
  rw [advanceA, Addr.toBytes_ofBytes, advance, List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [bytes_length]),
    List.take_of_length_le (by rw [bytes_length])]

theorem toBytes_absorbA (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) (l : Byte) (data : Bytes)
    (h : data.length ≤ p.D) : (absorbA p s l data h).toBytes.take 32 = bytes s := by
  rw [absorbA, Addr.toBytes_ofBytes, absorb, List.append_assoc,
    List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [bytes_length]), List.take_of_length_le (by rw [bytes_length])]

theorem squeezeA_ne_absorbA (p : Params M Cv L) (s s' : State) (l : Byte) (data : Bytes)
    (h : data.length ≤ p.D) : squeezeA p s ≠ absorbA p s' l data h := by
  intro e
  have := congrArg (fun a : Addr L => a.toBytes.length) e
  simp [squeezeA, absorbA, Addr.toBytes_ofBytes, squeeze, absorb, bytes_length] at this
  omega

theorem advanceA_ne_absorbA (p : Params M Cv L) (s s' : State) (l : Byte) (data : Bytes)
    (h : data.length ≤ p.D) : advanceA p s ≠ absorbA p s' l data h := by
  intro e
  have := congrArg (fun a : Addr L => a.toBytes.length) e
  simp [advanceA, absorbA, Addr.toBytes_ofBytes, advance, absorb, bytes_length] at this
  omega

/-- Challenge: a value and the next state. -/
abbrev Chal (Cv : Type) := Cv × State

/-- The duplex state after a prefix: the last challenge's state, or `iv`. -/
def stateOf {X : Type} (p : Params M Cv L) (P : Prefix X M (Chal Cv)) : State :=
  match P.rounds.getLast? with
  | none => p.iv
  | some (_, c) => c.2

/-- Round `i`'s sampler: absorb, then squeeze and advance of the absorbed
state in either order. -/
def samp {X : Type} (p : Params M Cv L) (i : Nat) (P : Prefix X M (Chal Cv)) (m : M) :
    Sampler (Addr L) State (Chal Cv) :=
  .ask (absorbA p (stateOf p P) (p.lbl i) (p.enc m) (p.encLen m)) fun s' =>
    .multi (squeezeA p s') [advanceA p s'] (by simp [squeezeA_ne_advanceA]) fun acc =>
      .done (p.σ i (acc (squeezeA p s')), acc (advanceA p s'))

/-! ## Counting over an abstract finite answer type

Stated for abstract finite types so that no concrete `Finset.univ` over
`Fin 32 → Byte` is ever unfolded; the collision predicate below mentions no
`Finset`, only existentials, for the same reason. -/

section Counting
variable {I S B : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype S] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] [Nonempty S]

def dom (T : Table I S) : Finset I := Finset.univ.filter fun a => T a ≠ none

omit [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] [Nonempty S] in
theorem mean_indicator_card (q : S → Prop) [DecidablePred q] :
    mean (fun f : S => indicator (q f)) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter q).card : ℚ) / (Fintype.card S : ℚ) := by
  unfold mean
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_boole]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro f _
  by_cases h : q f <;> simp [indicator, h]

omit [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Nonempty S] in
theorem mean_indicator_eq (c : S) :
    mean (fun f : S => indicator (f = c)) = 1 / (Fintype.card S : ℚ) := by
  rw [mean_indicator_card (fun f => f = c)]
  simp [Finset.filter_eq']

omit [DecidableEq S] in
/-- Outputs of a table: at most as many as its domain. -/
theorem mean_exists_output_le (T : Table I S) :
    mean (fun f : S => indicator (∃ a, T a = some f)) ≤ ((dom T).card : ℚ) / (Fintype.card S : ℚ) := by
  classical
  rw [mean_indicator_card (fun f => ∃ a, T a = some f)]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  have : (Finset.univ.filter fun f : S => ∃ a, T a = some f) ⊆
      (dom T).image fun a => (T a).getD (Classical.arbitrary S) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hf
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf.2
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dom, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by rw [ha]; exact Option.some_ne_none _⟩
    · rw [ha]; rfl
  exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card this).trans Finset.card_image_le

omit [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq S] [Nonempty S] in
/-- Values whose image under an injection hits the image of a predicate's
domain: at most as many as that domain. -/
theorem mean_exists_prefix_le [DecidableEq B] (e : S → B) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (g : I → B) :
    mean (fun f : S => indicator (∃ b, P b ∧ g b = e f)) ≤
      ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℚ) / (Fintype.card S : ℚ) := by
  classical
  rw [mean_indicator_card (fun f => ∃ b, P b ∧ g b = e f)]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  have h1 : (Finset.univ.filter fun f : S => ∃ b, P b ∧ g b = e f).card ≤
      ((Finset.univ.filter P).image g).card := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn e
    · intro f hf
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hf
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hg⟩ := hf.2
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image]
      exact ⟨b, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb⟩, hg⟩
    · intro f _ f' _ h
      exact he h
  exact_mod_cast h1.trans Finset.card_image_le

omit [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Nonempty S] in
theorem card_filter_insert_le (T : Table I S) (a : I) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun b : I => b = a ∨ T b ≠ none).card ≤ (dom T).card + 1 := by
  calc (Finset.univ.filter fun b : I => b = a ∨ T b ≠ none).card
      ≤ (insert a (dom T)).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro b hb
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hb
        rw [Finset.mem_insert]
        rcases hb.2 with h | h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)
    _ ≤ (dom T).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _

end Counting

/-! ## The collision event -/

/-- A fresh state at a first read collides: it is the initial state, an
earlier output, or a 32-byte prefix of an address read so far (the current
one included).  The size guard ties the density to `Q_tot`. -/
def badColl (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat) (a : Addr L) (T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (f : State) : Prop :=
  (dom T).card < Qtot ∧ (f = p.iv ∨ (∃ b, T b = some f) ∨
    ∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f)

theorem badColl_of_iv (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat) (a : Addr L) (T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (f : State) (hsz : (dom T).card < Qtot) (h : f = p.iv) : badColl p Qtot a T f :=
  ⟨hsz, Or.inl h⟩

theorem badColl_of_output (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat) (a : Addr L) (T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (f : State) (hsz : (dom T).card < Qtot) (b : Addr L) (h : T b = some f) : badColl p Qtot a T f :=
  ⟨hsz, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨b, h⟩)⟩

theorem badColl_of_prefix (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat) (a : Addr L) (T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (f : State) (hsz : (dom T).card < Qtot) (b : Addr L) (hb : b = a ∨ T b ≠ none)
    (h : b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f) : badColl p Qtot a T f :=
  ⟨hsz, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨b, hb, h⟩)⟩

theorem badColl_density (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat) (a : Addr L) (T : Table (Addr L) State) :
    mean (fun f : State => indicator (badColl p Qtot a T f)) ≤
      (2 * Qtot : ℚ) / (Fintype.card State : ℚ) := by
  classical
  by_cases hsz : (dom T).card < Qtot
  · have h1 : ∀ f, indicator (badColl p Qtot a T f) ≤
        indicator (f = p.iv) + indicator (∃ b, T b = some f) +
          indicator (∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f) := by
      intro f
      calc indicator (badColl p Qtot a T f)
          ≤ indicator (f = p.iv ∨ (∃ b, T b = some f) ∨
              ∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f) :=
            indicator_mono fun h => h.2
        _ ≤ indicator (f = p.iv) + indicator ((∃ b, T b = some f) ∨
              ∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f) := indicator_or_le _ _
        _ ≤ _ := by
            have := indicator_or_le (∃ b, T b = some f)
              (∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f)
            linarith
    have hcard : (0 : ℚ) < (Fintype.card State : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card State)
    have hout := mean_exists_output_le T
    have hfilt : ((Finset.univ.filter fun b : Addr L => b = a ∨ T b ≠ none).card : ℚ) ≤
        ((dom T).card : ℚ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast card_filter_insert_le T a
    have hpre := (mean_exists_prefix_le bytes bytes_injective (fun b : Addr L => b = a ∨ T b ≠ none)
      (fun b => b.toBytes.take 32)).trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hfilt hcard.le)
    calc mean (fun f : State => indicator (badColl p Qtot a T f))
        ≤ mean (fun f : State => indicator (f = p.iv) + indicator (∃ b, T b = some f) +
            indicator (∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f)) := mean_mono h1
      _ = mean (fun f : State => indicator (f = p.iv)) +
            mean (fun f : State => indicator (∃ b, T b = some f)) +
            mean (fun f : State => indicator (∃ b, (b = a ∨ T b ≠ none) ∧ b.toBytes.take 32 = bytes f)) := by
          rw [mean_add, mean_add]
      _ ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card State : ℚ) + ((dom T).card : ℚ) / (Fintype.card State : ℚ) +
            (((dom T).card : ℚ) + 1) / (Fintype.card State : ℚ) := by
          rw [mean_indicator_eq]
          linarith
      _ ≤ (2 * Qtot : ℚ) / (Fintype.card State : ℚ) := by
          rw [← add_div, ← add_div]
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hcard.le
          have : ((dom T).card : ℚ) + 1 ≤ Qtot := by exact_mod_cast hsz
          linarith
  · have hz : ∀ f, indicator (badColl p Qtot a T f) = 0 := by
      intro f
      rw [indicator_iff (q := False), indicator_false]
      exact ⟨fun h => hsz h.1, False.elim⟩
    rw [mean_congr hz, mean_const]
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2) (Nat.cast_nonneg Qtot))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card State))

/-- The collision event of an execution. -/
def Coll {Pf : Type} (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat) (v : View (Addr L) State (Pf × Bool)) : Prop :=
  hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable v.1

/-- `κ(Q_tot) = 2·Q_tot² / 2^256`. -/
def κ (Qtot : Nat) : ℚ := (Qtot : ℚ) * ((2 * Qtot : ℚ) / (256 ^ 32 : ℚ))

theorem coll_mass {X Pf : Type} (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (P : Program (Addr L) State Pf) (V : X → Pf → Program (Addr L) State Bool) (x : X)
    (hQ : ∀ H, distinctFirstReads (eval H (experiment P V x)) ≤ Qtot) :
    mean (fun H : Addr L → State => indicator (Coll p Qtot (eval H (experiment P V x)))) ≤
      κ Qtot := by
  unfold Coll κ
  rw [empty_oracle_law (experiment P V x)
    (fun v => indicator (hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable v.1))]
  have hε : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (2 * Qtot : ℚ) / (256 ^ 32 : ℚ) := by
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2) (Nat.cast_nonneg Qtot))
      (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 256) 32)
  have hdens : ∀ (a : Addr L) (T : Table (Addr L) State),
      mean (fun f => indicator (badColl p Qtot a T f)) ≤ (2 * Qtot : ℚ) / (256 ^ 32 : ℚ) := by
    intro a T
    have := badColl_density p Qtot a T
    rw [state_card] at this
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  apply FS.lemmaA (experiment P V x) emptyTable Qtot (badColl p Qtot) _ hε hdens
  apply firstReadsBound_of_traces
  intro H
  have := hQ H
  have hc : complete (emptyTable : Table (Addr L) State) H = H := rfl
  rw [hc]
  exact this

#print axioms coll_mass
end
end FS2.Duplex

import Wide.BatchSeparation
import Wide.MultiplicityThreeGS
import Wide.EncoderLinearity
import Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplexCategory.Basic

/-! Import-isolated R1 copy of the generic joint width-29 list bound. The two
WideExact-only specializations are omitted.

Joint width-29 list bound, derived from the single-word theorem
`exactInitialCloseCandidate_card_lt_101` by separating 101 tuples with one
nonzero batching challenge. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.JointList
open AspisV6Width29CorrelatedAgreement
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7
open AspisWide.InitialEncoder AspisWide.Agreement
open AspisWide.MultiplicityThreeGS AspisWide.BatchSeparation

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem initialMessageCurve_eq_batch (components : Fin 29 → InitialMessage K) (z : K) :
    exactInitialMessageCurve components z = width29CurveValue components z := by
  funext x
  simp only [exactInitialMessageCurve_apply, width29CurveValue, width29Batch]

/-- Each tuple consists of 29 released messages, hence 29 exact codewords.
Injectivity of the encoder makes this also the bound on distinct codeword tuples. -/
theorem jointInitialList_card_le_100
    (lanes : Fin 29 → InitialWord K)
    (family : Finset (Fin 29 → InitialMessage K))
    (close : ∀ components ∈ family,
      38230 ≤ (width29JointAgreementSet exactInitialEncoder lanes components).card) :
    family.card ≤ 100 := by
  classical
  by_contra tooMany
  obtain ⟨small, subset, size⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (show 101 ≤ family.card by omega)
  have baseCard : AspisCircleGroupOrder.P ≤ Fintype.card K := by
    simpa only [ZMod.card] using
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K)
        (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K)
  have pairBudget : small.card.choose 2 * 28 = 141400 := by
    rw [size, Nat.choose_two_right]
  have room : small.card.choose 2 * 28 < Fintype.card K - 1 := by
    rw [pairBudget]
    have primeSize : 141401 < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P := by
      norm_num [AspisCircleGroupOrder.P]
    omega
  obtain ⟨z, _nonzero, separates⟩ := exists_nonzero_injective_batch small room
  let received : InitialWord K := width29CurveValue lanes z
  let candidate : small → ExactInitialCloseCandidate received := fun t =>
    ⟨exactInitialMessageCurve t.1 z, by
      have supports : width29JointAgreementSet exactInitialEncoder lanes t.1 ⊆
          AspisV5FriCoherentCandidateExtraction.agreementSet received
            (exactInitialEncoder (exactInitialMessageCurve t.1 z)) := by
        intro x hx
        simp only [width29JointAgreementSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
          true_and] at hx
        simp only [AspisV5FriCoherentCandidateExtraction.agreementSet,
          Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        rw [exactInitialEncoder_messageCurve]
        change width29Batch (fun i => lanes i x) z =
          width29Batch (fun i => exactInitialEncoder (t.1 i) x) z
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact hx i
      exact (close t.1 (subset t.2)).trans (Finset.card_le_card supports)⟩
  have injective : Function.Injective candidate := by
    intro left right equal
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply separates left.2 right.2
    have messages := congrArg Subtype.val equal
    change exactInitialMessageCurve left.1 z = exactInitialMessageCurve right.1 z at messages
    simpa only [initialMessageCurve_eq_batch] using messages
  letI : Fintype (ExactInitialCloseCandidate received) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have count := Fintype.card_le_of_injective candidate injective
  have singleWordCap := exactInitialCloseCandidate_card_lt_101 received
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at singleWordCap
  rw [Fintype.card_coe, size] at count
  omega

/-- Literal codeword-tuple form: each of the 29 coordinates is in the exact
encoder image, and the 29 agreements must hold on the same 38230 points. -/
theorem jointInitialCodewords_card_le_100
    (lanes : Fin 29 → InitialWord K)
    (family : Finset (Fin 29 → InitialWord K))
    (codewords : ∀ words ∈ family, ∀ i,
      ∃ message : InitialMessage K, exactInitialEncoder message = words i)
    (close : ∀ words ∈ family,
      38230 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun x => ∀ i, lanes i x = words i x).card) :
    family.card ≤ 100 := by
  classical
  let selected : family → Fin 29 → InitialMessage K := fun t i =>
    Classical.choose (codewords t.1 t.2 i)
  have encoded : ∀ t : family, ∀ i, exactInitialEncoder (selected t i) = t.1 i := by
    intro t i
    exact Classical.choose_spec (codewords t.1 t.2 i)
  have injective : Function.Injective selected := by
    intro left right equal
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    rw [← encoded left i, ← encoded right i]
    exact congrArg exactInitialEncoder (congrFun equal i)
  let messages := Finset.univ.image selected
  have size : messages.card = family.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe]
  rw [← size]
  apply jointInitialList_card_le_100 lanes messages
  intro components member
  obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp member
  have jointEq : width29JointAgreementSet exactInitialEncoder lanes (selected t) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ∀ i, lanes i x = t.1 i x) := by
    simp only [width29JointAgreementSet, encoded]
  rw [jointEq]
  exact close t.1 t.2

#print axioms jointInitialCodewords_card_le_100
#print axioms initialMessageCurve_eq_batch
#print axioms jointInitialList_card_le_100
end AspisR1.JointList

R1LiteralOpeningFunctionalFacts.text:
import R1LiteralOpeningView

/-! Successful literal opening reads expose the functional values assembled
by the reader. This is a model-level projection fact only. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralOpeningFunctionalFacts

open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningFunctionals

attribute [local irreducible] SelectedOpeningFunctionals.functionals
  SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rawBase SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rows
  LiteralTypedWords.word

theorem read_functionals
    (rs : List (AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Message × AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (v : LiteralOpeningView.View)
    (hread : LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some v) :
    v.functionals =
        SelectedOpeningFunctionals.functionals (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
          (v.semantic.map Prod.snd) v.circlePoints ∧
    v.baseFunctional =
        SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rawBase (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
          (v.semantic.map Prod.snd) v.circlePoints := by
  unfold LiteralOpeningView.read at hread
  split at hread
  · rename_i hprefix
    cases hc1 : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c1At rs with
    | none => simp [hc1] at hread
    | some c1 =>
      cases hc2 : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c2At rs with
      | none => simp [hc1, hc2] at hread
      | some c2 =>
        simp only [hc1, hc2, Option.bind_some] at hread
        split at hread
        · simp at hread
        · rename_i semantic hsem
          cases hz0 : AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 25 with
          | none => simp [hc1, hc2, hsem, hz0] at hread
          | some z0 =>
            cases hz1 : AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 26 with
            | none => simp [hc1, hc2, hsem, hz0, hz1] at hread
            | some z1 =>
              let circlePoints : Fin 2 →
                  AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point AspisWideTower.WideExact := fun i =>
                if i.val = 0 then
                  R0P.SemSource.circleSampleParameter0
                    (AspisR1.SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf z0)
                else
                  R0P.SemSource.circleSampleParameter1
                    (AspisR1.SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf z1)
              let expected : LiteralOpeningView.View :=
                { c1 := c1
                  c2 := c2
                  word := AspisR1.LiteralTypedWords.word
                    AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed
                    AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView.eK c1 c2
                  semantic := semantic
                  semantic_length := by
                    have hlen := AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.read_length
                      AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView.eK 0 (rs.take 25) semantic hsem
                    rw [hlen]
                    exact hprefix
                  challenge25 := z0
                  challenge26 := z1
                  circlePoints := circlePoints
                  functionals := SelectedOpeningFunctionals.functionals (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
                    (semantic.map Prod.snd) circlePoints
                  baseFunctional := SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rawBase (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
                    (semantic.map Prod.snd) circlePoints }
              have hv : expected = v := by
                apply Option.some.inj
                change some expected = some v
                simpa [expected, circlePoints, hsem, hz0, hz1] using hread
              rw [← hv]
              exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · simp at hread

theorem read_semantic_components
    (rs : List (AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Message × AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (v : LiteralOpeningView.View)
    (hread : LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some v) :
    AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c1At rs = some v.c1 ∧
    AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c2At rs = some v.c2 ∧
    AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.read
      LiteralOpeningView.eK 0 (rs.take 25) = some v.semantic ∧
    v.word = AspisR1.LiteralTypedWords.word
      AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed LiteralOpeningView.eK v.c1 v.c2 := by
  unfold LiteralOpeningView.read at hread
  split at hread
  · rename_i hprefix
    cases hc1 : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c1At rs with
    | none => simp [hc1] at hread
    | some c1 =>
      cases hc2 : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c2At rs with
      | none => simp [hc1, hc2] at hread
      | some c2 =>
        simp only [hc1, hc2, Option.bind_some] at hread
        split at hread
        · simp at hread
        · rename_i semantic hsem
          cases hz0 : AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 25 with
          | none => simp [hc1, hc2, hsem, hz0] at hread
          | some z0 =>
            cases hz1 : AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 26 with
            | none => simp [hc1, hc2, hsem, hz0, hz1] at hread
            | some z1 =>
              let circlePoints : Fin 2 →
                  AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point AspisWideTower.WideExact := fun i =>
                if i.val = 0 then
                  R0P.SemSource.circleSampleParameter0
                    (AspisR1.SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf z0)
                else
                  R0P.SemSource.circleSampleParameter1
                    (AspisR1.SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf z1)
              let expected : LiteralOpeningView.View :=
                { c1 := c1
                  c2 := c2
                  word := AspisR1.LiteralTypedWords.word
                    AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed
                    LiteralOpeningView.eK c1 c2
                  semantic := semantic
                  semantic_length := by
                    have hlen := AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.read_length
                      LiteralOpeningView.eK 0 (rs.take 25) semantic hsem
                    rw [hlen]
                    exact hprefix
                  challenge25 := z0
                  challenge26 := z1
                  circlePoints := circlePoints
                  functionals := SelectedOpeningFunctionals.functionals (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
                    (semantic.map Prod.snd) circlePoints
                  baseFunctional := SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rawBase (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
                    (semantic.map Prod.snd) circlePoints }
              have hv : expected = v := by
                apply Option.some.inj
                change some expected = some v
                simpa [expected, circlePoints, hsem, hz0, hz1] using hread
              rw [← hv]
              exact ⟨rfl, rfl, hsem, rfl⟩
  · simp at hread

#print axioms read_functionals
#print axioms read_semantic_components

end AspisR1.LiteralOpeningFunctionalFacts
end

R1LiteralOpeningView.text:
import R1LiteralTranscript
import R1LiteralSemanticPrefix
import R1LiteralChallengeRead
import R1LiteralTypedWords
import R1SelectedOpeningFunctionals
import R1SelectedChallengeMap
import R1ExactBaseProjection

/-! Assemble the literal prefix fields used by the selected opening model.
The result is a strict typed view of existing message/challenge entries. It
does not assert source refinement, acceptance, or a shared-oracle density law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix
open AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningFunctionals
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev eK : QM31Exact →+* E := algebraMap QM31Exact E
abbrev W := Fin 29 → AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7.InitialWord E
abbrev Functional := AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Functional E

structure View where
  c1 : LiteralTranscript.C1Word
  c2 : LiteralTranscript.C2Word
  word : W
  semantic : List (R0P.Mask.SemMsgZ E × E)
  semantic_length : semantic.length = 25
  challenge25 : E
  challenge26 : E
  circlePoints : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point AspisWideTower.WideExact
  functionals : Fin 6 → Functional
  baseFunctional : Functional

/-- Read the typed opening context from literal message and challenge entries.
The semantic prefix must contain exactly 25 rows; the two ordinary challenges
at rows 25 and 26 are projected through the selected total circle maps. -/
def read (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge)) :
    Option View := do
  if hprefix : (rs.take 25).length = 25 then
    let c1 ← LiteralTranscript.c1At rs
    let c2 ← LiteralTranscript.c2At rs
    match hsem : LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 (rs.take 25) with
    | none => none
    | some semantic => do
        let z0 ← LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 25
        let z1 ← LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 26
        let word := LiteralTypedWords.word ExactBaseProjection.embed eK c1 c2
        let semanticChallenges := semantic.map Prod.snd
        let circlePoints : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point AspisWideTower.WideExact := fun i =>
          if i.val = 0 then
            R0P.SemSource.circleSampleParameter0 (SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf z0)
          else
            R0P.SemSource.circleSampleParameter1 (SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf z1)
        pure ⟨c1, c2, word, semantic,
          by
            have hlen := LiteralSemanticPrefix.read_length eK 0
              (rs.take 25) semantic hsem
            rw [hlen]
            exact hprefix,
          z0, z1, circlePoints,
          SelectedOpeningFunctionals.functionals (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
            semanticChallenges circlePoints,
          SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rawBase (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact)
            semanticChallenges circlePoints⟩
  else none

theorem read_semantic_length
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (v : View) (h : read rs = some v) : v.semantic.length = 25 := by
  exact v.semantic_length

#print axioms read
#print axioms read_semantic_length

end AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView
end

R1SelectedOpeningFunctionals.text:
import R1SemanticOpening
import R1SemanticTransport
import R0P.Copy
import R1SelectedCircleWeightModel

/-! A mathematical selected-row construction for the seven opening
functionals. The circle rows use the existing natural-line `circleWeight`
model. This file does not prove that this model matches the current Rust
`Weights` implementation. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.SelectedOpeningFunctionals

open AspisCircleGroupOrder

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) E]

def alpha (cs : List E) : Fin 10 → E := fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0

def circle (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E) :
    Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E := fun k j =>
      AspisR1.SelectedCircleWeightModel.circleWeight (z k).val.1 (z k).val.2 j.val

def rows (cs : List E) (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E) :
    Fin 7 → Fin 1024 → E :=
  AspisR1.SemanticOpening.rows R0P.copyInactiveRows
    (AspisR1.SemanticTransport.points (alpha cs))
    (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight (alpha cs)) (circle z)

def functionals (cs : List E) (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E) :=
  AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rawFunctionals (RingHom.id E) (rows cs z)

def rawBase (cs : List E) (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E) :=
  AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rawBaseFunctional (RingHom.id E) (rows cs z)

theorem rows_point (cs : List E) (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E)
    (j : Fin 3) :
    rows cs z ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ =
      AspisR1.tensorPoint (AspisR1.SemanticTransport.points (alpha cs) j) :=
  AspisR1.SemanticOpening.rows_point R0P.copyInactiveRows
    (AspisR1.SemanticTransport.points (alpha cs))
    (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight (alpha cs)) (circle z) j

theorem functionals_eq_rows (cs : List E)
    (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E) :
    functionals cs z =
      AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rawFunctionals (RingHom.id E) (rows cs z) := rfl

theorem rawBase_eq_rows (cs : List E)
    (z : Fin 2 → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E) :
    rawBase cs z =
      AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rawBaseFunctional (RingHom.id E) (rows cs z) := rfl

#print axioms rows_point
#print axioms functionals_eq_rows
#print axioms rawBase_eq_rows

end AspisR1.SelectedOpeningFunctionals
end

R1SemanticOpening.text:
import R1CandidateDescent
import R1RawOpening
import R1D18OpeningWeights

/-! Instantiate the seven-row opening algebra with the D18 point weights and
recover the typed candidate/point/extra-claim interface used by the existing
semantic proof. Circle rows and the extra row remain explicit inputs. This is
an E-valued coefficient model, not a parser, Rust, transcript, or spend theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SemanticOpening
open scoped BigOperators
open AspisCircleGroupOrder AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7
open AspisWide.InitialEncoder

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) E]

/-- Raw rows in verifier order: inactive, three semantic points, extra,
then the two circle evaluations. -/
def rows (inactive : Finset (Fin 1024)) (points : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E)
    (extra : Fin 1024 → E) (circle : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E) :
    Fin 7 → Fin 1024 → E :=
  ![AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv (AspisR0.Opening.indicator inactive),
    tensorPoint (points 0), tensorPoint (points 1), tensorPoint (points 2),
    extra, circle 0, circle 1]

theorem rows_point (inactive : Finset (Fin 1024)) (points : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E)
    (extra : Fin 1024 → E) (circle : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E) (j : Fin 3) :
    rows inactive points extra circle ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ = tensorPoint (points j) := by
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

theorem rowMap_id_eq_dot (w m : Fin 1024 → E) :
    AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rowMap (RingHom.id E) w m =
      AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot w m := by
  change (∑ i, m i * w i) = ∑ i, w i * m i
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)

/-- This has the point/extra/codeword-typing conjuncts of the older opening
witness, with the new literal candidate list and the concrete D18 transport. -/
def Witness (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (points : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E) (extra : Fin 1024 → E)
    (t : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E) : Prop :=
  t ∈ AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.candidates d.W ∧
  (∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ l : Fin 29,
    d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l = AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
      (AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv
        (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint (points j)))) (t l)) ∧
  (∀ l : Fin 29, d.Y 3 l = AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot extra (t l)) ∧
  (∀ l i, exactInitialEncoder (t l) i ∈ S l)

theorem claims_imply_witness
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (typed : AspisR1.CandidateDescent.WordTyped S d.W)
    (inactive : Finset (Fin 1024)) (points : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E)
    (extra : Fin 1024 → E) (circle : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E)
    (hclaims : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Claims
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E) (rows inactive points extra circle) d)) :
    ∃ t, Witness S d points extra t := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hrows, _⟩ := hclaims
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_, ?_, AspisR1.CandidateDescent.candidate_codeword_typed
    S d.W typed t ht⟩
  · intro j l
    have h := hrows ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l
    change AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rowMap (RingHom.id E)
      (rows inactive points extra circle ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩) (t l) = _ at h
    rw [rows_point, rowMap_id_eq_dot] at h
    have hweight : tensorPoint (points j) =
        AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv
          (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint (points j))) := by
      funext i
      exact (coeffWeight_eq_tensorPoint (points j) i).symm
    rw [hweight] at h
    exact h.symm
  · intro l
    have h := hrows 3 l
    change AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights.rowMap (RingHom.id E) extra (t l) = _ at h
    rw [rowMap_id_eq_dot] at h
    exact h.symm

theorem large_matching_implies_witness
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (typed : AspisR1.CandidateDescent.WordTyped S d.W)
    (inactive : Finset (Fin 1024)) (points : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E)
    (extra : Fin 1024 → E) (circle : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E)
    (hgood : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Good
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E) (rows inactive points extra circle) d))
    (haccepted : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E) (rows inactive points extra circle) d))
    (hcard : 9558 ≤ (AspisR1.MatchingSupport.matchingSet
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E) (rows inactive points extra circle) d)).card) :
    ∃ t, Witness S d points extra t :=
  claims_imply_witness S d typed inactive points extra circle
    (AspisR1.MatchingSupport.large_matching_implies_claims _ hgood haccepted hcard)

/-- The recovered coefficient tuple has subfield-typed semantic rows. -/
theorem witness_rows_typed
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (points : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E) (extra : Fin 1024 → E)
    (t : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E) (ht : Witness S d points extra t) :
    ∀ l r, t l (rowEquiv r) ∈ S l := by
  intro l r
  exact AspisWide.SubfieldDescent.initialMessage_subfield_descent
    (S l) (t l) (ht.2.2.2 l) (rowEquiv r)

#print axioms rows_point
#print axioms rowMap_id_eq_dot
#print axioms claims_imply_witness
#print axioms large_matching_implies_witness
#print axioms witness_rows_typed
end AspisR1.SemanticOpening
end

R1D18OpeningWeights.text:
import R0.OpeningWeights
import R1D18PointWeights
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Arithmetic alignment of the R0 Boolean opening weights with the D18 row
and tensor point products. These identities do not claim correspondence with
the Rust implementation or protocol semantics. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1

open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- The explicit coordinate reversal used by `R0P.SemSource.toR0`. -/
def reversePoint (p : Fin 10 → K) : Fin 10 → K :=
  fun b => p ⟨9 - b.val, by have hb := b.isLt; omega⟩

private theorem rowEquiv_symm_apply (j : Fin 1024) :
    rowEquiv.symm j = rowEquiv j := by
  apply rowEquiv.injective
  rw [rowEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (row_involutive j).symm

theorem coeffWeight_eq_rowPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv
      (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p)) j = rowPoint p j := by
  rw [AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight, rowEquiv_symm_apply]
  rfl

theorem coeffWeight_eq_tensorPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv
      (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p)) j = tensorPoint p j := by
  calc
    AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv
        (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p)) j = rowPoint p j :=
      coeffWeight_eq_rowPoint p j
    _ = tensorPoint p j := rowPoint_eq_tensorPoint p j

theorem dot_tensorPoint_eq_openingWeight
    (p : Fin 10 → K) (m : Fin 1024 → K) :
    AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot (tensorPoint p) m =
      AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
        (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p))
        (fun r => m (rowEquiv r)) := by
  calc
    AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot (tensorPoint p) m =
        AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
          (AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv
            (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p))) m := by
          congr 1
          funext j
          exact (coeffWeight_eq_tensorPoint p j).symm
    _ = AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
        (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p))
        (fun r => m (rowEquiv r)) :=
      AspisR0.Opening.dot_coeffWeight_left rowEquiv
        (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (reversePoint p)) m

theorem coeffWeight_indicator_eq_rowIndicator
    (I : Finset (Fin 1024)) (j : Fin 1024) :
    AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv (AspisR0.Opening.indicator I) j =
      if row j ∈ I then (1 : K) else 0 := by
  change AspisR0.Opening.indicator (K := K) I (rowEquiv.symm j) = _
  rw [rowEquiv_symm_apply]
  rfl

theorem dot_coeffWeight_indicator_rows
    (I : Finset (Fin 1024)) (m : Fin 1024 → K) :
    AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
      (AspisR0.Opening.coeffWeight rowEquiv (AspisR0.Opening.indicator I)) m =
      ∑ r ∈ I, m (rowEquiv r) :=
  AspisR0.Opening.dot_coeffWeight_indicator rowEquiv I m

#print axioms rowEquiv_symm_apply
#print axioms coeffWeight_eq_rowPoint
#print axioms coeffWeight_eq_tensorPoint
#print axioms dot_tensorPoint_eq_openingWeight
#print axioms coeffWeight_indicator_eq_rowIndicator
#print axioms dot_coeffWeight_indicator_rows

end AspisR1

R1D18PointWeights.text:
import R1D18Transport
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Arithmetic equivalence between the ten binary row factors and the five
radix-four tensor factors. This is a model-level identity only. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1

open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def d18Tau (d : Fin 5) : Fin 5 :=
  ⟨if d.val = 0 then 3 else if d.val = 3 then 0 else
    if d.val = 1 then 4 else if d.val = 4 then 1 else 2,
    by fin_cases d <;> norm_num⟩

theorem d18Tau_involutive (d : Fin 5) : d18Tau (d18Tau d) = d := by
  apply Fin.ext
  fin_cases d <;> norm_num [d18Tau]

def d18BitIndexEquiv : (Fin 5 × Fin 2) ≃ Fin 10 :=
  { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.2.val + 2 * (d18Tau x.1).val, by
      have hu := x.2.isLt
      have ht := (d18Tau x.1).isLt
      omega⟩
    invFun := fun b =>
      (d18Tau ⟨b.val / 2, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩,
        ⟨b.val % 2, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩)
    left_inv := by
      rintro ⟨d, u⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Fin.ext
        have hquot : (u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) / 2 = (d18Tau d).val := by
          have hu := u.isLt
          omega
        change (d18Tau ⟨(u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) / 2, by omega⟩).val = d.val
        have qfin : (⟨(u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) / 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 5) =
            d18Tau d := Fin.ext hquot
        rw [qfin]
        exact congrArg Fin.val (d18Tau_involutive d)
      · apply Fin.ext
        have hu := u.isLt
        change (u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) % 2 = u.val
        omega
    right_inv := by
      intro b
      apply Fin.ext
      have hquot : b.val / 2 < 5 := by have := b.isLt; omega
      change b.val % 2 + 2 *
        (d18Tau (d18Tau ⟨b.val / 2, hquot⟩)).val = b.val
      rw [d18Tau_involutive]
      exact Nat.mod_add_div b.val 2 }

@[simp] theorem d18BitIndexEquiv_val (d : Fin 5) (u : Fin 2) :
    (d18BitIndexEquiv (d, u)).val = u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val := rfl

def pairFactor (a b : K) (s : Nat) : K :=
  (if s % 2 = 0 then 1 - a else a) *
    (if s / 2 = 0 then 1 - b else b)

def rowPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) : K :=
  ∏ b : Fin 10, if rowNat j.val / 2 ^ b.val % 2 = 0 then
    1 - p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩
    else p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩

def tensorPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) : K :=
  ∏ d : Fin 5, pairFactor
    (p ⟨9 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
    (p ⟨8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
    ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4)

private theorem mod4_digit_bit (q : Nat) (u : Fin 2) :
    q / 2 ^ u.val % 2 = (q % 4 / 2 ^ u.val) % 2 := by
  fin_cases u
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
    have hsplit : q % 4 + 4 * (q / 4) = q := Nat.mod_add_div q 4
    have hr : q % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt q (by omega)
    omega

private theorem radix4_digit_bit (n k : Nat) (u : Fin 2) :
    n / 2 ^ (2 * k + u.val) % 2 =
      ((n / 4 ^ k) % 4 / 2 ^ u.val) % 2 := by
  have hpow : 2 ^ (2 * k + u.val) = 4 ^ k * 2 ^ u.val := by
    fin_cases u <;> norm_num [pow_add, pow_mul]
  rw [hpow, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
  exact mod4_digit_bit (n / 4 ^ k) u

private theorem rowBit_eq_digitBit (j : Nat) (d : Fin 5) (u : Fin 2) :
    rowNat j / 2 ^ (2 * (d18Tau d).val + u.val) % 2 =
      (((j / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) / 2 ^ u.val) % 2 := by
  have hrow := radix4_digit_bit (rowNat j) (d18Tau d).val u
  have hdigit : (rowNat j / 4 ^ (d18Tau d).val) % 4 =
      (j / 4 ^ d.val) % 4 := by
    fin_cases d <;>
      norm_num [d18Tau, rowNat_digit0, rowNat_digit1, rowNat_digit2,
        rowNat_digit3, rowNat_digit4]
  exact hrow.trans (congrArg (fun x : Nat => (x / 2 ^ u.val) % 2) hdigit)

theorem rowPoint_eq_tensorPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    rowPoint p j = tensorPoint p j := by
  unfold rowPoint tensorPoint
  calc
    (∏ b : Fin 10, if rowNat j.val / 2 ^ b.val % 2 = 0 then
        1 - p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩
        else p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩) =
      ∏ x : Fin 5 × Fin 2,
        if rowNat j.val / 2 ^ (d18BitIndexEquiv x).val % 2 = 0 then
          1 - p ⟨9 - (d18BitIndexEquiv x).val, by
            have := (d18BitIndexEquiv x).isLt; omega⟩
        else p ⟨9 - (d18BitIndexEquiv x).val, by
          have := (d18BitIndexEquiv x).isLt; omega⟩ := by
            symm
            apply Fintype.prod_equiv d18BitIndexEquiv
            intro x
            rfl
    _ = ∏ d : Fin 5, pairFactor
        (p ⟨9 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
        (p ⟨8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
        ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) := by
      rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_two]
      have hbit0 := rowBit_eq_digitBit j.val d 0
      have hbit1 := rowBit_eq_digitBit j.val d 1
      simp only [d18BitIndexEquiv_val, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one,
        Nat.zero_add] at ⊢
      have hbit0' : rowNat j.val / 2 ^ (2 * (d18Tau d).val) % 2 =
          ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) % 2 := by
        simpa using hbit0
      have hbit1' : rowNat j.val / 2 ^ (1 + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) % 2 =
          ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4 / 2) % 2 := by
        simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hbit1
      rw [hbit0', hbit1']
      have hp1 : (⟨9 - (1 + 2 * (d18Tau d).val), by
          have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 10) =
          ⟨8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩ := by
        have ht := (d18Tau d).isLt
        apply Fin.ext
        change 9 - (1 + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) = 8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val
        omega
      rw [hp1]
      simp only [pairFactor]
      have hslt : ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      have hhalf : ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) / 2 < 2 := by omega
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hhalf]

#print axioms d18Tau_involutive
#print axioms rowBit_eq_digitBit
#print axioms rowPoint_eq_tensorPoint

end AspisR1

import R1SemanticOpening
import R0P.MaskProtocol

/-! Translate the mechanical R1 D18 opening witness into the existing R0P
row-space semantic interfaces. This file does not add semantic premises. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SemanticTransport

open AspisCircleGroupOrder
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) E]

/-- The semantic point triple before R0's coordinate reversal. -/
def points (alpha : Fin 10 → E) : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → E :=
  ![alpha, R0P.SemSource.successorPoint alpha, R0P.SemSource.xor12Point alpha]

theorem reversePoint_points (alpha : Fin 10 → E) (j : Fin 3) :
    AspisR1.reversePoint (points alpha j) = R0P.SemSource.openingPoints alpha j := by
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

/-- The three D18 coefficient claims are exactly the R0P honest point claims
on the trace obtained by applying the row transport to the coefficient tuple. -/
theorem witness_point_claims
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (alpha : Fin 10 → E) (m : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (hm : AspisR1.SemanticOpening.Witness S d (points alpha)
      (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight alpha) m) :
    (fun j : Fin 3 => fun l : Fin 29 => d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l) =
      R0P.SemSource.honestClaims (R0P.SemSource.rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) alpha := by
  funext j l
  have h := hm.2.1 j l
  rw [AspisR0.Opening.dot_coeffWeight_left] at h
  rw [reversePoint_points alpha j] at h
  change d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l =
    AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
      (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (R0P.SemSource.openingPoints alpha j))
      (fun r => m l (AspisR1.rowEquiv r))
  exact h

/-- The D18 extra row is the existing Libra-weighted extra claim on the
transported semantic trace. -/
theorem witness_extra_claims
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (alpha : Fin 10 → E) (m : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (hm : AspisR1.SemanticOpening.Witness S d (points alpha)
      (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight alpha) m) :
    d.Y 3 = R0P.Mask.honestExtra AspisR1.rowEquiv
      (R0P.SemSource.rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) alpha := by
  funext l
  have h := hm.2.2.1 l
  change d.Y 3 l = AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
    (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight alpha) (m l) at h
  change d.Y 3 l = AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
    (R0P.Mask.libraWeight alpha)
    (R0P.SemSource.coeffsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv
      (R0P.SemSource.rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) l)
  rw [R0P.SemSource.coeffsOf_rowsOf]
  exact h

/-- Candidate encoder descent supplies the C1 base typing of the transported
row trace. -/
theorem witness_baseTyped
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (F : Subfield E)
    (lanesF : ∀ l : Fin 29, l.val < 26 → S l = F)
    (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E) (alpha : Fin 10 → E)
    (m : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (hm : AspisR1.SemanticOpening.Witness S d (points alpha)
      (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight alpha) m) :
    R0P.BaseTyped F (R0P.SemSource.rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) := by
  have htyped := AspisR1.SemanticOpening.witness_rows_typed S d (points alpha)
    (R0P.SemSource.libraWeight alpha) m hm
  intro l hl r
  change m l (AspisR1.rowEquiv r) ∈ F
  have hs : m l (AspisR1.rowEquiv r) ∈ S l := htyped l r
  rw [lanesF l hl] at hs
  exact hs

#print axioms reversePoint_points
#print axioms witness_point_claims
#print axioms witness_extra_claims
#print axioms witness_baseTyped

end AspisR1.SemanticTransport
end

import AspisFormal.V5FriNaturalBasisRadix4
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases

/-! The selected model of the source circle-weight formula, using only the
active natural-line basis. This does not establish Rust refinement. -/
namespace AspisR1.SelectedCircleWeightModel

open AspisCircleTensorBinding

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [NeZero (2 : F)]

def circleWeight (x y : F) (r : Nat) : F :=
  naturalLineValue x (r / 2) * if r % 2 = 0 then 1 else y

theorem circle_four (x y : F) (n : Nat) (k : Fin 4) :
    circleWeight x y (4 * n + k.val) =
      naturalLineValue (doubledFactor x 1) n * ![1, y, x, x * y] k := by
  have hd0 : (4 * n) / 2 = 2 * n := by omega
  have hd1 : (4 * n + 1) / 2 = 2 * n := by omega
  have hd2 : (4 * n + 2) / 2 = 2 * n + 1 := by omega
  have hd3 : (4 * n + 3) / 2 = 2 * n + 1 := by omega
  have hm0 : (4 * n) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hm1 : (4 * n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  have hm2 : (4 * n + 2) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hm3 : (4 * n + 3) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  fin_cases k <;> simp [circleWeight, hd0, hd1, hd2, hd3, hm0, hm1, hm2, hm3,
    show ¬ (1 : Nat) = 0 by decide, ↓reduceIte,
    AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.naturalLineValue_two_mul,
    AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.naturalLineValue_two_mul_add_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.cons_val_three, mul_one] <;> ring

#print axioms circle_four

end AspisR1.SelectedCircleWeightModel

import R1LiteralClassifier

/-! Identify the literal row-32 rho event with its residual-polynomial
predicate when the completed matching-data and ordered-query readers succeed.
This is a conditional event identity only; it makes no probability,
acceptance, or extraction claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralRhoBinding

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open AspisR1.LiteralClassifier
open AspisR1.LiteralRhoDensity
open AspisR1.LiteralQueryRead
open AspisR1.LiteralMatchingData
open AspisR1.SelectedChallengeMap
open AspisR1.QueryResidualBridge

attribute [local irreducible] QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad

theorem rho_event_iff
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (v : AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (state : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State)
    (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hround : P.round = 32)
    (hvalid : LiteralTranscript.valid 32 m)
    (hdata : LiteralMatchingData.beforeRho P = some d)
    (hqueries : LiteralQueryRead.queriesAt P.rounds 31 = some q) :
    LiteralClassifier.bad P m (TranscriptView.Value.ordinary v, state) ↔
      SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf v ∈
        QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad LiteralOpeningView.eK d q := by
  have hread : LiteralRhoDensity.read P = some (d, q) := by
    simp [LiteralRhoDensity.read, hdata, hqueries]
  cases m with
  | initial root word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at hvalid
  | c2 bytes word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at hvalid
  | second bytes word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at hvalid
  | payload bytes =>
      simpa [LiteralClassifier.bad, LiteralOrdinaryDensity.event,
        LiteralTranscript.valid, LiteralRhoDensity.bad, hround, hvalid, hread]

#print axioms rho_event_iff

end AspisR1.LiteralRhoBinding
end

import R1LiteralSemanticPrefix
import R1LiteralSemanticIndex
import R1SemanticPayloadView
import R1SemanticRecordCodec
import R1LiteralSemanticCodecBridge
import R1LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge

/-! Successful literal semantic-prefix reads are represented by the canonical
typed payload-pair list, with the C2 callback fixed by the literal word at
row 2. This is a model-level list identity only. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPairs

open AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix
open AspisR1.SemanticPayloadView
open AspisR1.SemanticRecordCodec
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open R0P.Mask

abbrev E := LiteralSemanticPrefix.E

theorem read_eq_pairs
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (out : List (SemMsgZ E × E))
    (word : LiteralTranscript.C2Word)
    (hread : LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 rs = some out)
    (hlen : rs.length = 25)
    (hc2 : LiteralTranscript.c2At rs = some word) :
    ∃ payloads : (i : Fin 25) → SemanticRecordCodec.RowPayload i,
    ∃ challenges : Fin 25 → E,
      out = SemanticPayloadView.pairs
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges := by
  have houtlen : out.length = 25 := by
    rw [LiteralSemanticPrefix.read_length eK 0 rs out hread, hlen]
  have hrowValid (i : Fin 25) :
      LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (rs[i.val]'(by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt)).1 := by
    have hi : i.val < rs.length := by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt
    obtain ⟨_, parsed, _, hparsed, _, _⟩ :=
      LiteralSemanticIndex.read_index eK 0 rs out hread i.val hi
    have hparsed' : LiteralSemanticPrefix.parseMessage eK i (rs[i.val]'hi).1 =
        some parsed := by
      simpa using hparsed
    by_contra hbad
    simp [LiteralSemanticPrefix.parseMessage, hbad] at hparsed'
  have hcarrying (i : Fin 25) :
      LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge.CarriesC2 word
        (rs[i.val]'(by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt)).1 := by
    intro bs actual hm
    have hvalid : LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (.c2 bs actual) := by
      rw [← hm]
      exact hrowValid i
    have hrow2 := LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge.valid_c2_row i.val bs actual hvalid
    have htwo : 2 < rs.length := by rw [hlen]; omega
    have hm2 : (rs[2]'htwo).1 = .c2 bs actual := by
      simpa only [hrow2] using hm
    have hh := hc2
    unfold LiteralTranscript.c2At at hh
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem htwo] at hh
    simp only [Option.bind_some, hm2] at hh
    exact Option.some.inj hh
  have hrow (i : Fin 25) :
      ∃ payload : SemanticRecordCodec.RowPayload i, ∃ c : E,
        out[i.val]'(by simpa [houtlen] using i.isLt) =
          (SemanticPayloadView.toMessage (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
            payload.val, c) := by
    have hi : i.val < rs.length := by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt
    obtain ⟨_, parsed, c, hparsed, _, hindex⟩ :=
      LiteralSemanticIndex.read_index eK 0 rs out hread i.val hi
    have hparsed' : LiteralSemanticPrefix.parseMessage eK i (rs[i.val]'hi).1 =
        some parsed := by
      simpa using hparsed
    have hv : LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (rs[i.val]'hi).1 := hrowValid i
    obtain ⟨payload, hdecode⟩ :=
      LiteralSemanticCodecBridge.decode_of_parseMessage eK i
        (rs[i.val]'hi).1 parsed hparsed'
    have hmap :
        (SemanticRecordCodec.decode i
          (LiteralSemanticCodecBridge.record (rs[i.val]'hi).1)).map
          (fun p => SemanticPayloadView.toMessage
            (LiteralSemanticCodecBridge.callback eK (rs[i.val]'hi).1) p.val) =
          some parsed := by
      have h := hparsed'
      rw [LiteralSemanticCodecBridge.parseMessage_eq_decode] at h
      simpa only [if_pos hv] using h
    rw [hdecode] at hmap
    simp only [Option.map_some] at hmap
    have hcallback :
        SemanticPayloadView.toMessage
          (LiteralSemanticCodecBridge.callback eK (rs[i.val]'hi).1) payload.val =
        SemanticPayloadView.toMessage
          (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payload.val :=
      LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge.callback_toMessage eK i payload
        (rs[i.val]'hi).1 word hv (hcarrying i)
    have hp : parsed = SemanticPayloadView.toMessage
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payload.val :=
      (Option.some.inj hmap).symm.trans hcallback
    refine ⟨payload, c, ?_⟩
    simpa [hp] using hindex
  let payloads : (i : Fin 25) → SemanticRecordCodec.RowPayload i :=
    fun i => Classical.choose (hrow i)
  let challenges : Fin 25 → E :=
    fun i => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hrow i))
  have hchosen (i : Fin 25) :
      out[i.val]'(by simpa [houtlen] using i.isLt) =
        (SemanticPayloadView.toMessage
            (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) (payloads i).val,
          challenges i) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hrow i))
  refine ⟨payloads, challenges, ?_⟩
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [SemanticPayloadView.pairs, List.length_ofFn, houtlen]
  · intro n h₁ h₂
    let i : Fin 25 := ⟨n, by simpa [houtlen] using h₁⟩
    have heq := hchosen i
    simpa only [SemanticPayloadView.pairs, List.getElem_ofFn, i] using heq

#print axioms read_eq_pairs

end AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPairs
end

import R1LiteralSemanticCodecBridge
import R1SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts
import R1LiteralTypedContext

/-! Relate strict semantic record bytes and
the literal C2 word to SemanticPayloadView. The record sequence, constructor
schedule and ordinary challenge coordinates are explicit representation
premises, not consequences asserted about Rust verification. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge

open R0P.Mask R0P.SemSource
open AspisR1.SemanticRecordCodec
open AspisR1.LiteralSemanticCodecBridge

abbrev E := LiteralSemanticPrefix.E
abbrev State := SemanticPayloadView.State
abbrev Bytes := SemanticRecordCodec.Bytes
abbrev Message := LiteralTranscript.Message
abbrev Challenge := LiteralTranscript.Challenge
abbrev Entry := SemanticPrefixCodec.Entry
abbrev Full := SemanticPrefixCodec.Full
abbrev C2Word := LiteralTranscript.C2Word

/-- Only the message at logical row two may carry this word. The relation
does not recover a word from a root or from a later oracle table. -/
def CarriesC2 (word : C2Word) (m : Message) : Prop :=
  ∀ bs actual, m = .c2 bs actual → actual = word

theorem callback_toMessage
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (row : Fin 25) (payload : RowPayload row) (m : Message) (word : C2Word)
    (hv : LiteralTranscript.valid row.val m) (hc2 : CarriesC2 word m) :
    SemanticPayloadView.toMessage (callback eK m) payload.val =
      SemanticPayloadView.toMessage (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payload.val := by
  rcases payload with ⟨payload, hp⟩
  cases payload with
  | empty => rfl
  | maskSum value => rfl
  | polynomial coefficients => rfl
  | c2Root root =>
      have hr : row.val = 2 := by simpa [validRow] using hp
      cases m with
      | initial c1 c1word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, hr] at hv
      | payload bs => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, hr] at hv
      | second bs v => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, hr] at hv
      | c2 bs actual =>
          have he := hc2 bs actual rfl
          subst actual
          rfl

theorem parseMessage_of_payload
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (row : Fin 25) (payload : RowPayload row) (m : Message) (word : C2Word)
    (hv : LiteralTranscript.valid row.val m)
    (hbytes : record m = SemanticRecordCodec.encode payload)
    (hc2 : CarriesC2 word m) :
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.parseMessage eK row m =
      some (SemanticPayloadView.toMessage
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payload.val) := by
  rw [parseMessage_eq_decode, if_pos hv, hbytes, SemanticRecordCodec.decode_encode]
  exact congrArg some (callback_toMessage eK row payload m word hv hc2)

def literalPairs (messages : Fin 25 → Message) (challenges : Fin 25 → E)
    (states : Fin 25 → State) : List (Message × Challenge) :=
  List.ofFn fun i => (messages i, (TranscriptView.Value.ordinary (challenges i), states i))

/-- Induction over the accepted codec's sequential entries. This reuses the
literal reader; it is not another parser. -/
theorem read_entries
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E) (word : C2Word)
    (message : Entry → Message) (challenge : Entry → E) (state : Entry → State)
    (row : Nat) (entries : List Entry)
    (hrows : entries.map Sigma.fst = List.range' row entries.length)
    (hv : ∀ e ∈ entries, LiteralTranscript.valid e.1 (message e))
    (hb : ∀ e ∈ entries, record (message e) = SemanticPrefixCodec.encodeEntry e)
    (hc2 : ∀ e ∈ entries, CarriesC2 word (message e)) :
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK row
      (entries.map fun e => (message e, (TranscriptView.Value.ordinary (challenge e), state e))) =
      some (entries.map fun e =>
        (SemanticPayloadView.toMessage (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
          e.2.value.val, challenge e)) := by
  induction entries generalizing row with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first tail ih =>
      rcases first with ⟨j, payload⟩
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.length_cons, List.range'_succ] at hrows
      have hj : j = row := (List.cons.inj hrows).1
      subst j
      have ht := (List.cons.inj hrows).2
      have hp := parseMessage_of_payload eK ⟨row, payload.isLt⟩ payload.value
        (message ⟨row, payload⟩) word
        (hv ⟨row, payload⟩ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        (hb ⟨row, payload⟩ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        (hc2 ⟨row, payload⟩ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
      have htail := ih (row + 1) ht
        (fun e he => hv e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he))
        (fun e he => hb e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he))
        (fun e he => hc2 e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he))
      simp [LiteralSemanticPrefix.read, payload.isLt, hp, htail]

theorem read_of_payloads
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E) (word : C2Word)
    (payloads : Full) (messages : Fin 25 → Message)
    (challenges : Fin 25 → E) (states : Fin 25 → State)
    (hv : ∀ i, LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (messages i))
    (hb : ∀ i, record (messages i) = SemanticRecordCodec.encode (payloads i))
    (hc2 : ∀ i, CarriesC2 word (messages i)) :
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 (literalPairs messages challenges states) =
      some (SemanticPayloadView.pairs
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges) := by
  let message : Entry → Message := fun e => messages ⟨e.1, e.2.isLt⟩
  let challenge : Entry → E := fun e => challenges ⟨e.1, e.2.isLt⟩
  let state : Entry → State := fun e => states ⟨e.1, e.2.isLt⟩
  have hv' : ∀ e ∈ SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf payloads,
      LiteralTranscript.valid e.1 (message e) := by
    intro e he
    rcases List.mem_ofFn.mp he with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hv i
  have hb' : ∀ e ∈ SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf payloads,
      record (message e) = SemanticPrefixCodec.encodeEntry e := by
    intro e he
    rcases List.mem_ofFn.mp he with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hb i
  have hc2' : ∀ e ∈ SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf payloads,
      CarriesC2 word (message e) := by
    intro e he
    rcases List.mem_ofFn.mp he with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hc2 i
  have hrows : (SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf payloads).map Sigma.fst =
      List.range' 0 (SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf payloads).length := by
    simpa only [SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf_length] using
      SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf_rows payloads
  have hr := read_entries eK word message challenge state 0
    (SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf payloads) hrows hv' hb' hc2'
  simpa [message, challenge, state, literalPairs, SemanticPayloadView.pairs,
    SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf, List.map_ofFn] using hr

theorem record_eq_of_decodeFull (messages : Fin 25 → Message) (payloads : Full)
    (h : SemanticPrefixCodec.decodeFull
      (List.ofFn fun i => record (messages i)) = some payloads) (i : Fin 25) :
    record (messages i) = SemanticRecordCodec.encode (payloads i) := by
  have hb := SemanticPrefixCodec.encodeFull_of_decodeFull _ _ h
  have hf : (fun j : Fin 25 => SemanticRecordCodec.encode (payloads j)) =
      (fun j : Fin 25 => record (messages j)) := by
    apply List.ofFn_injective
    simpa only [SemanticPrefixCodec.encodeFull, SemanticPrefixCodec.entriesOf,
      List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, SemanticPrefixCodec.encodeEntry] using hb
  exact (congrFun hf i).symm

/-- Once the literal records successfully decode, no pointwise re-encoding
premise is needed: the accepted codec's back law supplies it. -/
theorem read_of_decodeFull
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E) (word : C2Word)
    (payloads : Full) (messages : Fin 25 → Message)
    (challenges : Fin 25 → E) (states : Fin 25 → State)
    (hv : ∀ i, LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (messages i))
    (hc2 : ∀ i, CarriesC2 word (messages i))
    (hdecode : SemanticPrefixCodec.decodeFull
      (List.ofFn fun i => record (messages i)) = some payloads) :
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 (literalPairs messages challenges states) =
      some (SemanticPayloadView.pairs
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges) :=
  read_of_payloads eK word payloads messages challenges states hv
    (record_eq_of_decodeFull messages payloads hdecode) hc2

theorem lifted_read_of_decodeFull
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E) (word : C2Word)
    (payloads : Full) (messages : Fin 25 → Message)
    (challenges : Fin 25 → E) (states : Fin 25 → State)
    (hv : ∀ i, LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (messages i))
    (hc2 : ∀ i, CarriesC2 word (messages i))
    (hdecode : SemanticPrefixCodec.decodeFull
      (List.ofFn fun i => record (messages i)) = some payloads)
    (parsed : List (SemMsgZ E × E))
    (hread : LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0
      (literalPairs messages challenges states) = some parsed) :
    SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift parsed =
      SemanticPayloadView.rounds
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges := by
  have he := read_of_decodeFull eK word payloads messages challenges states hv hc2 hdecode
  have hp : parsed = SemanticPayloadView.pairs
      (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges :=
    Option.some.inj (hread.symm.trans he)
  rw [hp]
  rfl

theorem valid_c2_row (row : Nat) (bs : LiteralTranscript.BytesMessage) (word : C2Word)
    (h : LiteralTranscript.valid row (.c2 bs word)) : row = 2 := by
  cases row with
  | zero => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at h
  | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at h
      | succ n =>
          cases n with
          | zero => rfl
          | succ n => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at h

theorem carriesC2_of_row_two (messages : Fin 25 → Message) (word : C2Word)
    (hv : ∀ i, LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (messages i))
    (hrow2 : ∃ bs, messages ⟨2, by omega⟩ = .c2 bs word) :
    ∀ i, CarriesC2 word (messages i) := by
  intro i bs actual hm
  have hc : LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (.c2 bs actual) := by rw [← hm]; exact hv i
  have hi : i = (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 25) := Fin.ext (valid_c2_row i.val bs actual hc)
  subst i
  obtain ⟨atTwo, ht⟩ := hrow2
  have he : LiteralTranscript.Message.c2 bs actual =
      LiteralTranscript.Message.c2 atTwo word := hm.symm.trans ht
  cases he
  rfl

theorem read_of_decodeFull_atC2
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E) (word : C2Word)
    (payloads : Full) (messages : Fin 25 → Message)
    (challenges : Fin 25 → E) (states : Fin 25 → State)
    (hv : ∀ i, LiteralTranscript.valid i.val (messages i))
    (hrow2 : ∃ bs, messages ⟨2, by omega⟩ = .c2 bs word)
    (hdecode : SemanticPrefixCodec.decodeFull
      (List.ofFn fun i => record (messages i)) = some payloads) :
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 (literalPairs messages challenges states) =
      some (SemanticPayloadView.pairs
        (fun _ => LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) payloads challenges) :=
  read_of_decodeFull eK word payloads messages challenges states hv
    (carriesC2_of_row_two messages word hv hrow2) hdecode

theorem pair_fst_fullWords
    (eM : ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact →+* E)
    (eK : ExactLeafFieldCodec.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : LiteralTranscript.C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) :
    (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK c2).1 =
      LiteralTypedContext.fullWords eM eK c1 c2 26 := by
  funext i
  simp [LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair, LiteralTypedContext.fullWords, LiteralTypedWords.word]

theorem pair_snd_fullWords
    (eM : ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact →+* E)
    (eK : ExactLeafFieldCodec.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : LiteralTranscript.C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) :
    (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK c2).2 =
      LiteralTypedContext.fullWords eM eK c1 c2 27 := by
  funext i
  simp [LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair, LiteralTypedContext.fullWords, LiteralTypedWords.word]

theorem pair_c2Base
    (eM : ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact →+* E)
    (eK : ExactLeafFieldCodec.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : LiteralTranscript.C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) :
    c2Base (LiteralTypedWords.laneSubfield eM eK)
      (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK c2).1
      (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK c2).2 := by
  rw [pair_fst_fullWords eM eK c1 c2, pair_snd_fullWords eM eK c1 c2]
  exact LiteralTypedContext.c2Base_full eM eK c1 c2

theorem pair_c2Words
    (eM : ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact →+* E)
    (eK : ExactLeafFieldCodec.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (pub : R0P.Public E) (hpub : R0P.PublicBase eM.fieldRange pub)
    (c1 : LiteralTranscript.C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) (extra : Fin 29 → E) :
    c2Words (LiteralTypedContext.context eM eK pub hpub c1 extra)
      (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK c2).1
      (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK c2).2 =
      LiteralTypedContext.fullWords eM eK c1 c2 := by
  rw [pair_fst_fullWords eM eK c1 c2, pair_snd_fullWords eM eK c1 c2]
  exact LiteralTypedContext.c2Words_full eM eK pub hpub c1 c2 extra

-- Consumer: rewrite a parsed literal semantic list using
-- lifted_read_of_decodeFull; supply pair_c2Base to the already existing
-- SemanticPayloadOpeningView.opening_view_of_payloads. Circle premises,
-- opening-message representation and verifier acceptance remain external.

#print axioms callback_toMessage
#print axioms parseMessage_of_payload
#print axioms read_entries
#print axioms read_of_payloads
#print axioms record_eq_of_decodeFull
#print axioms read_of_decodeFull
#print axioms lifted_read_of_decodeFull
#print axioms carriesC2_of_row_two
#print axioms read_of_decodeFull_atC2
#print axioms pair_c2Base
#print axioms pair_c2Words

end AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge
end
