import R1LiteralTypedWords
import R1D18Transport
import R0P.SemSource
import R0P.SemView
import R0P.CoreExt

/-! Construct the existing semantic typed context directly from literal
decoded C1/C2 words. This is a representation bridge only. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.LiteralTypedContext

open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7
open R0P.SemSource
open R0C.SemStatement
open AspisR1.LiteralTypedWords
open AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) E]

def context (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (pub : R0P.Public E) (hpub : R0P.PublicBase eM.fieldRange pub)
    (c1 : C1Word) (extraClaims : Fin 29 → E) : TypedContext E (laneSubfield eM eK) where
  pub := pub
  transport := AspisR1.rowEquiv
  extraClaims := extraClaims
  W := word eM eK c1 (fun _ _ => 0)
  base := word_typed eM eK c1 (fun _ _ => 0)
  F := eM.fieldRange
  lanesF := by
    intro l hl
    simp [laneSubfield, TypedRecoveredWords.laneSubfield, hl]
  pubBase := hpub

def fullWords (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) : Fin 29 → InitialWord E :=
  word eM eK c1 c2

def lane26 (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord E) : InitialWord E := W 26
def lane27 (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord E) : InitialWord E := W 27

theorem full_eq_c1_only_outside_c2 (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) (l : Fin 29) (h26 : l ≠ 26) (h27 : l ≠ 27) :
    fullWords eM eK c1 c2 l =
      fullWords eM eK c1 (fun _ _ => 0) l := by
  exact LiteralTypedWords.word_eq_zeroC2Word_outside_c2 eM eK c1 c2 l h26 h27

theorem c2Words_full (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (pub : R0P.Public E) (hpub : R0P.PublicBase eM.fieldRange pub)
    (c1 : C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) (extraClaims : Fin 29 → E) :
    c2Words (context eM eK pub hpub c1 extraClaims)
      (lane26 (fullWords eM eK c1 c2))
      (lane27 (fullWords eM eK c1 c2)) =
      fullWords eM eK c1 c2 := by
  funext l
  by_cases h26 : l = 26
  · subst l
    simp [c2Words, lane26]
  · by_cases h27 : l = 27
    · subst l
      simp [c2Words, lane27]
    · simp [context, c2Words, lane26, lane27, h26, h27]
      exact (full_eq_c1_only_outside_c2 eM eK c1 c2 l h26 h27).symm

theorem c2Base_full (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : C1Word) (c2 : C2Word) :
    c2Base (laneSubfield eM eK)
      (lane26 (fullWords eM eK c1 c2))
      (lane27 (fullWords eM eK c1 c2)) := by
  have htyped := word_typed eM eK c1 c2
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact htyped 26 i
  · intro i
    exact htyped 27 i

#print axioms c2Words_full
#print axioms c2Base_full

end AspisR1.LiteralTypedContext

R1LiteralStageMessageCongr.text:
import R1LiteralOpeningStages

/-! The staged payload and committed-word readers depend on each transcript
entry's message component, not its challenge component. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralStageMessageCongr

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningStages
open AspisR1.InitialWalk
open AspisR1.OpeningRecordCodec

private theorem getElem_message_eq
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge)) (i : Nat)
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    (rs[i]?).map Prod.fst = (rs'[i]?).map Prod.fst := by
  have hget := congrArg (fun xs : List Message => xs[i]?) h
  simpa only [List.getElem?_map] using hget

theorem readAt_congr_messages {A : Type}
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge)) (i : Nat)
    (decode : Bytes → Option A)
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    readAt rs i decode = readAt rs' i decode := by
  have hm := getElem_message_eq rs rs' i h
  cases hleft : rs[i]? with
  | none =>
      have hright : rs'[i]? = none := by
        cases hcase : rs'[i]? with
        | none => rfl
        | some q => simp [hleft, hcase] at hm
      simp [readAt, hleft, hright]
  | some q =>
      cases hright : rs'[i]? with
      | none => simp [hleft, hright] at hm
      | some q' =>
          rcases q with ⟨m, c⟩
          rcases q' with ⟨m', c'⟩
          have hmsg : m = m' := by simpa [hleft, hright] using hm
          subst m'
          simp [readAt, hleft, hright]

theorem readGamma_congr_messages
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge))
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    readGamma rs = readGamma rs' := by
  unfold readGamma
  rw [readAt_congr_messages rs rs' 25 _ h,
    readAt_congr_messages rs rs' 26 _ h,
    readAt_congr_messages rs rs' 27 _ h]

theorem readKappa_congr_messages
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge))
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    readKappa rs = readKappa rs' := by
  unfold readKappa
  rw [readGamma_congr_messages rs rs' h,
    readAt_congr_messages rs rs' 28 _ h]

theorem readFirst_congr_messages
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge))
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    readFirst rs = readFirst rs' := by
  unfold readFirst
  rw [readKappa_congr_messages rs rs' h,
    readAt_congr_messages rs rs' 29 _ h]

theorem readSecond_congr_messages
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge))
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    readSecond rs = readSecond rs' := by
  unfold readSecond
  rw [readFirst_congr_messages rs rs' h,
    readAt_congr_messages rs rs' 30 _ h]

theorem vAt_congr_messages
    (rs rs' : List (Message × Challenge))
    (h : rs.map Prod.fst = rs'.map Prod.fst) :
    LiteralTranscript.vAt rs = LiteralTranscript.vAt rs' := by
  unfold LiteralTranscript.vAt
  have hm := getElem_message_eq rs rs' 30 h
  cases hleft : rs[30]? with
  | none =>
      have hright : rs'[30]? = none := by
        cases hcase : rs'[30]? with
        | none => rfl
        | some q => simp [hleft, hcase] at hm
      simp [hleft, hright]
  | some q =>
      cases hright : rs'[30]? with
      | none => simp [hleft, hright] at hm
      | some q' =>
          rcases q with ⟨m, c⟩
          rcases q' with ⟨m', c'⟩
          have hmsg : m = m' := by simpa [hleft, hright] using hm
          subst m'
          simp [hleft, hright]

#print axioms readAt_congr_messages
#print axioms readGamma_congr_messages
#print axioms readKappa_congr_messages
#print axioms readFirst_congr_messages
#print axioms readSecond_congr_messages
#print axioms vAt_congr_messages

end AspisR1.LiteralStageMessageCongr
end

import R1PublicByteCodec
import R1PublicIndexListCodec
import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! Agreement between the compositional public codec and the existing
variant-indexed public wire model. These are Lean representation equalities;
source-parser refinement remains separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PublicCodecAgreement

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

private theorem append_ofFn4 (lo hi : Fin 4 → Byte) :
    List.ofFn lo ++ List.ofFn hi =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 =>
        if h : i.val < 4 then lo ⟨i.val, h⟩ else hi ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hleft hright
    have hi8 : i < 8 := by simpa using hright
    by_cases h : i < 4 <;> simp [h]

theorem u64_emit_eq_index_encode (x : AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.Index) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.u64Codec.emit x =
      AspisR1.PublicIndexListCodec.encode x := by
  let halves := AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.u64Equiv.symm x
  have hsplit := append_ofFn4
    (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.1)
    (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.2)
  have hlow : halves.1.val = x.val % RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount := rfl
  have hhigh : halves.2.val = x.val / RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount := rfl
  change (List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.1) ++
      List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.2)) =
    List.ofFn (AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode x)
  rw [hsplit]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  by_cases h : i.val < 4
  · simp only [AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode, dif_pos h]
    change RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.1 ⟨i.val, h⟩ =
      RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE
        ⟨x.val % RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount, by
          exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount])⟩
        ⟨i.val, h⟩
    rfl
  · simp only [AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode, dif_neg h]
    change RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.2 ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩ =
      RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE
        ⟨x.val / RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount, by
          have hx := x.isLt
          norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount] at hx ⊢
          omega⟩
        ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩
    rfl

theorem encode_toPublic_eq_wire_encode (w : AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.Wire) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encode (AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic w) =
      some (AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.encode w) := by
  cases w with
  | transfer common recipient =>
      simp [AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encode,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicFieldsEquiv,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.toFields,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.fieldsCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.transport,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.pair,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.fixed,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.option,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.variantCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.digestCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.m31Codec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.frontierCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFields,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic_index_bound,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.encode,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.header,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes,
        u64_emit_eq_index_encode]
      rfl
  | withdrawal common amount =>
      simp [AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encode,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicFieldsEquiv,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.toFields,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.fieldsCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.transport,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.pair,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.fixed,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.option,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.variantCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.digestCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.m31Codec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.frontierCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFields,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic_index_bound,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.encode,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.header,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes,
        u64_emit_eq_index_encode]
      rfl

#print axioms u64_emit_eq_index_encode

import R1FunctionalWeights

/-! Materialize six functional rows and one base row from raw `K`-valued
coefficient vectors. This is a finite-dimensional algebra identity only; it
does not identify `raw` with any Rust constructor or semantic functional. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights

open scoped BigOperators
variable {K E : Type} [Field K] [Field E]

/-- Embed a raw coefficient row and evaluate it as an `E`-linear functional. -/
def rowMap {n : Nat} (iota : K →+* E) (w : Fin n → K) :
    (Fin n → E) →ₗ[E] E where
  toFun m := ∑ i : Fin n, m i * iota (w i)
  map_add' x y := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c x := by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

theorem rowMap_single {n : Nat} (iota : K →+* E) (w : Fin n → K)
    (i : Fin n) : rowMap iota w (Pi.single i (1 : E)) = iota (w i) := by
  classical
  change (∑ j : Fin n,
    ((Pi.single i (1 : E) : Fin n → E) j) * iota (w j)) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [Pi.single_apply]
  · intro j hj hji
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hji]
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

/-- The six nonconstant functionals are rows 1 through 6 of `raw`. -/
def rawFunctionals {n : Nat} (iota : K →+* E)
    (raw : Fin 7 → Fin n → K) :
    Fin 6 → (Fin n → E) →ₗ[E] E :=
  fun j => rowMap iota (raw ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩)

/-- The constant functional is row 0 of `raw`. -/
def rawBaseFunctional {n : Nat} (iota : K →+* E)
    (raw : Fin 7 → Fin n → K) : (Fin n → E) →ₗ[E] E :=
  rowMap iota (raw 0)

theorem weights_eq_raw_rows {n : Nat} (iota : K →+* E)
    (raw : Fin 7 → Fin n → K) (kappa : E) (i : Fin n) :
    AspisR1.FunctionalWeights.weights
        (rawFunctionals iota raw) (rawBaseFunctional iota raw) kappa i =
      ∑ k : Fin 7, kappa ^ k.val * iota (raw k i) := by
  simp [AspisR1.FunctionalWeights.weights,
    AspisR1.FunctionalWeights.weightedMap, rawFunctionals,
    rawBaseFunctional, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, rowMap_single, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

/-- `rowMap` is exactly the ordinary coefficient dot product after embedding. -/
theorem rowMap_eq_dot {n : Nat} (iota : K →+* E) (w : Fin n → K)
    (m : Fin n → E) :
    rowMap iota w m = AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot m (fun i => iota (w i)) := rfl

#print axioms rowMap_single
#print axioms weights_eq_raw_rows
#print axioms rowMap_eq_dot
end AspisR1.RawFunctionalWeights
end

import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Prod
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

/-! Abstract repeated-fibre projection and agreement descent.

This file proves only finite-set cardinality and a conditional algebraic
projection-descent lemma. Its encoder projection identity and agreement bound
are explicit hypotheses; a concrete E256 encoder instantiation is pending.
No protocol, decoder, privacy, or security theorem is claimed. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1

open scoped BigOperators

variable {V M N K : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Field K]

local instance : DecidableEq K := Classical.decEq K

/-- The repeated support comprises a complete four-lane fibre above each
base point in `S`. -/
def repeatedSupport (S : Finset V) : Finset (V × Fin 4) :=
  S.product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

theorem repeated_support_card (S : Finset V) :
    (repeatedSupport S).card = 4 * S.card := by
  calc
    (repeatedSupport S).card = S.card * 4 := by
      simp only [repeatedSupport, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    _ = 4 * S.card := Nat.mul_comm _ _

/-- A base support of size at least 2390 lifts to at least 9560 repeated
coordinates. -/
theorem repeated_support_card_ge_9560 (S : Finset V)
    (hS : 2390 ≤ S.card) :
    9560 ≤ (repeatedSupport S).card := by
  calc
    9560 = 4 * 2390 := by decide
    _ ≤ 4 * S.card := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hS
    _ = (repeatedSupport S).card := (repeated_support_card S).symm

/-- If the original encoding is constant on each complete fibre above `S`,
and the projection encoding is the fibre mean, then the two encodings agree
on the repeated support. -/
theorem repeated_projection_agrees_on_support
    (S : Finset V) (enc : M → V × Fin 4 → K) (project : M → M)
    (a : M) (g : V → K)
    (hfour : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s) = g v)
    (hmean : ∀ v j, enc (project a) (v, j) =
      (∑ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s)) / 4)
    (h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ p ∈ repeatedSupport S, enc a p = enc (project a) p := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨v, j⟩ hp
  simp only [repeatedSupport, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_product,
    Finset.mem_univ, and_true] at hp
  have hconstant : ∀ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s) = g v := hfour v hp
  have hsum : (∑ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s)) = (4 : K) * g v := by
    simp_rw [hconstant]
    simp
  calc
    enc a (v, j) = g v := hconstant j
    _ = ((4 : K) * g v) / 4 := by field_simp [h4]
    _ = enc (project a) (v, j) := by rw [← hsum, hmean]

/-- Complete four-lane agreement forces an element to equal its projection,
provided distinct messages have at most 255 agreement coordinates. -/
theorem repeated_lift_projection_descent
    (S : Finset V) (enc : M → V × Fin 4 → K) (project : M → M)
    (a : M) (g : V → K)
    (hfour : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s) = g v)
    (hmean : ∀ v j, enc (project a) (v, j) =
      (∑ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s)) / 4)
    (h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0)
    (hS : 64 ≤ S.card)
    (hoverlap : ∀ b c, b ≠ c →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V × Fin 4 => enc b p = enc c p)).card ≤ 255) :
    a = project a := by
  classical
  let agree : Finset (V × Fin 4) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun p => enc a p = enc (project a) p)
  have hsubset : repeatedSupport S ⊆ agree := by
    intro p hp
    change p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q : V × Fin 4 =>
      enc a q = enc (project a) q)
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact repeated_projection_agrees_on_support S enc project a g hfour hmean h4 p hp
  have hsupport : 256 ≤ (repeatedSupport S).card := by
    calc
      256 = 4 * 64 := by decide
      _ ≤ 4 * S.card := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hS
      _ = (repeatedSupport S).card := (repeated_support_card S).symm
  have hagree : 256 ≤ agree.card := by
    exact hsupport.trans (Finset.card_le_card hsubset)
  by_contra hne
  have hneq : a ≠ project a := by simpa using hne
  have hupper : agree.card ≤ 255 := by
    change (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V × Fin 4 =>
      enc a p = enc (project a) p)).card ≤ 255
    exact hoverlap a (project a) hneq
  have hlt : agree.card < 256 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hupper
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hagree) hlt

/-- If the projection is known to factor through a lift and a decoder, the
same conditional descent yields the corresponding lift-decoder identity. -/
theorem repeated_lift_descent_via_lift
    (S : Finset V) (enc : M → V × Fin 4 → K) (project : M → M)
    (a : M) (g : V → K)
    (hfour : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s) = g v)
    (hmean : ∀ v j, enc (project a) (v, j) =
      (∑ s : Fin 4, enc a (v, s)) / 4)
    (h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0)
    (hS : 64 ≤ S.card)
    (hoverlap : ∀ b c, b ≠ c →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V × Fin 4 => enc b p = enc c p)).card ≤ 255)
    (L : N → M) (D : M → N) (hfactor : project a = L (D a)) :
    a = L (D a) := by
  rw [← hfactor]
  exact repeated_lift_projection_descent S enc project a g hfour hmean h4 hS hoverlap

#print axioms repeated_support_card
#print axioms repeated_support_card_ge_9560
#print axioms repeated_projection_agrees_on_support
#print axioms repeated_lift_projection_descent
#print axioms repeated_lift_descent_via_lift

end AspisR1

end

import R1SamplerAddDigits
import R1SamplerArithmetic

/-! Connect the explicit digit-add recursion to positional modular arithmetic.
This is a Nat algorithm model; no Rust/fixed-width correspondence is asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerAddBridge
open AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits AspisR1.SamplerCarry

theorem digitsValue_lt_pow {p : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (digits : List Nat)
    (hcan : ∀ d ∈ digits, d < p) : digitsValue p digits < p ^ digits.length := by
  induction digits with
  | nil => simp [digitsValue]
  | cons d ds ih =>
    have hd : d < p := hcan d (by simp)
    have ht : digitsValue p ds < p ^ ds.length :=
      ih (fun a ha => hcan a (by simp [ha]))
    have hprod := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ht)
    simp only [List.length_cons, digitsValue, pow_succ]
    rw [Nat.mul_succ] at hprod
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (p ^ ds.length) p]
    omega

theorem addDigits_mod_div {p : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat) :
    digitsValue p (addDigits p addend digits).1 =
        (digitsValue p digits + addend) % p ^ digits.length ∧
      (addDigits p addend digits).2 =
        (digitsValue p digits + addend) / p ^ digits.length := by
  have hb := digitsValue_lt_pow hp (addDigits p addend digits).1
    (addDigits_output_digits_lt p addend digits hp)
  rw [addDigits_length] at hb
  have hv := addDigits_value_conservation p addend digits
  constructor
  · rw [← hv, Nat.add_mod]
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb]
  · rw [← hv, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (Nat.pow_pos hp)]
    simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hb]

/-- The source-shaped end-around carry algorithm at the level of lists of
natural-number digits. -/
def endAround (p q : Nat) (digits : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  let first := addDigits p (q + 1) digits
  if first.2 = 0 then first.1 else (addDigits p 1 first.1).1

theorem endAround_value {p q : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (digits : List Nat)
    (hcan : ∀ d ∈ digits, d < p)
    (hN : 2 ≤ p ^ digits.length) (hq : q < p ^ digits.length - 1) :
    digitsValue p (endAround p q digits) =
      carryResult (p ^ digits.length) q (digitsValue p digits) := by
  let N := p ^ digits.length
  let r := digitsValue p digits
  have hr : r < N := digitsValue_lt_pow hp digits hcan
  have hfirst := addDigits_mod_div hp (q + 1) digits
  have hsecond := addDigits_mod_div hp 1 (addDigits p (q + 1) digits).1
  rw [addDigits_length] at hsecond
  have hsum : r + q + 1 < 2 * N := by dsimp [N] at *; omega
  unfold endAround
  by_cases hs : r + q + 1 < N
  · have hzero : (addDigits p (q + 1) digits).2 = 0 := by
      rw [hfirst.2]
      exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by simpa [r, N, Nat.add_assoc] using hs)
    rw [if_pos hzero, hfirst.1]
    change (r + (q + 1)) % N = carryResult N q r
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    simp only [carryResult, if_pos hs]
    omega
  · have hge : N ≤ r + q + 1 := by omega
    have hnonzero : (addDigits p (q + 1) digits).2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hfirst.2]
      have hpos : 0 < (r + q + 1) / N := Nat.div_pos hge (by dsimp [N]; omega)
      simpa [r, N, Nat.add_assoc] using Nat.ne_of_gt hpos
    rw [if_neg hnonzero, hsecond.1, hfirst.1]
    change ((r + (q + 1)) % N + 1) % N = carryResult N q r
    have hsub : r + (q + 1) - N < N := by omega
    have hmod : (r + (q + 1)) % N = r + (q + 1) - N := by
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (by omega), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsub]
    rw [hmod]
    have hlast : r + (q + 1) - N + 1 < N := by
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using wrapped_result_lt hN hq hr hge
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlast]
    simp only [carryResult, if_neg hs]
    omega

#print axioms digitsValue_lt_pow
#print axioms addDigits_mod_div
#print axioms endAround_value
end AspisR1.SamplerAddBridge

import R1SamplerLongDivision
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Pure Nat model of a little-endian base-p digit carry pass. It does not
model mutation, fixed-width arithmetic, or Rust source operations. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits

/-- Little-endian positional value: the head digit is the least significant. -/
def digitsValue (p : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | digit :: digits => digit + p * digitsValue p digits

/-- Add an addend to the low-endian digit list, returning the final carry. -/
def addDigits (p addend : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat × Nat
  | [] => ([], addend)
  | digit :: digits =>
      let s := digit + addend
      let (out, carry) := addDigits p (s / p) digits
      (s % p :: out, carry)

theorem addDigits_length (p addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat) :
    (addDigits p addend digits).1.length = digits.length := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simp [addDigits]
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      simp [addDigits, ih]

theorem addDigits_value_conservation (p addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat) :
    digitsValue p (addDigits p addend digits).1 +
        p ^ digits.length * (addDigits p addend digits).2 =
      digitsValue p digits + addend := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simp [addDigits, digitsValue]
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      have hih := ih (addend := (digit + addend) / p)
      have hdivision : (digit + addend) % p + p * ((digit + addend) / p) =
          digit + addend := Nat.mod_add_div (digit + addend) p
      simp only [List.length_cons, addDigits, digitsValue]
      calc
        (digit + addend) % p +
              p * digitsValue p (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).1 +
              p ^ (digits.length + 1) * (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).2
            = (digit + addend) % p + p *
                (digitsValue p (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).1 +
                  p ^ digits.length * (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).2) := by
                rw [pow_succ]
                ring
        _ = (digit + addend) % p + p *
              (digitsValue p digits + (digit + addend) / p) := by rw [hih]
        _ = p * digitsValue p digits +
              ((digit + addend) % p + p * ((digit + addend) / p)) := by ring
        _ = p * digitsValue p digits + (digit + addend) := by rw [hdivision]
        _ = digitsValue p (digit :: digits) + addend := by
              simp [digitsValue]
              ring

theorem addDigits_output_digits_lt (p addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∀ digit ∈ (addDigits p addend digits).1, digit < p := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simp [addDigits]
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      intro outputDigit hmem
      simp only [addDigits, List.mem_cons] at hmem
      rcases hmem with hhead | htail
      · simpa [hhead] using Nat.mod_lt (digit + addend) hp
      · exact ih (addend := (digit + addend) / p) outputDigit htail

theorem final_carry_le_one_of_addend_le_one {p addend : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < p)
    (haddend : addend ≤ 1) :
    (addDigits p addend digits).2 ≤ 1 := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simpa [addDigits] using haddend
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      have hdigit : digit < p := hdigits digit (by simp)
      have hsum : digit + addend < 2 * p := by omega
      have hquot : (digit + addend) / p < 2 := by
        apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < p)).2
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hsum
      have hquot_le : (digit + addend) / p ≤ 1 := by omega
      have htail : ∀ x ∈ digits, x < p := by
        intro x hx
        exact hdigits x (by simp [hx])
      simpa [addDigits] using ih (addend := (digit + addend) / p) htail hquot_le

theorem final_carry_le_one_nonempty {p addend digit : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (haddend : addend < p) (hdigit : digit < p)
    (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ x ∈ digits, x < p) :
    (addDigits p addend (digit :: digits)).2 ≤ 1 := by
  have hsum : digit + addend < 2 * p := by omega
  have hquot : (digit + addend) / p < 2 := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < p)).2
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hsum
  have hquot_le : (digit + addend) / p ≤ 1 := by omega
  simpa [addDigits] using
    final_carry_le_one_of_addend_le_one hp digits hdigits hquot_le

#print axioms addDigits_length
#print axioms addDigits_value_conservation
#print axioms addDigits_output_digits_lt
#print axioms final_carry_le_one_of_addend_le_one
#print axioms final_carry_le_one_nonempty

end AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-! Arithmetic facts for a high-to-low base-radix long-division pass.
This file makes no claim about a Rust implementation, fixed-width machine
arithmetic, or a probability distribution. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision

/-- One long-division pass over a single radix digit. -/
def dividend (radix remainder digit : Nat) : Nat := remainder * radix + digit

theorem dividend_lt_mul {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (hremainder : remainder < divisor) (hdigit : digit < radix) :
    dividend radix remainder digit < divisor * radix := by
  dsimp [dividend]
  calc
    remainder * radix + digit < remainder * radix + radix :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left hdigit _
    _ = (remainder + 1) * radix := by rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
    _ ≤ divisor * radix :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right radix (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hremainder)

theorem quotient_lt_radix {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (hremainder : remainder < divisor) (hdigit : digit < radix) :
    dividend radix remainder digit / divisor < radix := by
  apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hdivisor).2
  have h := dividend_lt_mul hradix hdivisor hremainder hdigit
  simpa [dividend, Nat.mul_comm] using h

theorem remainder_lt_divisor {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat}
    (hdivisor : 0 < divisor) :
    dividend radix remainder digit % divisor < divisor :=
  Nat.mod_lt _ hdivisor

theorem dividend_eq_division {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat} :
    dividend radix remainder digit =
      divisor * (dividend radix remainder digit / divisor) +
        dividend radix remainder digit % divisor := by
  dsimp [dividend]
  simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using
    (Nat.mod_add_div (remainder * radix + digit) divisor).symm

/-- Accumulated quotient, current remainder, and the value of the processed
prefix. -/
structure State where
  quotient : Nat
  remainder : Nat
  processedValue : Nat
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def initialState : State := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Append one digit to the processed prefix and update the quotient/remainder. -/
def longDivisionStep (radix divisor : Nat) (state : State) (digit : Nat) : State :=
  let n := dividend radix state.remainder digit
  ⟨state.quotient * radix + n / divisor,
    n % divisor,
    state.processedValue * radix + digit⟩

theorem step_preserves_invariant {radix divisor : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (state : State) (digit : Nat)
    (hinvariant : state.processedValue =
      divisor * state.quotient + state.remainder)
    (hremainder : state.remainder < divisor)
    (hdigit : digit < radix) :
    let next := longDivisionStep radix divisor state digit
    next.processedValue = divisor * next.quotient + next.remainder ∧
      next.remainder < divisor := by
  dsimp [longDivisionStep]
  let n := dividend radix state.remainder digit
  have hdivision := dividend_eq_division (radix := radix) (divisor := divisor)
    (remainder := state.remainder) (digit := digit)
  have hdivision' : n = divisor * (n / divisor) + n % divisor := by
    simpa [n] using hdivision
  constructor
  · rw [hinvariant]
    calc
      (divisor * state.quotient + state.remainder) * radix + digit
          = divisor * state.quotient * radix + n := by
              dsimp [n, dividend]
              ring
      _ = divisor * state.quotient * radix +
            (divisor * (n / divisor) + n % divisor) :=
              congrArg (fun x => divisor * state.quotient * radix + x) hdivision'
      _ = divisor * (state.quotient * radix + n / divisor) + n % divisor := by ring
  · exact remainder_lt_divisor (radix := radix) (divisor := divisor)
      (remainder := state.remainder) (digit := digit) hdivisor

/-- Repeatedly process a digit list from its most-significant end. -/
def process (radix divisor : Nat) : State → List Nat → State
  | state, [] => state
  | state, digit :: digits =>
      process radix divisor (longDivisionStep radix divisor state digit) digits

theorem process_preserves_invariant {radix divisor : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (digits : List Nat) (state : State)
    (hinvariant : state.processedValue =
      divisor * state.quotient + state.remainder)
    (hremainder : state.remainder < divisor)
    (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < radix) :
    let finalState := process radix divisor state digits
    finalState.processedValue = divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder ∧
      finalState.remainder < divisor := by
  induction digits generalizing state with
  | nil =>
      simpa [process] using And.intro hinvariant hremainder
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      have hdigit : digit < radix := hdigits digit (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ x ∈ digits, x < radix := by
        intro x hx
        exact hdigits x (by simp [hx])
      have hstep := step_preserves_invariant hradix hdivisor state digit
        hinvariant hremainder hdigit
      simpa [process] using
        ih (state := longDivisionStep radix divisor state digit)
          hstep.1 hstep.2 htail

theorem initialState_process_correct {radix divisor : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < radix) :
    let finalState := process radix divisor initialState digits
    finalState.processedValue = divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder ∧
      finalState.remainder < divisor := by
  apply process_preserves_invariant hradix hdivisor digits initialState
  · rfl
  · exact hdivisor
  · exact hdigits

#print axioms dividend_lt_mul
#print axioms quotient_lt_radix
#print axioms dividend_eq_division
#print axioms step_preserves_invariant
#print axioms process_preserves_invariant
#print axioms initialState_process_correct

end AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision

import R1SamplerCarry
import R1SamplerDigits

/-! Composition of the repeated-digit and carry arithmetic models. These
identities do not identify a Rust loop, a fixed-width word, or a byte encoding.
The remaining quotient bound is explicit and is discharged separately for
the 256-bit input and eight M31 digits. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerArithmetic

open AspisR1.SamplerCarry AspisR1.SamplerDigits

/-- Arithmetic result before decoding the ordinary field tuple. -/
def ordinaryRank (p n x : Nat) : Nat := lowValue p n x

/-- Arithmetic result of adding the remaining quotient and applying the
single end-around carry used by the nonzero sampler. -/
def gammaRank (p n x : Nat) : Nat :=
  carryResult (p ^ n) (x / p ^ n) (lowValue p n x)

theorem ordinaryRank_eq_mod {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ordinaryRank p n x = x % p ^ n :=
  lowValue_eq_mod_pow hp

theorem gammaRank_eq_mod {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hN : 2 ≤ p ^ n) (hq : x / p ^ n < p ^ n - 1) :
    gammaRank p n x = x % (p ^ n - 1) + 1 ∧
      0 < gammaRank p n x ∧ gammaRank p n x < p ^ n := by
  have hdecomp : (x / p ^ n) * p ^ n + lowValue p n x = x := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm] using
      (lowValue_decomposition (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp).symm
  have h := carry_modular_identity hN hq
    (lowValue_lt_pow (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp)
  rw [hdecomp] at h
  exact h

/-- The extra increment in the carry branch cannot wrap again. -/
theorem gammaRank_no_second_wrap {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hN : 2 ≤ p ^ n) (hq : x / p ^ n < p ^ n - 1)
    (hwrap : p ^ n ≤ lowValue p n x + x / p ^ n + 1) :
    lowValue p n x + x / p ^ n + 1 - p ^ n + 1 < p ^ n :=
  wrapped_result_lt hN hq (lowValue_lt_pow hp) hwrap

#print axioms ordinaryRank_eq_mod
#print axioms gammaRank_eq_mod
#print axioms gammaRank_no_second_wrap

end AspisR1.SamplerArithmetic

import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Symbolic arithmetic for the sampler's conditional carry/reduction step.
These lemmas do not identify Rust digits or loop behavior, and make no
sampling, probability, or security claim. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerCarry

/-- The carry branch returns `s` below the limit and otherwise subtracts the
modulus and adds one. -/
def carryResult (N q r : Nat) : Nat :=
  let s := r + q + 1
  if s < N then s else s - N + 1

theorem carry_modular_identity {N q r : Nat}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hq : q < N - 1) (hr : r < N) :
    carryResult N q r = ((q * N + r) % (N - 1)) + 1 ∧
      0 < carryResult N q r ∧ carryResult N q r < N := by
  have hsum : q + r < 2 * (N - 1) := by omega
  have hmod : (q * N + r) % (N - 1) = (q + r) % (N - 1) := by
    have hN' : N = (N - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hprod : q * N = q * (N - 1) + q := by
      calc
        q * N = q * ((N - 1) + 1) := congrArg (fun x => q * x) hN'
        _ = q * (N - 1) + q := by rw [Nat.mul_add]; simp
    have hsumEq : q * N + r = q * (N - 1) + (q + r) := by
      rw [hprod]
      omega
    calc
      (q * N + r) % (N - 1) =
          (q * (N - 1) + (q + r)) % (N - 1) := by
        rw [hsumEq]
      _ = ((q * (N - 1)) % (N - 1) + (q + r) % (N - 1)) % (N - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_mod]
      _ = (q + r) % (N - 1) := by simp
  have hformula : carryResult N q r = ((q * N + r) % (N - 1)) + 1 := by
    dsimp [carryResult]
    by_cases hs : r + q + 1 < N
    · rw [if_pos hs, hmod]
      have hlt : q + r < N - 1 := by omega
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hs, hmod]
      have hge : N - 1 ≤ q + r := by omega
      have hsub_lt : q + r - (N - 1) < N - 1 := by omega
      have hsub_mod : (q + r) % (N - 1) = q + r - (N - 1) := by
        have hdecomp : q + r = (N - 1) + (q + r - (N - 1)) := by omega
        rw [hdecomp, Nat.add_mod]
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsub_lt]
      rw [hsub_mod]
      omega
  refine ⟨hformula, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hformula]
    omega
  · rw [hformula]
    have hmod_lt : (q * N + r) % (N - 1) < N - 1 :=
      Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    omega

/-- In the wrapped branch, subtracting the limit and then adding one still
leaves a value below `N`; there is no second carry. -/
theorem wrapped_result_lt {N q r : Nat}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hq : q < N - 1) (hr : r < N)
    (hwrap : N ≤ r + q + 1) :
    r + q + 1 - N + 1 < N := by
  have hsum : q + r < 2 * (N - 1) := by omega
  omega

#print axioms carry_modular_identity
#print axioms wrapped_result_lt

end AspisR1.SamplerCarry

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Symbolic base-`p` low-digit arithmetic.  These results do not identify a
Rust implementation, machine-word behavior, or a probability distribution. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerDigits

/-- The low `n` radix-`p` digits of `x`, defined by repeated quotient/remainder. -/
def lowValue (p : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, x => x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p)

theorem lowValue_decomposition {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    x = lowValue p n x + p ^ n * (x / p ^ n) := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [lowValue]
  | succ n ih =>
      change x = (x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p)) +
        p ^ (n + 1) * (x / p ^ (n + 1))
      have hdiv := ih (x := x / p)
      have hmod : x = x % p + p * (x / p) := by
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.mod_add_div x p).symm
      have hquot : (x / p) / p ^ n = x / (p ^ n * p) := by
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul x p (p ^ n))
      rw [hquot] at hdiv
      calc
        x = x % p + p * (x / p) := hmod
        _ = x % p + p * (lowValue p n (x / p) +
              p ^ n * (x / (p ^ n * p))) :=
                congrArg (fun y => x % p + p * y) hdiv
        _ = (x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p)) +
              p ^ (n + 1) * (x / p ^ (n + 1)) := by
                rw [Nat.pow_succ]
                rw [Nat.mul_comm (p ^ n) p]
                ring

theorem lowValue_lt_pow {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lowValue p n x < p ^ n := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [lowValue]
  | succ n ih =>
      change x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p) < p ^ (n + 1)
      have hmod : x % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ hp
      have hlow : lowValue p n (x / p) < p ^ n := ih (x := x / p)
      have hmod' : x % p + 1 ≤ p := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hmod
      have hprod : p * lowValue p n (x / p) + p ≤ p * p ^ n := by
        have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlow)
        rw [Nat.mul_succ] at h
        exact h
      calc
        x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p) < p * p ^ n := by omega
        _ = p ^ (n + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem lowValue_eq_mod_pow {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lowValue p n x = x % p ^ n := by
  have hdecomp := lowValue_decomposition (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp
  have hlow := lowValue_lt_pow (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp
  have hmod :
      (lowValue p n x + p ^ n * (x / p ^ n)) % p ^ n = lowValue p n x := by
    rw [Nat.add_mod]
    simp
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlow
  calc
    lowValue p n x =
        (lowValue p n x + p ^ n * (x / p ^ n)) % p ^ n := hmod.symm
    _ = x % p ^ n := (congrArg (fun y : Nat => y % p ^ n) hdecomp).symm

#print axioms lowValue_decomposition
#print axioms lowValue_lt_pow
#print axioms lowValue_eq_mod_pow

end AspisR1.SamplerDigits

import R1SamplerLongDivision
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Concrete Nat bounds for the sampler's chosen radix and modulus.
These lemmas do not identify Nat operations with Rust machine operations. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds

def P : Nat := 2^31 - 1
def B : Nat := 2^32

theorem P_pos : 0 < P := by norm_num [P]
theorem B_pos : 0 < B := by norm_num [B]

theorem P_times_B_lt_two63 : P * B < 2^63 := by norm_num [P, B]

/-- The multiply-add in one radix digit is strictly below the signed-bit
boundary, so it also fits in an unsigned 64-bit word. -/
theorem dividend_lt_two63 {r digit : Nat} (hr : r < P) (hdigit : digit < B) :
    r * B + digit < 2^63 := by
  have hstep := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.dividend_lt_mul
    (radix := B) (divisor := P) (remainder := r) (digit := digit)
    B_pos P_pos hr hdigit
  exact lt_trans hstep P_times_B_lt_two63

/-- One base-P long-division quotient is a single radix digit. -/
theorem dividend_quotient_lt_B {r digit : Nat} (hr : r < P) (hdigit : digit < B) :
    (r * B + digit) / P < B := by
  simpa [AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.dividend, B, P] using
    (AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.quotient_lt_radix
      (radix := B) (divisor := P) (remainder := r) (digit := digit)
      B_pos P_pos hr hdigit)

theorem dividend_remainder_lt_P {r digit : Nat} :
    (r * B + digit) % P < P := by
  simpa [AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.dividend, B, P] using
    (AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.remainder_lt_divisor
      (radix := B) (divisor := P) (remainder := r) (digit := digit) P_pos)

/-- Since a 256-bit input is less than 257 blocks of size P^8, its quotient
by P^8 is at most 256. -/
theorem rank_div_P8_le_256 {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2^256) : x / P^8 ≤ 256 := by
  have hP8 : 0 < P^8 := by norm_num [P]
  have h257 : x / P^8 < 257 := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hP8).2
    calc
      x < 2^256 := hx
      _ < 257 * P^8 := by norm_num [P]
  omega

theorem rank_quotient_plus_one_le_257 {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2^256) :
    x / P^8 + 1 ≤ 257 := by
  have h := rank_div_P8_le_256 hx
  omega

theorem two_le_P8 : 2 ≤ P^8 := by norm_num [P]

theorem rank_div_P8_lt_P8_sub_one {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2^256) :
    x / P^8 < P^8 - 1 := by
  have hquot := rank_div_P8_le_256 hx
  have hlarge : 257 < P^8 := by norm_num [P]
  omega

theorem two_fifty_seven_lt_P : 257 < P := by norm_num [P]

/-- A digit plus the largest accumulator addend still fits in one u32. -/
theorem digit_addend_lt_B {digit addend : Nat}
    (hdigit : digit < P) (haddend : addend ≤ 257) : digit + addend < B := by
  have hcap : P + 257 < B := by norm_num [P, B]
  omega

/-- Adding at most 257 to a base-P digit creates at most one carry. -/
theorem digit_addend_quotient_le_one {digit addend : Nat}
    (hdigit : digit < P) (haddend : addend ≤ 257) :
    (digit + addend) / P ≤ 1 := by
  have hP : 0 < P := P_pos
  have htwoP : digit + addend < 2 * P := by
    have hcap : P + 257 < 2 * P := by norm_num [P]
    omega
  have hquot : (digit + addend) / P < 2 := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hP).2
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using htwoP
  omega

/-- The ordinary subsequent carry addend is included in the general bound. -/
theorem digit_carry_quotient_le_one {digit carry : Nat}
    (hdigit : digit < P) (hcarry : carry ≤ 1) :
    (digit + carry) / P ≤ 1 := by
  apply digit_addend_quotient_le_one hdigit
  omega

#print axioms dividend_lt_two63
#print axioms dividend_quotient_lt_B
#print axioms dividend_remainder_lt_P
#print axioms rank_div_P8_le_256
#print axioms rank_quotient_plus_one_le_257
#print axioms two_le_P8
#print axioms rank_div_P8_lt_P8_sub_one
#print axioms two_fifty_seven_lt_P
#print axioms digit_addend_lt_B
#print axioms digit_addend_quotient_le_one
#print axioms digit_carry_quotient_le_one

end AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds

import R1SamplerLongDivision
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! The long-division state follows the high-to-low numeral fold.  The results
are arithmetic abstractions and do not identify any source implementation. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerPass

/-- The value of a high-to-low list of radix digits. -/
def numeral (radix : Nat) (digits : List Nat) : Nat :=
  digits.foldl (fun a d => a * radix + d) 0

theorem process_processedValue (radix divisor : Nat) (state : AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.State)
    (digits : List Nat) :
    (AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process radix divisor state digits).processedValue =
      digits.foldl (fun a d => a * radix + d) state.processedValue := by
  induction digits generalizing state with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      simpa [AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process,
        AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.longDivisionStep] using
        (ih (state := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.longDivisionStep
          radix divisor state digit))

theorem initialState_process_quotient_remainder
    {radix divisor : Nat} (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < radix) :
    let finalState := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process radix divisor
      AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
    finalState.quotient = numeral radix digits / divisor ∧
      finalState.remainder = numeral radix digits % divisor := by
  let finalState := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process radix divisor
    AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
  have hcorrect := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState_process_correct
    hradix hdivisor digits hdigits
  have hfold := process_processedValue radix divisor
    AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
  have hnum : numeral radix digits =
      divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder := by
    change numeral radix digits = divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder
    have hpv : finalState.processedValue = numeral radix digits := by
      simpa [finalState, numeral, AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState] using hfold
    rw [← hpv]
    exact hcorrect.1
  have hrem : finalState.remainder < divisor := hcorrect.2
  have hquotient : numeral radix digits / divisor = finalState.quotient := by
    apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
    · rw [hnum]
      calc
        finalState.quotient * divisor = divisor * finalState.quotient :=
          Nat.mul_comm _ _
        _ ≤ divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder := Nat.le_add_right _ _
    · rw [hnum]
      calc
        divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder <
            divisor * finalState.quotient + divisor :=
          Nat.add_lt_add_left hrem _
        _ = (finalState.quotient + 1) * divisor := by
          rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul, Nat.mul_comm finalState.quotient divisor]
  have hmod : numeral radix digits % divisor = finalState.remainder := by
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div (numeral radix digits) divisor
    rw [hquotient] at h
    conv_rhs at h => rw [hnum]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm divisor finalState.quotient] at h
    omega
  exact ⟨hquotient.symm, hmod.symm⟩

#print axioms process_processedValue
#print axioms initialState_process_quotient_remainder

end AspisR1.SamplerPass

import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerRanking

def digitsRank (p n : Nat) : (Fin n → Fin p) ≃ Fin (p ^ n) :=
  finFunctionFinEquiv

private theorem pow_pos_nat {p n : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) : 0 < p ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact Nat.mul_pos ih hp

theorem digitsRank_symm_apply_val {p n : Nat} (_hp : 0 < p)
    (x : Fin (p ^ n)) (i : Fin n) :
    ((digitsRank p n).symm x i).val = x.val / p ^ i.val % p := by
  simp [digitsRank]

theorem digitsRank_value {p n : Nat} (f : Fin n → Fin p) :
    (digitsRank p n f).val = ∑ i : Fin n, (f i).val * p ^ i.val := by
  exact finFunctionFinEquiv_apply f

def canonicalDigits (p n x : Nat) (hp : 0 < p) : Fin n → Fin p :=
  fun i => ⟨x / p ^ i.val % p, Nat.mod_lt _ hp⟩

theorem canonicalDigits_eq_rank_symm {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    canonicalDigits p n x hp =
      (digitsRank p n).symm ⟨x % p ^ n, Nat.mod_lt _ (pow_pos_nat hp)⟩ := by
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  change x / p ^ i.val % p = _
  rw [digitsRank_symm_apply_val hp]
  have hle : i.val ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt i.is_lt
  have hsum : i.val + (n - i.val) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hle
  have hpow : p ^ i.val * p ^ (n - i.val) = p ^ n := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_add, hsum]
  have hquot : x % p ^ n / p ^ i.val =
      x / p ^ i.val % p ^ (n - i.val) := by
    rw [← hpow]
    exact Nat.mod_mul_right_div_self x (p ^ i.val) (p ^ (n - i.val))
  have htail : 0 < n - i.val := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.is_lt
  have hdvd : p ∣ p ^ (n - i.val) := by
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt htail) with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [hk, pow_succ]
    exact ⟨p ^ k, by rw [Nat.mul_comm]⟩
  rw [hquot, Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ hdvd]

#print axioms digitsRank_symm_apply_val
#print axioms digitsRank_value
#print axioms canonicalDigits_eq_rank_symm

end AspisR1.SamplerRanking

import R1SemanticCandidateList
import R1SemanticHit
import R0P.MaskEarly
import R0P.MaskDensity

/-! Reuse only the first 25 masked semantic rows. The old classifier's
pre-C2 padding argument covers the literal R1 list without fixing H1/G
before lambda or chi. No old opening tail or Fiat--Shamir theorem is used.
Parsing, authenticated-word correspondence and absence of a prefix hit
remain explicit; this file does not give a shared-oracle probability law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPrefix
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.Mask R0P.SemRounds R0C.SemStatement Polynomial
open AspisCircleGroupOrder AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

attribute [local irreducible] AspisR0.ListsResponses.Lambda LambdaRows
  AspisR1.InitialResponses.Lambda ConcreteBinding.candidates

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) E]

theorem slice_zc (cs : List E) :
    semSlice (fun j : Fin 24 => cs.getD j.val 0) 3 10 =
      preZc (fun j : Fin 14 => cs.getD j.val 0) := by
  funext j
  simp only [semSlice, semPrefixVal, preZc, dif_pos (show 3 + j.val < 24 by omega)]

/-- One no-hit premise on the parsed semantic prefix supplies every exclusion
required by the R1 candidate-level semantic theorem. The prefix ends before
circle/opening rows, so the old five-row opening protocol is not assumed. -/
theorem outsideBad_of_prefix
    {S : Fin 29 → Subfield E} {F : Subfield E} (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : TypedContext E S) (htransport : x.transport = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    (fallback : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E)
    (rs : List (MsgZ E × ChalZ E)) (hlen : rs.length = 25)
    (cs : List E) (hparse : semChalsZ rs = some cs)
    (claim : E) (hclaim : claimOf rs = some claim)
    (polys : Fin 10 → E[X]) (hpolys : semPolysZ rs = some polys)
    (hdegree : ∀ j, (polys j).natDegree ≤ 27)
    (hw gw : InitialWord E) (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw, gw))
    (hno : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback (maskClaimsR0 B) B) x [] rs)
    (m : ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (hm : m ∈ ConcreteBinding.candidates (c2Words x hw gw)) :
    MaskedSemantic.OutsideBad x.pub B (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m)
      (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) (cs.getD 14 0) claim
      (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0) polys := by
  have ht : rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw) := by
    rw [htransport]
    exact SemanticCandidateList.rowsOf_candidate_mem_LambdaRows _ _ _ hm
  have hno' : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback (maskClaimsR0 B) B)
      x [] (rs ++ []) := by simpa only [List.append_nil] using hno
  have hearly := earlyRounds_cover (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) x.pub B
    (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0)
    (no_hit_early fallback (maskClaimsR0 B) B x rs [] hlen cs hparse hw gw hc2
      (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) ht hno')
  rw [slice_zc] at hearly
  have heta := no_hit_eta fallback (maskClaimsR0 B) B x rs [] hlen cs hparse
    claim hclaim hw gw hc2 (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) ht hno'
  have halpha := no_hit_alpha fallback (maskClaimsR0 B) B x rs [] hlen cs hparse
    claim hclaim polys hpolys hdegree hw gw hc2 (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) ht hno'
  rw [htransport] at heta halpha
  exact ⟨hearly.1, hearly.2.1, hearly.2.2.1, hearly.2.2.2, heta, halpha⟩

/-- Apply the prefix exclusions directly to the recovered opening witness.
Only the semantic classifier at each actual preceding prefix is excluded.
The C2 and transport equalities are model correspondence obligations, not
assumed semantic correctness of a candidate. -/
theorem large_matching_extracts_of_prefix
    (prime : Nat) [CharP E prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E) (F : Subfield E)
    (lanesF : ∀ l : Fin 29, l.val < 26 → S l = F) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : TypedContext E S) (htransport : x.transport = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    (pubTyped : PublicBase F x.pub)
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data E) (typed : CandidateDescent.WordTyped S d.W)
    (fallback : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point E)
    (rs : List (MsgZ E × ChalZ E)) (hlen : rs.length = 25)
    (cs : List E) (hparse : semChalsZ rs = some cs)
    (claim : E) (hclaim : claimOf rs = some claim)
    (polys : Fin 10 → E[X]) (hpolys : semPolysZ rs = some polys)
    (hw gw : InitialWord E) (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw, gw))
    (hwords : d.W = c2Words x hw gw)
    (hexcluded : ∀ i : Fin rs.length, ∀ sm,
      (rs[i.val]'i.isLt).1 = .semantic sm →
        ¬ semanticBadZ (maskClaimsR0 B) B ⟨x, rs.take i.val⟩ sm (cs.getD i.val 0))
    (inactive : Finset (Fin 1024)) (circle : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E)
    (hgood : MatchingSupport.Good
      (RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E)
        (SemanticOpening.rows inactive
          (SemanticTransport.points (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0))
          (SemSource.libraWeight (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0)) circle) d))
    (haccepted : MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing
      (RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E)
        (SemanticOpening.rows inactive
          (SemanticTransport.points (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0))
          (SemSource.libraWeight (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0)) circle) d))
    (hcard : 9558 ≤ (MatchingSupport.matchingSet
      (RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E)
        (SemanticOpening.rows inactive
          (SemanticTransport.points (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0))
          (SemSource.libraWeight (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0)) circle) d)).card)
    (checks : sumcheckChecksZ (maskClaimsR0 B) x.pub B
      (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) (cs.getD 14 0) claim
      (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0) polys
      (fun j l => d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l) (d.Y 3)) :
    ∃ m ∈ ConcreteBinding.candidates d.W,
      (ProductionHolds x.pub (cs.getD 0 0) (cs.getD 1 0) (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) ∧
        CopyLinkBalance x.pub (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m)) ∧
      InputNoteExtracted x.pub (rowsOf AspisR1.rowEquiv m) := by
  have hno := (SemanticHit.no_hitFrom_iff_all_semanticBadZ_excluded x fallback
    (maskClaimsR0 B) B rs cs hparse (by omega)).mpr hexcluded
  apply MaskedSemantic.large_matching_extracts prime hprime S F lanesF B x.pub
    pubTyped d typed inactive circle (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) (cs.getD 14 0)
    claim (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0) polys hgood haccepted hcard checks
  intro m hm
  rw [hwords] at hm
  exact outsideBad_of_prefix B x htransport fallback rs hlen cs hparse claim
    hclaim polys hpolys checks.1 hw gw hc2 hno m hm

#print axioms slice_zc
#print axioms outsideBad_of_prefix
#print axioms large_matching_extracts_of_prefix
end AspisR1.SemanticPrefix

import R1MaskedSemantic

/-! Deterministic set-membership bridge between the R1 tuple alias and the
existing R0 committed-word list. No probability or uniqueness premise is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SemanticCandidateList

open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) E]

/-- `ConcreteBinding.candidates` and the frozen R0 `Lambda` use the identical
38230 joint-agreement filter. -/
theorem candidate_mem_iff_old_Lambda
    (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord E) (m : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E) :
    m ∈ AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.candidates W ↔
      m ∈ AspisR0.ListsResponses.Lambda W := by
  change m ∈ AspisR1.InitialResponses.Lambda W ↔
    m ∈ AspisR0.ListsResponses.Lambda W
  rfl

#print axioms candidate_mem_iff_old_Lambda

attribute [local irreducible] AspisR1.InitialResponses.Lambda
  AspisR0.ListsResponses.Lambda R0P.SemSource.LambdaRows

/-- Reindex an R1 candidate tuple into R0's semantic row trace. -/
theorem rowsOf_candidate_mem_LambdaRows
    (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord E) (m : AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (hm : m ∈ AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.candidates W) :
    R0P.SemSource.rowsOf pi m ∈ R0P.SemSource.LambdaRows pi W := by
  apply (R0P.SemSource.mem_LambdaRows pi W (R0P.SemSource.rowsOf pi m)).mpr
  rw [R0P.SemSource.coeffsOf_rowsOf]
  exact (candidate_mem_iff_old_Lambda W m).mp hm

#print axioms rowsOf_candidate_mem_LambdaRows

end AspisR1.SemanticCandidateList

import R1SemanticTransport
import R0P.MaskSemantics
import R0P.MaskValue

/-! Candidate-level reuse of the existing masked semantic argument. All six
bad-event exclusions are explicit and quantified over the literal R1 list in
the extraction theorem. This does not assign their probability, implement a
transcript, identify Rust bytes, or prove privacy. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.MaskedSemantic
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.Mask R0P.Sumcheck Polynomial
open AspisCircleGroupOrder

variable {E : Type} [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) E]

/-- Exactly the candidate-level exclusions used by the old semantic core.
No semantic conclusion or opening claim is included in this predicate. -/
structure OutsideBad (pub : Public E) {F : Subfield E} (B : PackBasis F)
    (t : Trace E) (pre : Fin 14 → E) (eta claim : E)
    (alpha : Fin 10 → E) (polys : Fin 10 → E[X]) : Prop where
  logup : ¬ BadLogUp pub t (pre 0) (pre 1)
  theta : ¬ BadTheta (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B) (pre 2)
  zc : ¬ BadZc (lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B)) (preZc pre)
  mu : ¬ BadMu
    (mle 10 (lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B)) (preZc pre))
    (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
    (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
      (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b)))
    (pre 13)
  eta_safe : ¬ etaBad claim (maskTotal (maskClaimsR0 B) rowEquiv t)
    (originalTotal pub B t pre) eta
  alpha_safe : ¬ badAlpha 27 10
    (virtualPolyZ (maskClaimsR0 B) rowEquiv pub B t pre eta) polys alpha

/-- Instantiate the existing degree theorem with the concrete selected mask. -/
theorem concreteMaskDegree {F : Subfield E} (B : PackBasis F) :
    MaskDegree (maskClaimsR0 B) := by
  intro π t
  exact maskClaimsR0_vdeg B π t

/-- Reuse the masked sumcheck, eta, zerocheck, lane and LogUp theorems on
one typed candidate. The accepted checks still have to come from the verifier. -/
theorem candidate_semantics (prime : Nat) [CharP E prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31-1) (F : Subfield E) (B : PackBasis F)
    (pub : Public E) (t : Trace E) (typed : BaseTyped F t)
    (pubTyped : PublicBase F pub) (pre : Fin 14 → E) (eta claim : E)
    (alpha : Fin 10 → E) (polys : Fin 10 → E[X])
    (checks : sumcheckChecksZ (maskClaimsR0 B) pub B pre eta claim alpha polys
      (honestClaims t alpha) (honestExtra rowEquiv t alpha))
    (outside : OutsideBad pub B t pre eta claim alpha polys) :
    (ProductionHolds pub (pre 0) (pre 1) t ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub t) ∧
      InputNoteExtracted pub t := by
  have hacc := checksAcceptZ (maskClaimsR0 B) rowEquiv pub B t pre eta claim
    alpha polys checks
  have htotal := originalTotal_zero_of_masked_accept (maskClaimsR0 B)
    (concreteMaskDegree B) rowEquiv pub B t pre eta claim alpha polys hacc
    outside.alpha_safe outside.eta_safe
  have hprod := semantic_of_total_zero prime hprime F B pub t typed pubTyped
    pre htotal outside.logup outside.theta outside.zc outside.mu
  exact ⟨hprod, semantic_extraction pub t (pre 0) (pre 1) hprod
    (extraction_step pub (pre 0) (pre 1) t)⟩

/-- The R1 opening's actual candidate supplies the semantic witness. Universal
exclusions use the already bounded joint list; no unique candidate is assumed.
The conclusion is the existing input-note relation, not full spend security. -/
theorem large_matching_extracts (prime : Nat) [CharP E prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31-1) (S : Fin 29 → Subfield E)
    (F : Subfield E) (lanesF : ∀ l : Fin 29, l.val < 26 → S l = F)
    (B : PackBasis F) (pub : Public E) (pubTyped : PublicBase F pub)
    (d : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (typed : AspisR1.CandidateDescent.WordTyped S d.W)
    (inactive : Finset (Fin 1024)) (circle : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → E)
    (pre : Fin 14 → E) (eta claim : E) (alpha : Fin 10 → E)
    (polys : Fin 10 → E[X])
    (hgood : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.Good
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E)
        (AspisR1.SemanticOpening.rows inactive (SemanticTransport.points alpha)
          (SemSource.libraWeight alpha) circle) d))
    (haccepted : AspisR1.MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E)
        (AspisR1.SemanticOpening.rows inactive (SemanticTransport.points alpha)
          (SemSource.libraWeight alpha) circle) d))
    (hcard : 9558 ≤ (AspisR1.MatchingSupport.matchingSet
      (AspisR1.RawOpening.withRows (RingHom.id E)
        (AspisR1.SemanticOpening.rows inactive (SemanticTransport.points alpha)
          (SemSource.libraWeight alpha) circle) d)).card)
    (checks : sumcheckChecksZ (maskClaimsR0 B) pub B pre eta claim alpha polys
      (fun j l => d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l) (d.Y 3))
    (outside : ∀ m ∈ AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.candidates d.W,
      OutsideBad pub B (rowsOf rowEquiv m) pre eta claim alpha polys) :
    ∃ m ∈ AspisR1.ConcreteBinding.candidates d.W,
      (ProductionHolds pub (pre 0) (pre 1) (rowsOf rowEquiv m) ∧
        CopyLinkBalance pub (rowsOf rowEquiv m)) ∧
      InputNoteExtracted pub (rowsOf rowEquiv m) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := AspisR1.SemanticOpening.large_matching_implies_witness S d typed
    inactive (SemanticTransport.points alpha) (SemSource.libraWeight alpha) circle
    hgood haccepted hcard
  have hy := SemanticTransport.witness_point_claims S d alpha m hm
  have hx := SemanticTransport.witness_extra_claims S d alpha m hm
  have ht := SemanticTransport.witness_baseTyped S F lanesF d alpha m hm
  rw [hy, hx] at checks
  exact ⟨m, hm.1, candidate_semantics prime hprime F B pub (rowsOf rowEquiv m)
    ht pubTyped pre eta claim alpha polys checks (outside m hm.1)⟩

#print axioms concreteMaskDegree
#print axioms candidate_semantics
#print axioms large_matching_extracts
end AspisR1.MaskedSemantic
end

import R0P.MaskD2

/-! Masked semantic core. Sumcheck first identifies the masked Boolean sum;
the eta exclusion then recovers the original zero-sum claim. The remaining
zerocheck, lane and LogUp consequences are the ones used by SemD3.d3_core. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.Mask
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.Sumcheck Polynomial
noncomputable section
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Honest Boolean rows include the mask's literal Boolean-row value. -/
theorem honestRowsZ (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (pre : Fin 14 → K) (eta : K) (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    virtualPolyZ maskClaims π pub B t pre eta (ofBool b) = maskClaims (fun l => honestClaims t (ofBool b) 0 l) (honestExtra π t (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) + eta *
      (eqwB 10 (preZc pre) b * lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B) b +
        pre 13 * t 26 (rowOf b) + (pre 13)^2 *
          ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) := by
  unfold virtualPolyZ
  rw [honestRows pub B t pre b]

/-- The masked boundary, chain and terminal checks give recursive acceptance. -/
theorem checksAcceptZ (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (pre : Fin 14 → K) (eta claim : K) (alpha : Fin 10 → K)
    (polys : Fin 10 → K[X])
    (h : sumcheckChecksZ maskClaims pub B pre eta claim alpha polys (honestClaims t alpha) (honestExtra π t alpha)) :
    accept 27 10 (virtualPolyZ maskClaims π pub B t pre eta) claim polys alpha := by
  exact accept_of_checks 27 9 _ claim polys alpha h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2

/-- Neither the eta argument nor its zero-slope branch requires a property
of maskClaims. Its degree bound is used only by sumcheck soundness. -/
theorem originalTotal_zero_of_masked_accept (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (hMask : MaskDegree maskClaims) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (pre : Fin 14 → K) (eta claim : K)
    (alpha : Fin 10 → K) (polys : Fin 10 → K[X])
    (hacc : accept 27 10 (virtualPolyZ maskClaims π pub B t pre eta) claim polys alpha)
    (hAlpha : ¬ badAlpha 27 10 (virtualPolyZ maskClaims π pub B t pre eta) polys alpha)
    (hEta : ¬ etaBad claim (maskTotal maskClaims π t) (originalTotal pub B t pre) eta) :
    originalTotal pub B t pre = 0 := by
  have hsum : bsum 10 (virtualPolyZ maskClaims π pub B t pre eta) = claim := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hAlpha (sound 27 10 _ claim polys alpha
      (virtualPolyZ_indDeg maskClaims hMask π pub B t pre eta) hacc hne)
  rw [bsum_eq_bsumB, virtualPolyZ_total] at hsum
  by_contra hs
  exact hEta ⟨hs, hsum.symm⟩

/-- The part of the original semantic core after sumcheck: a zero Boolean
sum outside the four early bad families implies production and link balance. -/
theorem semantic_of_total_zero (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31-1) (F : Subfield K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (hA : BaseTyped F t) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (pre : Fin 14 → K)
    (hTotal : originalTotal pub B t pre = 0)
    (hlc : ¬ BadLogUp pub t (pre 0) (pre 1))
    (hTheta : ¬ BadTheta (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B) (pre 2))
    (hZc : ¬ BadZc (lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B)) (preZc pre))
    (hMu : ¬ BadMu
      (mle 10 (lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B)) (preZc pre))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
        (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) (pre 13)) :
    ProductionHolds pub (pre 0) (pre 1) t ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub t := by
  have he : (fun b => virtualPoly pub B t pre (ofBool b)) = fun b =>
      (eqwB 10 (preZc pre) b * lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B) b +
        pre 13 * t 26 (rowOf b)) + (pre 13)^2 *
        ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b)) := by
    funext b
    exact honestRows pub B t pre b
  unfold originalTotal at hTotal
  rw [he, bsumB_add, bsumB_add, bsumB_eqw, bsumB_smul, bsumB_smul] at hTotal
  have h3 : mle 10 (lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B)) (preZc pre) = 0 ∧
      bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)) = 0 ∧
      bsumB 10 (fun b =>
        (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b)) = 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    apply hMu
    exact ⟨by tauto, hTotal⟩
  obtain ⟨hm, h1, h2⟩ := h3
  have hcomp : ∀ b, lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B) b = 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hZc ⟨hc, hm⟩
  have hlanes : ∀ i b, laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B i b = 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hTheta ⟨hc, hcomp⟩
  have hprod : ProductionHolds pub (pre 0) (pre 1) t :=
    (lanes_zero_iff_holds F B pub (pre 0) (pre 1) t hA hpub).mp hlanes
  have hlogup : LogUpStep pub t (BadLogUp pub t) (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b))
      (fun b => (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b)) :=
    logup_step_of pub t (fun lam chi => logupL1 pub t lam chi)
      (fun lam chi => logupL2 pub t lam chi) (fun lam chi => logupL3 pub t lam chi)
      (fun lam => logupL4 prime hprime pub t lam) (logupL5 prime hprime pub t) _ _
      (lane_h1_sum t) (lane_inactive_sum t)
  exact ⟨hprod, hlogup (pre 0) (pre 1) hlc hprod.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 h1 h2⟩

#print axioms honestRowsZ
#print axioms checksAcceptZ
#print axioms originalTotal_zero_of_masked_accept
#print axioms semantic_of_total_zero
end
end R0P.Mask
