R0P.MaskEarly.text:
import R0P.MaskNoHit

/-! The first fourteen events are the frozen semantic events. C2 padding
and candidate membership are preserved before the inserted eta row. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.Mask
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.SemD3Glue R0C.SemStatement Polynomial R0P.Sumcheck
open R0P.SemRounds
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisR0.ListsResponses
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] Lambda LambdaRows
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem early_candidate_to_prefixZ {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K} {F : Subfield K}
    (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : TypedContext K Sfield)
    (rs : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K)) (hlen : rs.length = 25)
    (cs : List K) (hparse : semChalsZ rs = some cs)
    (hw gw : InitialWord K) (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw,gw))
    (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw)) (i : Fin 24) (hi : i.val < 14)
    (sm : SemMsgZ K) (hcurrent : (rs[i.val]'(by omega)).1 = .semantic sm)
    (hbad : candidateRoundBad x.pub B t (fun _ => 0) (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) i) :
    semanticBadZ maskClaims B ⟨x,rs.take i.val⟩ sm (cs.getD i.val 0) := by
  have htake : (rs.take i.val).length = i.val := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
  have hblen : (baseRoundsZ rs).length = 25 := by simp only [baseRoundsZ, List.length_map, hlen]
  have hbcur : ((baseRoundsZ rs)[i.val]'(by omega)).1 = .semantic (unmaskSem sm) := by
    simp only [baseRoundsZ, List.getElem_map, hcurrent, unmaskMsg]
  have hpre : (fun j : Fin i.val => (cs.take i.val).getD j.val 0) =
      semPrefix (fun j : Fin 24 => cs.getD j.val 0) i := by
    funext j
    exact getD_take_lt cs i.val j.val j.isLt
  have hfinish (u : Trace K)
      (hu : u ∈ candidates x (baseRoundsZ (rs.take i.val)) (unmaskSem sm))
      (hb : semRoundBad u x.pub B (fun pre => virtualPoly x.pub B u pre)
        (fixedStrat (polysOf (baseRoundsZ (rs.take i.val)) (unmaskSem sm))) i
        (semPrefix (fun j : Fin 24 => cs.getD j.val 0) i) (cs.getD i.val 0)) :
      semanticBadZ maskClaims B ⟨x,rs.take i.val⟩ sm (cs.getD i.val 0) := by
    constructor
    · intro h; change 15 ≤ (rs.take i.val).length at h; omega
    · rw [dif_pos (show (rs.take i.val).length < 14 by omega)]
      have hl : (baseRoundsZ (rs.take i.val)).length = i.val := by
        simp only [baseRoundsZ, List.length_map, htake]
      refine ⟨by change (baseRoundsZ (rs.take i.val)).length < 24; omega, cs.take i.val,
        (semChalsZ_base _).trans (semChalsZ_take rs cs hparse i.val), ?_, u, hu, ?_⟩
      · intro h; change 14 ≤ (baseRoundsZ (rs.take i.val)).length at h; omega
      · have lift (k : Fin 24) (he : k = i) :
            semRoundBad u x.pub B (fun pre => virtualPoly x.pub B u pre)
              (fixedStrat (polysOf (baseRoundsZ (rs.take i.val)) (unmaskSem sm))) k
              (fun j : Fin k.val => (cs.take i.val).getD j.val 0) (cs.getD i.val 0) := by
          subst k
          rw [hpre]
          exact hb
        exact lift _ (Fin.ext hl)
  by_cases hi2 : i.val < 2
  · apply hfinish (padC2Trace t)
    · have hmem := candidate_mem_before_c2N x (baseRoundsZ rs) 25 hblen hw gw t ht
        ⟨i.val,by omega⟩ hi2 (unmaskSem sm)
      simpa only [baseRoundsZ, List.map_take] using hmem
    · exact (semRoundBad_pad_early t x.pub B _ _ i _ _ hi2).mpr hbad
  · apply hfinish t
    · have hmem := candidate_mem_after_c2N x (baseRoundsZ rs) 25 hblen hw gw hc2 t ht
        ⟨i.val,by omega⟩ (by change 2 ≤ i.val; omega) (unmaskSem sm) hbcur
      simpa only [baseRoundsZ, List.map_take] using hmem
    · exact (semRoundBad_strat_early t x.pub B _ _ _ i _ _ hi).mpr hbad

#print axioms early_candidate_to_prefixZ

theorem no_hit_early {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K} {F : Subfield K}
    (fallback1 : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K) (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (rs tail : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K))
    (hlen : rs.length = 25) (cs : List K) (hparse : semChalsZ rs = some cs)
    (hw gw : InitialWord K) (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw,gw))
    (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw))
    (hno : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback1 maskClaims B) x [] (rs ++ tail)) :
    ∀ i : Fin 24, i.val < 14 →
      ¬ candidateRoundBad x.pub B t (fun _ => 0) (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) i := by
  intro i hi hb
  obtain ⟨sm,hslot⟩ := semSlotZ rs cs hparse ⟨i.val,by omega⟩
  have hbad := early_candidate_to_prefixZ maskClaims B x rs hlen cs hparse hw gw hc2 t ht i hi sm
    (congrArg Prod.fst hslot) hb
  apply no_hit_roundZ fallback1 maskClaims B x rs tail hno ⟨i.val,by omega⟩
  rw [hslot]
  apply Or.inl
  refine ⟨sm,cs.getD i.val 0,?_,rfl,rfl,hbad⟩
  change (rs.take i.val).length < 25
  simp only [List.length_take, hlen]
  omega

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semPrefixVal_actual (r : Fin 24 → K) (i : Fin 24)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < i.val) :
    semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) k = r ⟨k, hk.trans i.isLt⟩ := by
  simp only [semPrefixVal, dif_pos hk, semPrefix]
  rfl

#print axioms semPrefixVal_actual

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semSlice_actual (r : Fin 24 → K) (start len : Nat)
    (hbound : start + len ≤ 24) (j : Fin len) :
    semSlice r start len j = r ⟨start + j.val, by omega⟩ := by
  have hj : start + j.val < 24 := by omega
  simp only [semSlice, semPrefixVal, dif_pos hj]

#print axioms semSlice_actual

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semSlice_prefix_actual (r : Fin 24 → K) (i : Fin 24)
    (start len : Nat) (hbound : start + len ≤ i.val) :
    semSlice (semPrefix r i) start len = semSlice r start len := by
  funext j
  have hj : start + j.val < i.val := by omega
  have hj24 : start + j.val < 24 := hj.trans i.isLt
  simp only [semSlice, semPrefixVal, dif_pos hj, dif_pos hj24, semPrefix]
  rfl

#print axioms semSlice_prefix_actual

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semRoundBad_zero {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 0 (semPrefix r 0) x ↔ lambdaRoundBad pub t x := by
  simp [semRoundBad]

#print axioms semRoundBad_zero

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semRoundBad_one {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 1 (semPrefix r 1) x ↔ chiRoundBad pub t (r 0) x := by
  simp [semRoundBad, semPrefixVal, semPrefix]

#print axioms semRoundBad_one

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semRoundBad_two {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 2 (semPrefix r 2) x ↔
      BadTheta (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) x := by
  simp [semRoundBad, semPrefixVal, semPrefix]

#print axioms semRoundBad_two

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semRoundBad_zc {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (j : Fin 10) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩
        (semPrefix r ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩) x ↔
      zcRound 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B))
        j (zcPrefix (semSlice r 3 10) j) x := by
  let i : Fin 24 := ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩
  change semRoundBad t pub B G strat i (semPrefix r i) x ↔ _
  have h0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h1 : i.val ≠ 1 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h2 : i.val ≠ 2 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hz : i.val < 13 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hj : (⟨i.val - 3, by dsimp [i]; omega⟩ : Fin 10) = j := by
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [i]
    omega
  have hp0 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) 0 = r 0 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r i 0 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hp1 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) 1 = r 1 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r i 1 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hp2 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) 2 = r 2 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r i 2 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hslice : semSlice (semPrefix r i) 3 j.val = zcPrefix (semSlice r 3 10) j := by
    rw [semSlice_prefix_actual r i 3 j.val (by dsimp [i]; omega)]
    rfl
  simp only [semRoundBad, dif_neg h0, dif_neg h1, dif_neg h2, dif_pos hz,
    hp0, hp1, hp2]
  have hview := congrArg (fun k : Fin 10 =>
    zcRound 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B))
      k (semSlice (semPrefix r i) 3 k.val) x) hj
  rw [hslice] at hview
  exact Iff.of_eq hview

#print axioms semRoundBad_zc

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
private theorem semRoundBad_mu {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 13 (semPrefix r 13) x ↔
      BadMu
        (mle 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10))
        (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
        (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
          (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) x := by
  have h0 : (13 : Fin 24).val ≠ 0 := by omega
  have h1 : (13 : Fin 24).val ≠ 1 := by omega
  have h2 : (13 : Fin 24).val ≠ 2 := by omega
  have hz : ¬ (13 : Fin 24).val < 13 := by omega
  have hm : (13 : Fin 24).val = 13 := rfl
  have hp0 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r 13) 0 = r 0 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r 13 0 (by omega)
  have hp1 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r 13) 1 = r 1 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r 13 1 (by omega)
  have hp2 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r 13) 2 = r 2 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r 13 2 (by omega)
  have hslice := semSlice_prefix_actual r 13 3 10 (by omega)
  simp only [semRoundBad, dif_neg h0, dif_neg h1, dif_neg h2, dif_neg hz,
    dif_pos hm, hp0, hp1, hp2, hslice]

#print axioms semRoundBad_mu

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem earlyRounds_cover {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (r : Fin 24 → K)
    (hrounds : ∀ i, i.val < 14 → ¬ candidateRoundBad pub B t (fun _ => 0) r i) :
    (¬ BadLogUp pub t (r 0) (r 1)) ∧
    (¬ BadTheta (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) (r 2)) ∧
    (¬ BadZc (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10)) ∧
    (¬ BadMu
      (mle 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
        (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) (r 13)) := by
  let G := fun pre => virtualPoly pub B t pre
  let strat := fixedStrat (fun _ : Fin 10 => (0 : K[X]))
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro hb
    rcases (badLogUp_rounds_iff pub t (r 0) (r 1)).mp hb with hchi | hlam
    · exact hrounds 1 (by omega) ((semRoundBad_one t pub B G strat r (r 1)).mpr hchi)
    · exact hrounds 0 (by omega) ((semRoundBad_zero t pub B G strat r (r 0)).mpr hlam)
  · intro hb
    exact hrounds 2 (by omega) ((semRoundBad_two t pub B G strat r (r 2)).mpr hb)
  · rintro ⟨⟨b,hb⟩,hz⟩
    have hn : lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) ≠ 0 := by
      intro he; exact hb (congrFun he b)
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (zc_rounds_iff 10
      (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10)).mp ⟨hn,hz⟩
    rw [semSlice_actual r 3 10 (by omega) j] at hj
    exact hrounds ⟨3+j.val,by omega⟩ (by change 3+j.val < 14; omega) ((semRoundBad_zc t pub B G strat r j _).mpr hj)
  · intro hb
    exact hrounds 13 (by omega) ((semRoundBad_mu t pub B G strat r (r 13)).mpr hb)

#print axioms no_hit_early
#print axioms earlyRounds_cover

end
end R0P.Mask

R0P.MaskNoHit.text:
import R0P.MaskPrefix

/-! Absence of a masked classifier hit excludes eta and alpha events for
any candidate trace selected by the opening witness. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.Mask
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.SemD3Glue R0C.SemStatement Polynomial R0P.Sumcheck
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisR0.ListsResponses
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] Lambda LambdaRows
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem semSlotZ (rs : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K)) (cs : List K)
    (hp : semChalsZ rs = some cs) (i : Fin rs.length) :
    ∃ sm, rs[i.val] = (.semantic sm, .semantic (cs.getD i.val 0)) := by
  obtain ⟨sm,hs⟩ := semChalsZ_getElem rs cs hp i
  refine ⟨sm, ?_⟩
  have hi : i.val < cs.length := by rw [semChalsZ_length rs cs hp]; exact i.isLt
  simpa only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.getD_some] using hs

theorem no_hit_eta {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K} {F : Subfield K}
    (fallback1 : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K) (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (rs tail : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K))
    (hlen : rs.length = 25) (cs : List K) (hparse : semChalsZ rs = some cs)
    (claim : K) (hclaim : claimOf rs = some claim)
    (hw gw : InitialWord K) (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw,gw))
    (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw))
    (hno : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback1 maskClaims B) x [] (rs ++ tail)) :
    ¬ etaBad claim (maskTotal maskClaims x.transport t)
      (originalTotal x.pub B t (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0)) (cs.getD 14 0) := by
  intro hb
  have htlen : (rs.take 14).length = 14 := by simp only [List.length_take, hlen]; omega
  have hpre : (fun j : Fin 14 => (cs.take 14).getD j.val 0) = (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) := by
    funext j; exact getD_take_lt cs 14 j.val j.isLt
  obtain ⟨sm,hslot⟩ := semSlotZ rs cs hparse ⟨14,by omega⟩
  have hm := claimOf_getElem rs claim (by omega) hclaim
  rw [hslot] at hm
  have hsm : sm = .maskSum claim := Msg.semantic.inj hm
  subst sm
  apply no_hit_roundZ fallback1 maskClaims B x rs tail hno ⟨14,by omega⟩
  rw [hslot]
  apply Or.inl
  refine ⟨.maskSum claim, cs.getD 14 0, ?_, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  · change (rs.take 14).length < 25; omega
  · constructor
    · intro hh
      change 15 ≤ (rs.take 14).length at hh
      omega
    · simp only [htlen, show ¬ (14 : Nat) < 14 by omega,
        semChalsZ_take rs cs hparse 14, hpre]
      exact ⟨t, candidate_memZ x rs hw gw hc2 t ht 14 (by omega) (by omega), hb⟩

#print axioms semSlotZ
#print axioms no_hit_eta

theorem no_hit_alpha {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K} {F : Subfield K}
    (fallback1 : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K) (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (rs tail : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K))
    (hlen : rs.length = 25) (cs : List K) (hparse : semChalsZ rs = some cs)
    (claim : K) (hclaim : claimOf rs = some claim)
    (polys : Fin 10 → K[X]) (hpolys : semPolysZ rs = some polys)
    (hdegree : ∀ j, (polys j).natDegree ≤ 27)
    (hw gw : InitialWord K) (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw,gw))
    (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw))
    (hno : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback1 maskClaims B) x [] (rs ++ tail)) :
    ¬ badAlpha 27 10
      (virtualPolyZ maskClaims x.transport x.pub B t (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) (cs.getD 14 0))
      polys (fun j => cs.getD (15+j.val) 0) := by
  intro hb
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (badAlpha_iff_exists_round 27 10 _ polys _).mp hb
  let n := 15+j.val
  have hn : n < rs.length := by dsimp [n]; omega
  have htn : (rs.take n).length = n := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
  obtain ⟨sm,hslot⟩ := semSlotZ rs cs hparse ⟨n,hn⟩
  have hm := semPolysZ_getElem rs polys hlen hpolys j
  change (rs[n]'hn).1 = .semantic (.base (.roundPoly (polys j))) at hm
  rw [hslot] at hm
  have hsm : sm = .base (.roundPoly (polys j)) := Msg.semantic.inj hm
  subst sm
  have hpre : (fun k : Fin 14 => (cs.take n).getD k.val 0) = (fun k => cs.getD k.val 0) := by
    funext k; exact getD_take_lt cs n k.val (by dsimp [n]; omega)
  have heta : (cs.take n).getD 14 0 = cs.getD 14 0 := getD_take_lt cs n 14 (by dsimp [n]; omega)
  have hpref : (fun k : Fin j.val => (cs.take n).getD (15+k.val) 0) =
      alphaRoundPrefix (fun k : Fin 10 => cs.getD (15+k.val) 0) j := by
    funext k
    exact getD_take_lt cs n (15+k.val) (by dsimp [n]; omega)
  apply no_hit_roundZ fallback1 maskClaims B x rs tail hno ⟨n,hn⟩
  rw [hslot]
  apply Or.inl
  refine ⟨.base (.roundPoly (polys j)), cs.getD n 0, ?_, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  · change (rs.take n).length < 25; dsimp [n] at *; omega
  · constructor
    · intro _; exact hdegree j
    · have hparsepre := semChalsZ_take rs cs hparse n
      have hclaimpre := (claimOf_take rs n (by dsimp [n]; omega)).trans hclaim
      simp only [htn, show ¬ n < 14 by dsimp [n]; omega,
        show n ≠ 14 by dsimp [n]; omega, show n < 25 by dsimp [n]; omega,
        hparsepre, hclaimpre, hpre, heta, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte]
      have hidx : (⟨(rs.take n).length-15,by rw [htn]; dsimp [n]; omega⟩ : Fin 10) = j := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change (rs.take n).length - 15 = j.val
        rw [htn]
        exact Nat.add_sub_cancel_left 15 j.val
      refine ⟨t, candidate_memZ x rs hw gw hc2 t ht n (by dsimp [n]; omega) (by omega), ?_⟩
      have lift (k : Fin 10) (he : k = j) :
          alphaRound 27 10
            (virtualPolyZ maskClaims x.transport x.pub B t (fun k => cs.getD k.val 0) (cs.getD 14 0))
            (fun _ => polys j) k (fun l : Fin k.val => (cs.take n).getD (15+l.val) 0)
            (cs.getD n 0) := by
        subst k
        rw [hpref]
        exact hj
      exact lift _ hidx

#print axioms no_hit_alpha

end
end R0P.Mask
R0P.MaskNoHit.qualification: Unique source variant across located roots with adjacent hash-matched historical selected objects. Original source receipt not independently established; fresh replay required.

R0P.MaskPrefix.text:
import R0P.MaskSource
import R0P.MaskSemantics

/-! Symbolic prefix lemmas for the inserted eta row. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.Mask
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.SemD3Glue R0C.SemStatement Polynomial
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisR0.ListsResponses
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] Lambda LambdaRows
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem candidate_mem_after_c2N {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}
    (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (rs : List (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K))
    (n : Nat) (hlen : rs.length = n) (hw gw : InitialWord K) (hc2 : c2Of rs = some (hw,gw))
    (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw))
    (i : Fin n) (hi : 2 ≤ i.val) (sm : SemMsg K)
    (hcurrent : (rs[i.val]'(by omega)).1 = .semantic sm) :
    t ∈ candidates x (rs.take i.val) sm := by
  have htake : (rs.take i.val).length = i.val := by simp only [List.length_take, hlen]; omega
  by_cases hi2 : i.val = 2
  · have hm := c2Of_getElem rs hw gw (by omega) hc2
    have hcurrent' : (rs[2]'(by omega)).1 = .semantic sm := by simpa only [hi2] using hcurrent
    rw [hcurrent'] at hm
    have hsm : sm = .h1 hw gw := Msg.semantic.inj hm
    unfold candidates
    rw [htake, if_neg (by omega), if_pos hi2, hsm]
    exact ht
  · have hc2' : c2Of (rs.take i.val) = some (hw,gw) := (c2Of_take rs i.val (by omega)).trans hc2
    simp only [candidates, htake, show ¬ i.val < 2 by omega, if_false, hi2, hc2']
    exact ht

#print axioms candidate_mem_after_c2N

/-- Padding supplies the pre-C2 candidate without fixing C2 before lambda. -/
theorem candidate_mem_before_c2N {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}
    (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (rs : List (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K))
    (n : Nat) (hlen : rs.length = n) (hw gw : InitialWord K)
    (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw))
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < 2) (sm : SemMsg K) :
    padC2Trace t ∈ candidates x (rs.take i.val) sm := by
  have htake : (rs.take i.val).length = i.val := by simp only [List.length_take, hlen]; omega
  have hne : (26 : Fin 29) ≠ 27 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    change 26 = 27 at hv
    omega
  have h26 : padC2Trace t 26 = 0 := by
    simp only [padC2Trace, Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self]
  have h27 : padC2Trace t 27 = 0 := by simp only [padC2Trace, Function.update_self]
  simp only [candidates, htake, if_pos hi, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨mem_Lambda_pad x hw gw t ht, h26, h27⟩

#print axioms candidate_mem_before_c2N


omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem getD_take_lt (cs : List K) (n k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    (cs.take n).getD k 0 = cs.getD k 0 := by
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take_of_lt hk]

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem semPolysZ_getElem (rs : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K)) (polys : Fin 10 → K[X])
    (hlen : rs.length = 25) (hp : semPolysZ rs = some polys) (j : Fin 10) :
    (rs[15 + j.val]'(by omega)).1 = .semantic (.base (.roundPoly (polys j))) := by
  simp only [semPolysZ, dif_pos hlen] at hp
  split at hp
  · rename_i hall
    have hv := congrFun (Option.some.inj hp) j
    have hj := hall j
    cases hm : (rs[15 + j.val]'(by omega)).1 with
    | semantic sm =>
      cases sm with
      | base m =>
        cases m with
        | roundPoly p =>
          simp [hm] at hv
          rw [hv]
        | none => simp [hm] at hj
        | h1 h g => simp [hm] at hj
      | maskSum c => simp [hm] at hj
    | beforeZ0 y => simp [hm] at hj
    | beforeZ1 y => simp [hm] at hj
    | opening om => simp [hm] at hj
  · simp at hp

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem claimOf_getElem (rs : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K)) (claim : K)
    (hlen : 14 < rs.length) (hp : claimOf rs = some claim) :
    (rs[14]'hlen).1 = .semantic (.maskSum claim) := by
  rcases he : rs[14]'hlen with ⟨m,c⟩
  simp only [claimOf, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlen, he] at hp
  cases m with
  | semantic sm =>
    cases sm with
    | base m => cases hp
    | maskSum a =>
      have ha := Option.some.inj hp
      subst a
      rfl
  | beforeZ0 y => cases hp
  | beforeZ1 y => cases hp
  | opening om => cases hp

theorem no_hit_roundZ {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K} {F : Subfield K}
    (fallback1 : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K) (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 29 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (rs tail : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K))
    (hno : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback1 maskClaims B) x [] (rs ++ tail))
    (i : Fin rs.length) :
    ¬ roundBad (sourceDataWithFallbackZ fallback1 maskClaims B) ⟨x,rs.take i.val⟩
      (rs[i.val]).1 (rs[i.val]).2 := by
  intro hb
  apply hno
  apply roundBadZ_hitFrom _ x (rs ++ tail) [] i.val (by simp only [List.length_append]; omega)
  rw [List.nil_append, List.take_append_of_le_length (by omega), List.getElem_append_left i.isLt]
  exact hb

theorem candidate_memZ {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K} (x : TypedContext K Sfield)
    (rs : List (MsgZ K × ChalZ K)) (hw gw : InitialWord K)
    (hc2 : c2OfZ rs = some (hw,gw)) (t : Trace K) (ht : t ∈ LambdaRows x.transport (c2Words x hw gw))
    (n : Nat) (hn : 2 < n) (hnlen : n ≤ rs.length) :
    t ∈ candidates x (baseRoundsZ (rs.take n)) .none := by
  have hc : c2Of (baseRoundsZ (rs.take n)) = some (hw,gw) :=
    (c2OfZ_take rs n hn).trans hc2
  have hl : (baseRoundsZ (rs.take n)).length = n := by
    simp only [baseRoundsZ, List.length_map, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hnlen]
  simp only [candidates, hl, if_neg (show ¬ n < 2 by omega), if_neg (show n ≠ 2 by omega), hc]
  exact ht

#print axioms getD_take_lt
#print axioms semPolysZ_getElem
#print axioms claimOf_getElem
#print axioms no_hit_roundZ
#print axioms candidate_memZ

end
end R0P.Mask

import R1SpendRelation
import R1InputWitness
import R1SpendSemantics
import R1AppendSemantics

/-! Reuse the existing production-trace witness facts for the explicit spend
relation. This existential bridge does not implement the list decoder, field
descent, or the full-log efficient extractor. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelationExtraction

open R0P SpendRelation
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation nodeCompress merkleRoot

/-- The production gates bind the public post-state root and carry cell to
the append pair. The pair is recovered from the canonical public variant. -/
theorem append_of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31 - 1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    SpendRelation.AppendBinding pub := by
  have hg := AppendSemantics.of_production prime hprime pub A lam chi h
  refine ⟨OutputNotes.output A 33, ?_, hg.root, hg.carry⟩
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      obtain ⟨recipient, hr, _⟩ :=
        PublicOptionShape.private_transfer_shape pub hv hshape
      rw [SpendRelation.outputPair, hv, hr]
      exact congrArg some (hg.transferPair hv recipient hr).symm
  | withdrawal =>
      rw [SpendRelation.outputPair, hv]
      exact congrArg some (hg.withdrawalPair hv).symm

theorem of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31 - 1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    ∃ w : Witness K, Rspend pub w := by
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2, h0, h1, h2, hbalance, e0, e1, e2, hinput⟩ :=
    InputWitness.bounded_of_production prime hprime pub A lam chi h
  have hfacts := SpendSemantics.of_production prime hprime pub A lam chi h
  let w : Witness K :=
    { inputValue := ⟨v0, h0⟩
      outputValue := ⟨v1, h1⟩
      changeValue := ⟨v2, h2⟩
      sk := traceSk A
      salt := traceSalt A
      path := tracePath A
      pair := InputPair.leaf A
      recipientOwner := OutputNotes.chunk A 27
      recipientSalt := OutputNotes.salt A 28 29
      changeOwner := OutputNotes.chunk A 30
      changeSalt := OutputNotes.salt A 31 32 }
  refine ⟨w, hshape, hinput, hbalance, ?_, ?_,
    append_of_production prime hprime pub A lam chi hshape h⟩
  · simpa only [changeCommitment, w, e2] using hfacts.change
  · cases hv : pub.variant with
    | privateTransfer =>
        obtain ⟨recipient, hr, _⟩ :=
          PublicOptionShape.private_transfer_shape pub hv hshape
        change variantOutput pub w
        rw [variantOutput, hv]
        rw [hr]
        apply congrArg some
        simpa only [recipientCommitment, w, e1] using hfacts.recipient hv recipient hr
    | withdrawal =>
        obtain ⟨amount, _, ha, _⟩ := PublicOptionShape.withdrawal_shape pub hv hshape
        change variantOutput pub w
        rw [variantOutput, hv]
        rw [ha]
        apply congrArg some
        exact (hfacts.withdrawal hv amount ha).symm.trans e1

#print axioms of_production
#print axioms append_of_production
end AspisR1.SpendRelationExtraction

R1InputWitness.text:
import R1InputWitnessCore
import R0P.Extraction

/-! Concrete ownership/nullifier/membership and occupied-pair witnesses,
all read from the same production trace. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputWitness
open R0P InputWitnessCore
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] nodeCompress poseidonPermutation merkleRoot

theorem of_production (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    Relation pub (A 10 1008) (traceSk A) (traceSalt A) (tracePath A) (InputPair.leaf A) := by
  have hn := input_note_trace_witness pub A h.1.2.2.2.1 h.1.2.2.2.2.1
    h.1.2.2.2.2.2.1 h.1.2.2.1 h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 h.2
  have hp := InputPairSelection.of_production pub A lam chi h
  exact ⟨hp.valid, hp.spendable, hp.selected.trans hn.2.2,
    trace_sibling pub A h.2, hn.1, hn.2.1⟩

/-- The bounded natural values and integer conservation come from the
existing value theorem; the input relation uses that exact natural value. -/
theorem bounded_of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2 ^ 31 - 1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    ∃ v0 v1 v2 : Nat,
      v0 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v1 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v2 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v0 = v1 + v2 ∧
      A 10 1008 = (v0 : K) ∧ A 10 1010 = (v1 : K) ∧ A 10 1012 = (v2 : K) ∧
      Relation pub (v0 : K) (traceSk A) (traceSalt A) (tracePath A) (InputPair.leaf A) := by
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2, h0, h1, h2, hb, e0, e1, e2⟩ :=
    SpendValues.of_value_balance prime hprime pub A h.1.1 h.2
  refine ⟨v0, v1, v2, h0, h1, h2, hb, e0, e1, e2, ?_⟩
  rw [← e0]
  exact of_production pub A lam chi h

#print axioms of_production
#print axioms bounded_of_production
end AspisR1.InputWitness

R1AppendSemantics.text:
import R1AppendPath
import R1AppendPair
import R1SpendSemantics

/-! Deterministic note and literal append-path facts from production gates.
Non-carry frontier cells are a separate public-prevalidation premise. The
table recurrence, chronological frontier invariant, actual public codec and
verifier source, shared-oracle law, and privacy remain outside this result. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendSemantics
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The frontier portion of the host's public `validate_transition` guard.
It contains neither the root nor the carry-node equality proved by the gates. -/
def NonCarryShape (pub : Public K) : Prop :=
  ∀ level : Fin 20, level.val ≠ digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex →
    pub.nextFrontier level =
      if level.val < digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex ∨ digestBitZero pub level
      then AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc else pub.snapshotFrontier level

def expectedFrontier (pub : Public K) (pair : Digest K) (level : Fin 20) : Digest K :=
  if level.val = digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex
  then AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair level.val
  else if level.val < digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex ∨ digestBitZero pub level
  then AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc else pub.snapshotFrontier level

theorem complete_frontier (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hshape : NonCarryShape pub) :
    pub.nextFrontier = expectedFrontier pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) := by
  funext level
  unfold expectedFrontier
  by_cases he : level.val = digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex
  · rw [if_pos he]
    have hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20 := by omega
    have hi : level = ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩ := Fin.ext he
    rw [hi]
    exact AppendPath.next_frontier_carry prime hprime pub A hs hd hpo hb hc
  · rw [if_neg he]
    exact hshape level he

structure GateFacts (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) : Prop where
  notes : SpendSemantics.NoteFacts pub A
  pairValid : (AppendPair.leaf A).Valid
  root : pub.nextRoot = AppendPath.pathPrefix pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) 20
  carry : ∀ hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20,
    pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
      AppendPath.pathPrefix pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)
  transferPair : pub.variant = .privateTransfer → ∀ recipient : Digest K,
    pub.recipient = some recipient → OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress recipient pub.change
  withdrawalPair : pub.variant = .withdrawal →
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress pub.change (fun _ => 0)

theorem of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) : GateFacts pub A := by
  have ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A := h.1.2.1
  have hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.1
  have hd : Holds digestFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  exact ⟨SpendSemantics.of_production prime hprime pub A lam chi h,
    AppendPair.leaf_valid pub A ho,
    AppendPath.next_root prime hprime pub A hs hd hpo h.2,
    AppendPath.next_frontier_carry prime hprime pub A hs hd hpo h.2,
    fun hv recipient hp => AppendPair.transfer_output pub A hs hpo h.2 hd hv recipient hp,
    fun hv => AppendPair.withdrawal_output pub A hs hpo h.2 hd ho hv⟩

/-- Full literal public root/frontier binding, retaining the host-precheck
premise and allowing carry=20 at the last insertion. It is not yet a theorem
equating this recurrence to a chronological Merkle tree. -/
theorem afterstate_of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31-1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hshape : NonCarryShape pub) :
    GateFacts pub A ∧ pub.nextFrontier = expectedFrontier pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) := by
  exact ⟨of_production prime hprime pub A lam chi h,
    complete_frontier prime hprime pub A h.1.2.2.2.1 h.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
      h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 h.2 hshape⟩

#print axioms complete_frontier
#print axioms of_production
#print axioms afterstate_of_production
end AspisR1.AppendSemantics

R1SpendRelationMap.text:
import R1SpendDataMap
import R1NoteHashMap
import R1AppendBindingMap

/-! Ring-hom transport for the complete spend relation. This is a coordinate
embedding equivalence for already mapped witnesses; it does not claim that
arbitrary projections preserve witness validity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelationMap

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]

private theorem map_eq_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x y : K) : f x = f y ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hf h
  · intro h
    exact congrArg f h

private theorem map_zero_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x : K) : f x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  rw [← map_zero f]
  exact map_eq_iff f hf x 0

private theorem digest_injective (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact hf (congrFun h i)

private theorem pair_valid_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : PairLeaf K) : (SpendDataMap.pair f p).Valid ↔ p.Valid := by
  rcases p with ⟨firstCommitment, secondOccupied, secondCommitment,
    secondOccupancyInverse⟩
  change
    (f secondOccupied * (f secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
      f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩) * f secondOccupancyInverse =
        f secondOccupied ∧
      (1 - f secondOccupied) * f secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane, (1 - f secondOccupied) * f (secondCommitment lane) = 0) ↔
    (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
      secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse = secondOccupied ∧
      (1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane, (1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane = 0)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h1' : f (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1)) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h1
    have h2' : f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse) =
        f secondOccupied := by simpa [map_mul] using h2
    have h3' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h3
    refine ⟨(map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h1', (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h2',
      (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h3', ?_⟩
    intro lane
    have h4' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h4 lane
    exact (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h4'
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h1' : f (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1)) = f 0 := congrArg f h1
    have h2' : f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse) =
        f secondOccupied := congrArg f h2
    have h3' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse) = f 0 := congrArg f h3
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h1'
    · simpa [map_mul] using h2'
    · simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h3'
    · intro lane
      have h4' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane) = f 0 :=
        congrArg f (h4 lane)
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h4'

private theorem pair_spendable_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : PairLeaf K) (b : Bool) :
    (SpendDataMap.pair f p).SelectedSlotIsSpendable b ↔
      p.SelectedSlotIsSpendable b := by
  cases b with
  | false => simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied,
      SpendDataMap.pair]
  | true =>
      change f p.secondOccupied = 1 ↔ p.secondOccupied = 1
      rw [← map_one f]
      exact map_eq_iff f hf _ _

theorem canonical_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) :
    PublicOptionShape.canonical (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) ↔
      PublicOptionShape.canonical pub := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;> cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [PublicOptionShape.canonical, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr, ha,
          map_zero_iff f hf]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;> cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [PublicOptionShape.canonical, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr, ha,
          map_zero_iff f hf]

private theorem map_digest_noteCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pk : R0P.Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) =
      noteCommitment (SpendDataMap.digest f pk) (f value)
        (f asset) (SpendDataMap.digest f salt) := by
  change PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) = _
  exact NoteHashMap.map_noteCommitment f pk value asset salt

private theorem map_digest_ownerKey (f : K →+* L) (sk : R0P.Digest K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (SpendDataMap.digest f sk) := by
  change PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (ownerKey sk) = _
  exact NoteHashMap.map_ownerKey f sk

private theorem map_digest_nullifier (f : K →+* L)
    (sk salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (nullifierHash sk salt) =
      nullifierHash (SpendDataMap.digest f sk) (SpendDataMap.digest f salt) := by
  change PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (nullifierHash sk salt) = _
  exact NoteHashMap.map_nullifierHash f sk salt

private theorem map_digest_merkleRoot (f : K →+* L) (leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (SpendDataMap.digest f leaf) (SpendDataMap.path f path) := by
  change PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
    merkleRoot (PoseidonMap.mapDigest f leaf) (NoteHashMap.mapPath f path)
  exact NoteHashMap.map_merkleRoot f leaf path

private theorem relation_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K) :
    InputWitnessCore.Relation (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (f value)
      (SpendDataMap.digest f sk) (SpendDataMap.digest f salt)
      (SpendDataMap.path f path) (SpendDataMap.pair f pair) ↔
    InputWitnessCore.Relation pub value sk salt path pair := by
  let d := SpendDataMap.digest f
  have howner : d (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (d sk) := by
    simpa [d] using map_digest_ownerKey f sk
  have hnote : d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) =
      noteCommitment (d (ownerKey sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) := by
    simpa [d] using map_digest_noteCommitment f (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt
  have hroot : ∀ leaf, d (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (d leaf) (SpendDataMap.path f path) := by
    intro leaf
    simpa [d] using map_digest_merkleRoot f leaf path
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcommitMap : d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
      calc
        d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
            (SpendDataMap.pair f pair).selectedCommitment (path 0).1 := by
              cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
        _ = noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) := h.commitment
        _ = d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
              rw [← howner]
              exact hnote.symm
    have hsiblingMap : d ((path 0).2) =
        d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) := by
      cases hb : (path 0).1 <;>
        simpa [d, SpendDataMap.path, SpendDataMap.pair, hb] using h.sibling
    have hnullifierMap : d pub.nullifier = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := by
      calc
        d pub.nullifier = (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nullifier := rfl
        _ = nullifierHash (d sk) (d salt) := h.nullifier
        _ = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := (map_digest_nullifier f sk salt).symm
    have hmembershipMap : d pub.anchor = d (merkleRoot
        (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) := by
      calc
        d pub.anchor = (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).anchor := rfl
        _ = merkleRoot
              (noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt))
              (SpendDataMap.path f path) := h.membership
        _ = merkleRoot (d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt))
              (SpendDataMap.path f path) := by rw [← howner, hnote.symm]
        _ = d (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) :=
              (hroot _).symm
    refine ⟨(pair_valid_map_iff f hf pair).mp h.valid,
      (pair_spendable_map_iff f hf pair (path 0).1).mp h.spendable,
      (digest_injective f hf hcommitMap), ?_,
      digest_injective f hf hnullifierMap,
      digest_injective f hf hmembershipMap⟩
    exact digest_injective f hf hsiblingMap
  · intro h
    have hcommitMap : d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := congrArg d h.commitment
    have hsiblingMap : d ((path 0).2) =
        d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) :=
      congrArg d h.sibling
    have hnullifierMap : d pub.nullifier = d (nullifierHash sk salt) :=
      congrArg d h.nullifier
    have hmembershipMap : d pub.anchor = d (merkleRoot
        (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) :=
      congrArg d h.membership
    have hmappedNote : noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
      rw [← howner]
      exact hnote.symm
    refine ⟨(pair_valid_map_iff f hf pair).mpr h.valid,
      (pair_spendable_map_iff f hf pair (path 0).1).mpr h.spendable,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
          (SpendDataMap.pair f pair).selectedCommitment (path 0).1 =
              d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) := by cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
          _ = d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := hcommitMap
          _ = noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) :=
              hmappedNote.symm
    · calc
        (SpendDataMap.path f path 0).2 = d ((path 0).2) := rfl
        _ = d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) := hsiblingMap
        _ = if (path 0).1 then (SpendDataMap.pair f pair).firstCommitment
              else (SpendDataMap.pair f pair).secondCommitment := by cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
    · calc
        (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nullifier = d pub.nullifier := rfl
        _ = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := hnullifierMap
        _ = nullifierHash (d sk) (d salt) := map_digest_nullifier f sk salt
    · calc
        (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).anchor = d pub.anchor := rfl
        _ = d (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) := hmembershipMap
        _ = merkleRoot (d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt))
              (SpendDataMap.path f path) := hroot _
        _ = merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt))
              (SpendDataMap.path f path) := by rw [hmappedNote.symm]

private theorem map_changeCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) =
      changeCommitment (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) := by
  simpa [changeCommitment, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, SpendDataMap.witness,
    SpendDataMap.digest, map_digest_noteCommitment] using
    (map_digest_noteCommitment f w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K)
      pub.assetId w.changeSalt)

private theorem map_recipientCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (recipientCommitment pub w) =
      recipientCommitment (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) := by
  simpa [recipientCommitment, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, SpendDataMap.witness,
    SpendDataMap.digest, map_digest_noteCommitment] using
    (map_digest_noteCommitment f w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K)
      pub.assetId w.recipientSalt)

private theorem variantOutput_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    variantOutput (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔
      variantOutput pub w := by
  have hd : Function.Injective (SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) :=
    digest_injective f hf
  have hcast : f (w.outputValue.val : K) = (w.outputValue.val : L) := by simp
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient with
      | none => simp [variantOutput, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr]
      | some r =>
          simp only [variantOutput, hv, hr, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, SpendDataMap.witness,
            Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          change SpendDataMap.digest f r =
              recipientCommitment (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔
            r = recipientCommitment pub w
          constructor
          · intro h
            apply hd
            calc
              SpendDataMap.digest f r =
                  recipientCommitment (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) := h
              _ = SpendDataMap.digest f (recipientCommitment pub w) :=
                  (map_recipientCommitment f pub w).symm
          · intro h
            rw [h, map_recipientCommitment]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount with
      | none => simp [variantOutput, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, ha]
      | some amount =>
          simp only [variantOutput, hv, ha, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, SpendDataMap.witness,
            Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          change f amount = (w.outputValue.val : L) ↔ amount = (w.outputValue.val : K)
          rw [← hcast]
          exact map_eq_iff f hf _ _

theorem rspend_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    Rspend (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔ Rspend pub w := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := f.injective
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcanonical, hrelation, hbalance, hchange, hvariant, happend⟩
    have hvalue : f (w.inputValue.val : K) = (w.inputValue.val : L) := by simp
    refine ⟨(canonical_map_iff f hf pub).mp hcanonical, ?_,
      ?_, ?_, (variantOutput_map_iff f hf pub w).mp hvariant,
      (AppendBindingMap.appendBinding_map_iff f pub).mp happend⟩
    · have hm := (relation_map_iff f hf pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt
        w.path w.pair).mp (by simpa [SpendDataMap.witness, hvalue] using hrelation)
      simpa [SpendDataMap.witness] using hm
    · simpa [SpendDataMap.witness] using hbalance
    · apply digest_injective f hf
      calc
        SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.change) =
            changeCommitment (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) := hchange
        _ = SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) := (map_changeCommitment f pub w).symm
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcanonical, hrelation, hbalance, hchange, hvariant, happend⟩
    have hvalue : f (w.inputValue.val : K) = (w.inputValue.val : L) := by simp
    refine ⟨(canonical_map_iff f hf pub).mpr hcanonical, ?_,
      ?_, ?_, (variantOutput_map_iff f hf pub w).mpr hvariant,
      (AppendBindingMap.appendBinding_map_iff f pub).mpr happend⟩
    · have hm := (relation_map_iff f hf pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt
        w.path w.pair).mpr hrelation
      simpa [SpendDataMap.witness, hvalue] using hm
    · simpa [SpendDataMap.witness] using hbalance
    · calc
        (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).change = SpendDataMap.digest f pub.change := rfl
        _ = SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) := congrArg (SpendDataMap.digest f) hchange
        _ = changeCommitment (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (SpendDataMap.witness f w) := map_changeCommitment f pub w

#print axioms canonical_map_iff
#print axioms rspend_map_iff

end AspisR1.SpendRelationMap

import R1PoseidonMap

/-! Ring-hom naturality for the R0 note-hash and 24-level Merkle functions.
These are algebraic transport lemmas only; they do not connect a runtime field
parser or a Rust trace to the generic semantic model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NoteHashMap

open R0P AspisR1.PoseidonMap

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem map_spongeInit (domain len : K) :
    mapState f (spongeInit domain len) =
      spongeInit (f domain) (f len) := by
  funext lane
  by_cases h8 : lane = 8
  · subst lane
    simp [mapState, spongeInit]
  · by_cases h9 : lane = 9
    · subst lane
      simp [mapState, spongeInit, h8]
    · simp [mapState, spongeInit, h8, h9]

theorem map_absorb (s : State K) (chunk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapState f (absorb s chunk) =
      absorb (mapState f s) (mapDigest f chunk) := by
  funext lane
  by_cases h : lane.val < 8 <;>
    simp [mapState, mapDigest, absorb, h, map_add]

theorem map_spongeStep (s : State K) (chunk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapState f (spongeStep s chunk) =
      spongeStep (mapState f s) (mapDigest f chunk) := by
  unfold spongeStep
  rw [map_poseidonPermutation, map_absorb]

theorem map_digestOf (s : State K) :
    mapDigest f (digestOf s) = digestOf (mapState f s) := by
  rfl

theorem map_ownerKey (sk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (mapDigest f sk) := by
  unfold ownerKey
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeInit]
  simp only [map_ofNat]

theorem map_nullifierHash (sk salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (nullifierHash sk salt) =
      nullifierHash (mapDigest f sk) (mapDigest f salt) := by
  unfold nullifierHash
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep, map_spongeInit]
  simp only [map_ofNat]

theorem map_noteCommitment (pk : R0P.Digest K) (value asset : K)
    (salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) =
      noteCommitment (mapDigest f pk) (f value) (f asset) (mapDigest f salt) := by
  unfold noteCommitment
  let chunk2K : R0P.Digest K := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then value else if i.val = 1 then asset
      else salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩
  let chunk2L : R0P.Digest L := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then f value else if i.val = 1 then f asset
      else mapDigest f salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩
  let chunk3K : R0P.Digest K := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 2 then salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0
  let chunk3L : R0P.Digest L := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 2 then mapDigest f salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0
  have hchunk2 : mapDigest f chunk2K = chunk2L := by
    funext i
    change f (chunk2K i) = chunk2L i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [chunk2K, chunk2L, mapDigest]
  have hchunk3 : mapDigest f chunk3K = chunk3L := by
    funext i
    change f (chunk3K i) = chunk3L i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [chunk3K, chunk3L, mapDigest]
  change mapDigest f
      (digestOf (spongeStep (spongeStep (spongeStep
        (spongeInit (0x4153_0003 : K) 18) pk) chunk2K) chunk3K)) = _
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep,
    map_spongeInit, hchunk2, hchunk3]
  simp only [map_ofNat, chunk2L, chunk3L]

def mapPath (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest L :=
  fun level => ((path level).1, mapDigest f (path level).2)

theorem map_merkleStep (cur : R0P.Digest K) (bit : Bool)
    (sibling : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (merkleStep cur bit sibling) =
      merkleStep (mapDigest f cur) bit (mapDigest f sibling) := by
  cases bit <;> simp [merkleStep, map_nodeCompress]

theorem map_merkleRootAux (cur : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    ∀ n, mapDigest f (merkleRootAux cur path n) =
      merkleRootAux (mapDigest f cur) (mapPath f path) n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold merkleRootAux
      by_cases h : n < 24
      · simp only [dif_pos h]
        rw [map_merkleStep, ih]
        simp [mapPath]
      · simp only [dif_neg h]
        exact ih

theorem map_merkleRoot (leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (mapDigest f leaf) (mapPath f path) := by
  unfold merkleRoot
  exact map_merkleRootAux f leaf path 24

#print axioms map_spongeInit
#print axioms map_absorb
#print axioms map_spongeStep
#print axioms map_digestOf
#print axioms map_ownerKey
#print axioms map_nullifierHash
#print axioms map_noteCommitment
#print axioms map_merkleStep
#print axioms map_merkleRootAux
#print axioms map_merkleRoot

end AspisR1.NoteHashMap

import PoseidonMap

/-! Compatibility import for the retained R1 cone. Declarations have one

PoseidonMap.text:
import R0P.Semantics

/-! Field-homomorphism naturality for the scalar Poseidon model. These lemmas
are purely algebraic: no field characteristic, constant correspondence, or
finite-field computation is assumed. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonMap

open R0P

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

abbrev State (K : Type) := Fin 16 → K
abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

def mapState (s : State K) : State L := fun i => f (s i)
def mapDigest (d : Digest K) : Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

theorem map_poseidonPow5 (x : K) :
    f (poseidonPow5 x) = poseidonPow5 (f x) := by
  simp [poseidonPow5]

theorem map_poseidonMat4 (s : Fin 4 → K) (i : Fin 4) :
    f (poseidonMat4 s i) = poseidonMat4 (fun i => f (s i)) i := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [poseidonMat4, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonExternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonExternalLinear s) =
      poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonExternalLinear, mapState]
  simp_rw [map_add, map_zero, map_poseidonMat4]

theorem map_foldl_add (xs : List K) (init : K) :
    f (xs.foldl (· + ·) init) = (xs.map f).foldl (· + ·) (f init) := by
  induction xs generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons]
      rw [ih, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonInternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalLinear s) =
      poseidonInternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonInternalLinear, mapState]
  have hxs : (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => s j.succ)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => f (s j.succ)) := by
    simp
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · simp only [dif_pos hi, map_sub]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]
  · simp only [dif_neg hi, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]

theorem map_poseidonFullRound (s c : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c) =
      poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c) := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun lane => poseidonPow5 (s lane + c lane)) =
        (fun lane => poseidonPow5
          (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s lane + mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c lane)) := by
    funext i
    simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonInternalRound (s : State K) c :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c) =
      poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c) := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  rw [map_poseidonInternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun i =>
        if i = 0 then poseidonPow5 (s 0 + c) else s i) =
      (fun i => if i = 0 then poseidonPow5
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s 0 + f c)
        else mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s i) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
    · simp [mapState, hi]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonExternalInitial (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonExternalFinal (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonInternalConstants (r : Fin 14) :
    f (poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r) =
      poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r := by
  fin_cases r <;> exact map_natCast f _

private theorem map_fullRoundFold (cs : List (State K)) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
      (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
                (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c)) := by rw [map_poseidonFullRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

private theorem map_internalRoundFold (cs : List K) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
      (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c)) := by
                rw [map_poseidonInternalRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

theorem map_poseidonPermutation (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation s) =
      poseidonPermutation (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  unfold poseidonPermutation
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).foldl
        poseidonFullRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).foldl
          poseidonInternalRound
          ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).foldl
            poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear s)))) =
    (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r)).foldl
      poseidonFullRound
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r)).foldl
        poseidonInternalRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r)).foldl
          poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s))))
  have hi : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalInitial f r))
  have hc : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact map_poseidonInternalConstants f r)
  have hf : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalFinal f r))
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hf]
  rw [map_internalRoundFold, hc]
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hi]
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]

theorem map_nodeCompress (a b : Digest K) :
    mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f a)
        (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f b) := by
  change (fun i : Fin 8 => f (poseidonPermutation (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)) = _
  have hinput : mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) =
    (fun l => if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
      else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
      else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)) := by
    funext l
    dsimp only [mapState]
    split_ifs with hlow hlast
    · rfl
    · rw [map_sub]
      exact congrArg (fun z : L => f (b 7) - z) (map_natCast f 1051521018)
    · rfl
  funext i
  let inK : State K := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
    else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
    else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩
  let inL : State L := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
    else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
    else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation inK)
      ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = poseidonPermutation inL ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  rw [congrFun (map_poseidonPermutation f inK) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩]
  rw [hinput]

R1AppendBindingMap.text:
import R1SpendDataMap
import R1NoteHashMap
import R1AppendPath

/-! Ring-hom naturality for the public append binding. This transports the
public append equations through an injective field map; it adds no statement
about how the public values were produced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendBindingMap

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation
open AspisR1.PoseidonMap

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

private theorem digest_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact hf (congrFun h i)

private theorem digest_nodeCompress (a b : R0P.Digest K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (SpendDataMap.digest f a) (SpendDataMap.digest f b) := by
  change PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (nodeCompress a b) =
    nodeCompress (PoseidonMap.mapDigest f a) (PoseidonMap.mapDigest f b)
  exact PoseidonMap.map_nodeCompress f a b

private theorem digest_zero :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : K)) =
      (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : L)) := by
  funext i
  exact map_zero f

theorem map_frozenEmpty (level : Fin 21) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendNode.frozenEmpty (K := K) level) =
      AppendNode.frozenEmpty (K := L) level := by
  funext i
  dsimp [SpendDataMap.digest, AppendNode.frozenEmpty]
  exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_step (pub : Public K) (level : Fin 20) (cur : R0P.Digest K) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.step pub level cur) =
      AppendPath.step (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) level
        (SpendDataMap.digest f cur) := by
  unfold AppendPath.step
  change
    SpendDataMap.digest f
      (if digestBitZero pub level then
        nodeCompress cur (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
       else
        nodeCompress (pub.snapshotFrontier level) cur) =
    (if digestBitZero pub level then
      nodeCompress (SpendDataMap.digest f cur) (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
     else
      nodeCompress (SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.snapshotFrontier level))
        (SpendDataMap.digest f cur))
  by_cases h : digestBitZero pub level
  · simp only [if_pos h]
    rw [digest_nodeCompress, map_frozenEmpty]
  · simp only [if_neg h]
    exact digest_nodeCompress f _ _

theorem map_pathPrefix (pub : Public K) (leaf : R0P.Digest K) (n : Nat) :
    SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub leaf n) =
      AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
        (SpendDataMap.digest f leaf) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold AppendPath.pathPrefix
      by_cases hn : n < 20
      · simp only [dif_pos hn]
        rw [map_step, ih]
      · simp only [dif_neg hn]
        exact ih

theorem map_outputPair (pub : Public K) :
    outputPair (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) =
      (outputPair pub).map (SpendDataMap.digest f) := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
        simp [outputPair, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr,
          digest_nodeCompress]
  | withdrawal =>
      simp [outputPair, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv,
        digest_nodeCompress, digest_zero]

theorem appendBinding_map_iff (pub : Public K) :
    AppendBinding (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) ↔ AppendBinding pub := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := f.injective
  have hd : Function.Injective (SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) :=
    digest_injective f hf
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨pairL, hpairL, hrootL, hcarryL⟩
    cases hpair : outputPair pub with
    | none =>
        rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpair] at hpairL
        cases hpairL
    | some pairK =>
        have hpairMapped :
            outputPair (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) =
              some (SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) := by
          rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpair]
          rfl
        have hpairValue : pairL = SpendDataMap.digest f pairK :=
          Option.some.inj (hpairL.symm.trans hpairMapped)
        refine ⟨pairK, hpair, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply hd
          calc
            SpendDataMap.digest f pub.nextRoot =
                (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextRoot := rfl
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL 20 := hrootL
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
                  (SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) 20 := by rw [hpairValue]
            _ = SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK 20) :=
                  (map_pathPrefix f pub pairK 20).symm
        · intro hc
          have hcMapped : digestCarry (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex < 20 := by
            simpa [SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hc
          have hfrontier :
              SpendDataMap.digest f
                (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩) =
              AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL
                (digestCarry (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := by
            simpa [SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hcarryL hcMapped
          apply hd
          calc
            SpendDataMap.digest f
                (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩) =
              AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL
                (digestCarry (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := hfrontier
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
                  (SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex) := by
                    rw [hpairValue]
                    rfl
            _ = SpendDataMap.digest f
                  (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)) :=
                    (map_pathPrefix f pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)).symm
  · rintro ⟨pairK, hpairK, hrootK, hcarryK⟩
    refine ⟨SpendDataMap.digest f pairK, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpairK]
      rfl
    · calc
        (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextRoot = SpendDataMap.digest f pub.nextRoot := rfl
        _ = SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK 20) := congrArg _ hrootK
        _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
              (SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) 20 := map_pathPrefix f pub pairK 20
    · intro hc
      have hcK : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20 := by
        simpa [SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hc
      calc
        (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextFrontier
            ⟨digestCarry (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
          SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hcK⟩) := rfl
        _ = SpendDataMap.digest f
              (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)) :=
                congrArg (SpendDataMap.digest f) (hcarryK hcK)
        _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
              (SpendDataMap.digest f pairK)
              (digestCarry (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := by
                rw [map_pathPrefix]
                rfl

#print axioms map_frozenEmpty
#print axioms map_step
#print axioms map_pathPrefix
#print axioms map_outputPair
#print axioms appendBinding_map_iff

end AspisR1.AppendBindingMap

R1TraceValueDecode.text:
import R0P.Core
import R1ExactBaseProjection

/-! A computable bounded-value decoder for the three value cells in a wide
trace.  This only projects those cells into the exact M31 base and checks the
requested 30-bit bounds; it makes no claim that a protocol execution supplied
the trace or that production constraints hold. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.TraceValueDecode

open R0P
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower

abbrev Values := Fin (2 ^ 30) × Fin (2 ^ 30) × Fin (2 ^ 30)

/-- Read the three value cells, project them to M31, and accept exactly
when all three canonical representatives fit in 30 bits. -/
def decode (A : Trace WideExact) : Option Values :=
  let v0 := (ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1008)).val
  let v1 := (ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1010)).val
  let v2 := (ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1012)).val
  if h0 : v0 < 2 ^ 30 then
    if h1 : v1 < 2 ^ 30 then
      if h2 : v2 < 2 ^ 30 then
        some (⟨v0, h0⟩, ⟨v1, h1⟩, ⟨v2, h2⟩)
      else none
    else none
  else none

/-- Embedded 30-bit natural values in the three trace cells decode exactly. -/
theorem decode_of_values (A : Trace WideExact)
    (v0 v1 v2 : Fin (2 ^ 30))
    (h0 : A 10 1008 = (v0.val : WideExact))
    (h1 : A 10 1010 = (v1.val : WideExact))
    (h2 : A 10 1012 = (v2.val : WideExact)) :
    decode A = some (v0, v1, v2) := by
  have hp0 : v0.val < P := Nat.lt_trans v0.isLt (by norm_num [P])
  have hp1 : v1.val < P := Nat.lt_trans v1.isLt (by norm_num [P])
  have hp2 : v2.val < P := Nat.lt_trans v2.isLt (by norm_num [P])
  have hproj0 : ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1008) = (v0.val : M31Exact) := by
    rw [h0, ← map_natCast ExactBaseProjection.embed v0.val]
    exact ExactBaseProjection.project_embed _
  have hproj1 : ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1010) = (v1.val : M31Exact) := by
    rw [h1, ← map_natCast ExactBaseProjection.embed v1.val]
    exact ExactBaseProjection.project_embed _
  have hproj2 : ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1012) = (v2.val : M31Exact) := by
    rw [h2, ← map_natCast ExactBaseProjection.embed v2.val]
    exact ExactBaseProjection.project_embed _
  have hv0 : (ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1008)).val = v0.val := by
    rw [hproj0, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hp0]
  have hv1 : (ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1010)).val = v1.val := by
    rw [hproj1, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hp1]
  have hv2 : (ExactBaseProjection.project (A 10 1012)).val = v2.val := by
    rw [hproj2, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hp2]
  simp [decode, hv0, hv1, hv2, v0.isLt, v1.isLt, v2.isLt]

#print axioms decode_of_values

end AspisR1.TraceValueDecode
