import R1SecondFoldMatched
import R1SecondFoldRestoration
import R1FirstFoldRestoration
import R1InitialResponses

/-! Deterministic two-fold extraction on the actual stored domains. A support
of 9558 matching first-layer positions gives a tuple from the literal joint
list of the committed words. The matching equations and exclusion of the
three algebraic bad sets are explicit premises. No commitment binding,
query probability, source correspondence, or Fiat--Shamir claim is made. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.TwoFoldExtraction

open scoped BigOperators
open AspisCircleGroupOrder
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7
open AspisWide.InitialEncoder AspisWide.FinalEncoder AspisWide.Agreement
open AspisV5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement AspisV6Width29CorrelatedAgreement

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) K]

def batchedWord (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K) (gamma : K) : InitialWord K :=
  width29CurveValue W gamma

/-- Concrete second-fold matching reconstructs a 256-coefficient message
on every original first-layer position, including when parents repeat. -/
theorem second_fold_extract
    (V : FinalWord K) (alpha : K)
    (hgood : alpha ∉ AspisR1.SecondFoldMatched.secondBad
      (AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.channels V))
    (f : AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.SmallMessage K)
    (M : Finset (Fin 262144)) (hM : 9558 ≤ M.card)
    (hmatch : ∀ i ∈ M,
      curveValue (AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.channels V) alpha
          (AspisR1.parentIndex i) =
        AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder f (AspisR1.parentIndex i)) :
    ∃ m : FinalMessage K,
      (∀ i ∈ M, V i = exactFinalEncoder m i) ∧
      f = AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold (n := 64) alpha m := by
  let S := AspisR1.parentSupport (n := 65536) M
  have hS : 2390 ≤ S.card :=
    AspisR1.parentSupport_card_ge_2390_65536 M hM
  have hvalid : ∀ i ∈ S,
      curveValue (AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.channels V) alpha i =
        AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder f i := by
    intro i hi
    have hex : ∃ k ∈ M, AspisR1.parentIndex k = i := by
      simpa only [S, AspisR1.parentSupport, Finset.mem_image] using hi
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hex
    exact hmatch k hk
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hf⟩ := AspisR1.SecondFoldMatched.second_match
    (AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.channels V) alpha hgood f S hS hvalid
  let m := AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.join b
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.secondFoldRestoration V S b hb i
      (AspisR1.mem_fullQuartetSet_parentSupport (n := 65536) M i hi)
  · funext i
    have hi := congrFun hf i
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
    rw [hi]
    unfold AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    change alpha ^ s.val * b s i =
      b (AspisR1.slotIndex (AspisR1.childIndex i s))
        (AspisR1.parentIndex (AspisR1.childIndex i s)) * alpha ^ s.val
    simp only [AspisR1.slotIndex_childIndex, AspisR1.parentIndex_childIndex,
      mul_comm]

set_option maxRecDepth 4096 in
/-- The extracted terminal message is the twofold coefficient fold of the
gamma-batch of one tuple in the fixed literal list `Lambda W`. -/
theorem two_fold_extract
    (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K) (V : FinalWord K)
    (gamma alpha0 alpha1 : K) (hgamma_ne : gamma ≠ 0)
    (hgamma : gamma ∉ AspisR1.InitialResponses.B1 W)
    (hfirst : alpha0 ∉ AspisR1.FinalResponses.B6
      (AspisR1.FirstFold.channels (batchedWord W gamma)))
    (hsecond : alpha1 ∉ AspisR1.SecondFoldMatched.secondBad
      (AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.channels V))
    (f : AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.SmallMessage K)
    (M : Finset (Fin 262144)) (hM : 9558 ≤ M.card)
    (hmatch0 : ∀ i ∈ M,
      AspisR1.FirstFold.foldWord alpha0 (batchedWord W gamma) i = V i)
    (hmatch1 : ∀ i ∈ M,
      curveValue (AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration.channels V) alpha1
          (AspisR1.parentIndex i) =
        AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder f (AspisR1.parentIndex i)) :
    ∃ t ∈ AspisR1.InitialResponses.Lambda W,
      f = AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold (n := 64) alpha1
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold (n := 256) alpha0
          (exactInitialMessageCurve t gamma)) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hf⟩ := second_fold_extract V alpha1 hsecond f M hM hmatch1
  let R := batchedWord W gamma
  let response : AspisR1.FinalResponses.FinalResponse K := (m, M)
  have hv : AspisR1.FinalResponses.AlphaValid
      (AspisR1.FirstFold.channels R) alpha0 response := by
    constructor
    · change 9557 < M.card
      omega
    · intro i hi
      change curveValue (AspisR1.FirstFold.channels R) alpha0 i =
        exactFinalEncoder m i
      rw [AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge.curveValue_eq_coefficientFoldValue]
      exact (hmatch0 i hi).trans (hm i hi)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hma⟩ := AspisR1.FinalResponses.alpha_match
    (AspisR1.FirstFold.channels R) alpha0 hfirst response hv
  let q := AspisR1.FirstFoldRestoration.join a
  have hmq : m = AspisR1.FirstFold.foldMessage alpha0 q :=
    hma.trans (AspisR1.FirstFoldRestoration.fold_join a alpha0).symm
  have hrestore : ∀ k ∈ AspisR1.fullQuartetSet M,
      R k = exactInitialEncoder q k :=
    AspisR1.FirstFoldRestoration.restore R a M ha
  let initialResponse : AspisR1.InitialResponses.InitialResponse K :=
    (q, AspisR1.fullQuartetSet M)
  have hvalid : AspisR1.InitialResponses.GammaValid W gamma initialResponse := by
    constructor
    · change 38229 < (AspisR1.fullQuartetSet M).card
      rw [AspisR1.fullQuartetSet_card]
      omega
    · exact hrestore
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _hs, hq⟩ := AspisR1.InitialResponses.gamma_match
    W gamma hgamma_ne hgamma initialResponse hvalid
  change t ∈ AspisR1.InitialResponses.Lambda W at ht
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  have hmq' : m = AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold (n := 256) alpha0 q :=
    hmq.trans (AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge.coefficientFoldLayer_eq_primalFold
      (n := 256) alpha0 q)
  change q = exactInitialMessageCurve t gamma at hq
  exact hf.trans (congrArg (AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold (n := 64) alpha1)
    (hmq'.trans (congrArg (AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold (n := 256) alpha0) hq)))

#print axioms second_fold_extract
#print axioms two_fold_extract
end AspisR1.TwoFoldExtraction
end

R1SecondFoldMatched.text:
import R1ConcreteProjection
import R1FinalResponses

/-! Transfer the existing exact 256-coefficient matched-response theorem to
the concrete 64-coefficient log-16 encoder by repeating each received word
four times. No new decoder/certificate premise is introduced. This is an
encoder-level statement; runtime channel recovery and FS remain separate. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SecondFoldMatched

open scoped BigOperators
open AspisCircleGroupOrder
open AspisR1.ConcreteProjection
open AspisR1.FinalResponses
open AspisWide.FinalEncoder AspisWide.Agreement
open AspisV5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) K]

/-- Repeat a parent word on all four children. -/
def repeatedWord (w : SmallWord K) : Fin 262144 → K :=
  fun k => w (AspisR1.parentIndex k)

/-- The existing existential unmatched-response bad set of the lifted words. -/
def secondBad (g : Fin 4 → SmallWord K) : Finset K :=
  B6 (fun s => repeatedWord (g s))

theorem secondBad_card (g : Fin 4 → SmallWord K) :
    (secondBad g).card ≤ 9396508281246 :=
  B6_card _

private theorem child_mem_fullQuartetSet
    (S : Finset (Fin 65536)) (i : Fin 65536) (hi : i ∈ S) (s : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.childIndex i s ∈ AspisR1.fullQuartetSet S := by
  simp only [AspisR1.fullQuartetSet, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨i, hi, s, rfl⟩

/-- Outside the unchanged exact-final bad set, every sufficiently supported
64-coefficient response has a matching four-component decomposition. -/
theorem second_match
    (g : Fin 4 → SmallWord K) (alpha : K)
    (hgood : alpha ∉ secondBad g)
    (f : SmallMessage K) (S : Finset (Fin 65536)) (hS : 2390 ≤ S.card)
    (hvalid : ∀ i ∈ S, curveValue g alpha i = secondEncoder f i) :
    ∃ b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K,
      (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ s : Fin 4, g s i = secondEncoder (b s) i) ∧
      f = ∑ s : Fin 4, alpha ^ s.val • b s := by
  let lifted := fun s : Fin 4 => repeatedWord (g s)
  let response : FinalResponse K :=
    (AspisR1.sparseLift f, AspisR1.fullQuartetSet S)
  have hv : AlphaValid lifted alpha response := by
    constructor
    · change 9557 < (AspisR1.fullQuartetSet S).card
      rw [AspisR1.fullQuartetSet_card]
      omega
    · intro k hk
      change k ∈ AspisR1.fullQuartetSet S at hk
      have hi := AspisR1.parentIndex_mem_of_mem_fullQuartetSet S hk
      change curveValue lifted alpha k = exactFinalEncoder (AspisR1.sparseLift f) k
      rw [← AspisR1.childIndex_parentIndex_slotIndex (n := 65536) k,
        exactFinal_sparseLift_child]
      simpa only [curveValue, lifted, repeatedWord,
        AspisR1.parentIndex_childIndex] using hvalid (AspisR1.parentIndex k) hi
  obtain ⟨a, hsupport, hcurve⟩ := alpha_match lifted alpha hgood response hv
  have hfour (s : Fin 4) (i : Fin 65536) (hi : i ∈ S) (j : Fin 4) :
      exactFinalEncoder (a s) (AspisR1.childIndex i j) = g s i := by
    have hk := hsupport (child_mem_fullQuartetSet S i hi j)
    have hx := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2 s
    change repeatedWord (g s) (AspisR1.childIndex i j) =
      exactFinalEncoder (a s) (AspisR1.childIndex i j) at hx
    simpa only [repeatedWord, AspisR1.parentIndex_childIndex] using hx.symm
  let b := fun s : Fin 4 => AspisR1.laneCoefficients 64 0 (a s)
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi s
    exact (secondEncoder_of_repeated_match S (by omega) (a s) (g s)
      (hfour s) i hi).symm
  · funext d
    have h := congrFun hcurve (AspisR1.childIndex d 0)
    simpa [response, AspisR1.sparseLift, exactFinalMessageCurve,
      Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, b,
      AspisR1.laneCoefficients] using h

#print axioms secondBad_card
#print axioms second_match
end AspisR1.SecondFoldMatched
end

R1SecondFoldRestoration.text:
import R1ConcreteProjection

/-! Concrete restoration of one more radix-four layer above the existing
log-16 exact encoder. This is an encoder identity only; it makes no claim
about runtime verification, source correspondence, transcripts, or security.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration

open scoped BigOperators
open AspisCircleGroupOrder AspisCircleTensorBinding
open AspisV5FriReleasedLineGeometry AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains
open AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation
open AspisWide.FinalEncoder

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) K]

abbrev FinalWord (K : Type) := Fin 262144 → K
abbrev ParentWord (K : Type) := Fin 65536 → K
abbrev SmallMessage (K : Type) := Fin 64 → K
abbrev FinalMessage (K : Type) := Fin 256 → K

/-- The actual embedded log-18 radix-four geometry over the log-16 domain. -/
def x0 (i : Fin 65536) : K :=
  algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (AspisR1.childIndex i 0))

def x1 (i : Fin 65536) : K :=
  algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (AspisR1.childIndex i 2))

def x2 (i : Fin 65536) : K :=
  algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedLine17X (binaryChildIndex i))

theorem concreteGeometry : AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.Radix4LineGeometry
    (fun k => algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 k))
    (fun i => algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedLine16X i))
    x0 x1 x2 :=
  AspisR1.storedLine18_radix4_geometry_algebraMap K

private theorem map_eq_zero_iff {K : Type} [Field K]
    [Algebra (ZMod P) K] (z : ZMod P) :
    algebraMap (ZMod P) K z = 0 ↔ z = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (ZMod P) K (by simpa using hz)
  · rintro rfl
    simp

private theorem map_doubledFactor {K : Type*} [Field K]
    [Algebra (ZMod P) K] (x y : ZMod P)
    (h : AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor x 1 = y) :
    AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (algebraMap (ZMod P) K x) 1 =
      algebraMap (ZMod P) K y := by
  have hm := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod P) K) h
  simpa [AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor, map_sub, map_mul,
    map_pow, map_one, map_ofNat] using hm

/-- The first coordinate cannot vanish: its opposite stored slot would then
collide with it, contradicting injectivity of the released stored domain. -/
theorem x0_ne_zero (i : Fin 65536) : x0 (K := K) i ≠ (0 : K) := by
  intro hx
  have hbase : storedFirstLineX18
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0) = 0 := by
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff (K := K)
      (storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0))).mp
      (by simpa [x0, AspisR1.childIndex,
        AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex] using hx)
  have hneg := AspisR1.storedLine18_slot1 i
  have hslot : storedFirstLineX18
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hneg, hbase]
    simp
  have heq : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0 =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 1 :=
    storedFirstLineX18_injective (hbase.trans hslot.symm)
  have hval := congrArg Fin.val heq
  simp [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex] at hval

/-- The second inner coordinate cannot vanish, by the same stored-slot
collision argument on slots two and three. -/
theorem x1_ne_zero (i : Fin 65536) : x1 (K := K) i ≠ (0 : K) := by
  intro hx
  have hbase : storedFirstLineX18
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2) = 0 := by
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff (K := K)
      (storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2))).mp
      (by simpa [x1, AspisR1.childIndex,
        AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex] using hx)
  have hneg := AspisR1.storedLine18_slot3 i
  have hslot : storedFirstLineX18
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 3) = 0 := by
    rw [hneg, hbase]
    simp
  have heq : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2 =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 3 :=
    storedFirstLineX18_injective (hbase.trans hslot.symm)
  have hval := congrArg Fin.val heq
  simp [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex] at hval

/-- The outer coordinate is also nonzero. A zero doubled coordinate would
make the two inner coordinates equal up to sign, again colliding distinct
stored slots. -/
theorem x2_ne_zero (i : Fin 65536) : x2 (K := K) i ≠ (0 : K) := by
  intro hx2
  have h0 : 2 * (x0 (K := K) i) ^ 2 - 1 = 0 := by
    have h := map_doubledFactor (K := K)
      (storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0))
      (storedLine17X (binaryChildIndex i)) (AspisR1.storedLine18_t2_slot0 i)
    change AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x0 i) 1 = x2 i at h
    simp only [AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor] at h
    rw [hx2] at h
    exact h
  have h1 : 2 * (x1 (K := K) i) ^ 2 - 1 = 0 := by
    have h := map_doubledFactor (K := K)
      (storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2))
      (-storedLine17X (binaryChildIndex i)) (AspisR1.storedLine18_t2_slot2 i)
    have h' : AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x1 (K := K) i) 1 =
        -x2 (K := K) i := by
      simpa [x1, x2, AspisR1.childIndex,
        AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex, map_neg] using h
    simp only [AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor] at h'
    rw [hx2] at h'
    simpa using h'
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := AspisWide.InitialEncoder.two_ne_zero
  have heqmul : 2 * (x0 (K := K) i) ^ 2 =
      2 * (x1 (K := K) i) ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : K => z + 1) (h0.trans h1.symm)
    simpa using h
  have hsquares : (x0 (K := K) i)^2 = (x1 (K := K) i)^2 := by
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ htwo heqmul
  have hfac : (x0 (K := K) i - x1 (K := K) i) *
      (x0 (K := K) i + x1 (K := K) i) = 0 := by
    calc
      (x0 (K := K) i - x1 (K := K) i) *
          (x0 (K := K) i + x1 (K := K) i) =
        (x0 (K := K) i)^2 - (x1 (K := K) i)^2 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hsquares]; ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with heq | heq
  · have hcoords : x0 (K := K) i = x1 (K := K) i := sub_eq_zero.mp heq
    have hidx0 : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0 =
        AspisR1.childIndex i 0 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hidx2 : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2 =
        AspisR1.childIndex i 2 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hpoint := AspisR1.storedLine18_child_slot i 0
    have hpoint2 := AspisR1.storedLine18_child_slot i 2
    have heqbase : storedFirstLineX18
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0) =
        storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2) := by
      have hmap :
          algebraMap (ZMod P) K
              (storedFirstLineX18
                (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0)) =
            algebraMap (ZMod P) K
              (storedFirstLineX18
                (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2)) := by
        have hm := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod P) K) hpoint
        have hm2 := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod P) K) hpoint2
        rw [hidx0, hidx2] at hm hm2
        have hm0' : algebraMap (ZMod P) K
            (storedFirstLineX18
              (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0)) =
            AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
              (x0 i) (x1 i) 0 := by
          simpa [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint,
            x0, x1, hidx0, hidx2] using hm
        have hm2' : AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
            (x0 i) (x1 i) 2 =
            algebraMap (ZMod P) K
              (storedFirstLineX18
                (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2)) := by
          simpa [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint,
            x0, x1, hidx0, hidx2] using hm2.symm
        calc
          _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
                (x0 i) (x1 i) 0 := hm0'
          _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
                (x0 i) (x1 i) 2 := by
            simp [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint, hcoords]
          _ = _ := hm2'
      exact FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (ZMod P) K hmap
    have hidx := storedFirstLineX18_injective heqbase
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val hidx
    simp [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex] at hval
  · have hcoords : x0 (K := K) i = -x1 (K := K) i :=
      (eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero).2 heq
    have hidx0 : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0 =
        AspisR1.childIndex i 0 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hidx2 : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 2 =
        AspisR1.childIndex i 2 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hidx3 : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 3 =
        AspisR1.childIndex i 3 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hpoint := AspisR1.storedLine18_child_slot i 0
    have hpoint3 := AspisR1.storedLine18_child_slot i 3
    have heqbase : storedFirstLineX18
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0) =
        storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 3) := by
      have hmap :
          algebraMap (ZMod P) K
              (storedFirstLineX18
                (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0)) =
            algebraMap (ZMod P) K
              (storedFirstLineX18
                (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 3)) := by
        have hm := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod P) K) hpoint
        have hm3 := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod P) K) hpoint3
        rw [hidx0, hidx2] at hm
        rw [hidx0, hidx2, hidx3] at hm3
        have hm0' : algebraMap (ZMod P) K
            (storedFirstLineX18
              (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 0)) =
            AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
              (x0 i) (x1 i) 0 := by
          simpa [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint,
            x0, x1, hidx0, hidx2] using hm
        have hm3' : AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
            (x0 i) (x1 i) 3 =
            algebraMap (ZMod P) K
              (storedFirstLineX18
                (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i 3)) := by
          simpa [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint,
            x0, x1, hidx0, hidx2, hidx3] using hm3.symm
        calc
          _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
                (x0 i) (x1 i) 0 := hm0'
          _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint
                (x0 i) (x1 i) 3 := by
            simp [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4ChildPoint,
              map_neg, hcoords]
          _ = _ := hm3'
      exact FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (ZMod P) K hmap
    have hidx := storedFirstLineX18_injective heqbase
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val hidx
    simp [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex] at hval

def inverse0 (i : Fin 65536) : K := (2 * x0 (K := K) i)⁻¹
def inverse1 (i : Fin 65536) : K := (2 * x1 (K := K) i)⁻¹
def inverse2 (i : Fin 65536) : K := (2 * x2 (K := K) i)⁻¹

theorem inverse_products (i : Fin 65536) :
    2 * x0 (K := K) i * inverse0 i = 1 ∧
    2 * x1 (K := K) i * inverse1 i = 1 ∧
    2 * x2 (K := K) i * inverse2 i = 1 := by
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := AspisWide.InitialEncoder.two_ne_zero
  have h0 : 2 * x0 (K := K) i ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero htwo (x0_ne_zero i)
  have h1 : 2 * x1 (K := K) i ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero htwo (x1_ne_zero i)
  have h2 : 2 * x2 (K := K) i ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero htwo (x2_ne_zero i)
  constructor
  · simpa [inverse0] using mul_inv_cancel₀ h0
  constructor
  · simpa [inverse1] using mul_inv_cancel₀ h1
  · simpa [inverse2] using mul_inv_cancel₀ h2

def transform (i : Fin 65536) (v : Fin 4 → K) : Fin 4 → K :=
  AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Decode
    (inverse0 i) (inverse1 i) (inverse2 i) v

def channels (V : FinalWord K) : Fin 4 → ParentWord K :=
  fun s i => transform i (fun t => V (AspisR1.childIndex i t)) s

def foldWord (alpha : K) (V : FinalWord K) : ParentWord K :=
  fun i => AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue alpha
    (fun s => channels V s i)

def join (b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K) : Fin (4 * 64) → K :=
  fun k => b (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex (n := 64) k)
    (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 64) k)

def foldMessage (alpha : K) (b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K) : SmallMessage K :=
  AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 alpha (join b)

theorem lane_join (b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K) (s : Fin 4) :
    AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 s (join b) = b s := by
  funext i
  simp [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane, join]

theorem fold_join (alpha : K) (b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K) :
    foldMessage alpha b =
      fun i => AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue alpha
        (fun s => b s i) := by
  funext i
  change AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue alpha
      (fun s => join b
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s)) = _
  have hp (s : Fin 4) :
      AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s) = i := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex,
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex_val]
    omega
  have hs (s : Fin 4) :
      AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s) = s := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex,
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex_val]
  simp [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue, join, hp, hs]

private noncomputable def secondEncoderLinear :
    SmallMessage K →ₗ[K] ParentWord K where
  toFun := AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder
  map_add' a b := by
    funext i
    simp [AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder, AspisR1.naturalEval,
      add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c a := by
    funext i
    simp only [AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder, AspisR1.naturalEval,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, RingHom.id_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _hj
    ring

private theorem secondEncoderLinear_eq_eval (a : SmallMessage K) (i : Fin 65536) :
    secondEncoderLinear a i =
      (naturalCoefficientPolynomial a).eval
        (algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedLine16X i)) := by
  change AspisR1.naturalEval a _ = _
  rw [naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num)]
  rfl

/-- The deployed four values are represented by decoding and re-evaluating the
four decoded channels; both inverse identities are exact for the concrete
nonzero stored geometry. -/
theorem channel_decode_evaluate (V : FinalWord K) (i : Fin 65536) :
    AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
        (x0 i) (x1 i) (x2 i) (fun s => channels V s i) =
      fun t => V (AspisR1.childIndex i t) := by
  have hp := inverse_products (K := K) i
  exact AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate_radix4Decode
    (x0 i) (x1 i) (x2 i) (inverse0 i) (inverse1 i) (inverse2 i)
    hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2 (fun t => V (AspisR1.childIndex i t))

/-- Conversely, decoding an encoded fibre returns its four coefficient
channels, using the other exact radix-four inverse identity. -/
theorem channel_encode_decode (c : Fin 4 → K) (i : Fin 65536) :
    transform i (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
      (x0 i) (x1 i) (x2 i) c) = c := by
  have hp := inverse_products (K := K) i
  exact AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Decode_radix4Evaluate
    (x0 i) (x1 i) (x2 i) (inverse0 i) (inverse1 i) (inverse2 i)
    hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2 c

private theorem exactFinal_join_radix4 (b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K)
    (k : Fin 262144) :
    exactFinalEncoder (join b) k =
      AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
        (x0 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (x1 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (x2 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (fun s => secondEncoderLinear (b s)
          (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex (n := 65536) k) := by
  let encoder := secondEncoderLinear (K := K)
  let parentPoint : Fin 65536 → K :=
    fun i => algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedLine16X i)
  let childPoint : Fin 262144 → K :=
    fun i => algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 i)
  have hLift := AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability.radix4LiftEncoder_eq_natural_eval
    (K := K) (n := 64) (m := 65536) (by norm_num)
    encoder parentPoint x0 x1 x2 childPoint
    (by
      intro message i
      exact secondEncoderLinear_eq_eval (K := K) message i)
    (concreteGeometry (K := K)) (join b) k
  have hExact := AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.exactFinal_eq_naturalEval
    (K := K) (join b) k
  have hpoly : (naturalCoefficientPolynomial (join b)).eval
      (algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 k)) =
        AspisR1.naturalEval (join b)
          (algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 k)) := by
    rw [naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num)]
    rfl
  calc
    exactFinalEncoder (join b) k = AspisR1.naturalEval (join b)
        (algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 k)) := hExact
    _ = (naturalCoefficientPolynomial (join b)).eval
        (algebraMap (ZMod P) K (storedFirstLineX18 k)) := hpoly.symm
    _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4LiftEncoder
        encoder x0 x1 x2 (join b) k := hLift.symm
    _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
        (x0 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (x1 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (x2 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (fun s => secondEncoderLinear (b s)
          (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
        (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex (n := 65536) k) := by
      rw [← AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.childIndex_parentIndex_slotIndex
        (n := 65536) k]
      rw [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4LiftEncoder_apply_child]
      simp only [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex_childIndex,
        AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex_childIndex]
      have hvec :
          (fun lane : Fin 4 => encoder
            (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 lane (join b))
            (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k)) =
          (fun lane => secondEncoderLinear (b lane)
            (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k)) := by
        funext lane
        rw [lane_join]
      exact congrArg (fun v : Fin 4 → K =>
        AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
          (x0 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
          (x1 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k))
          (x2 (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex (n := 65536) k)) v
          (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex (n := 65536) k)) hvec

/-- Restoration on every complete stored quartet: if the decoded channels
agree with the four actual log-16 encodings on a parent support, the original
word agrees there with the exact log-18 encoding of their joined message. -/
theorem secondFoldRestoration (V : FinalWord K)
    (S : Finset (Fin 65536)) (b : Fin 4 → SmallMessage K)
    (hchannels : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ s : Fin 4,
      channels V s i = AspisR1.ConcreteProjection.secondEncoder (b s) i) :
    ∀ k ∈ AspisR1.fullQuartetSet S,
      V k = exactFinalEncoder (join b) k := by
  intro k hk
  have hi := AspisR1.parentIndex_mem_of_mem_fullQuartetSet S hk
  let i := AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex k
  let s := AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex (n := 65536) k
  have hchannels_i : ∀ t : Fin 4,
      channels V t i = secondEncoderLinear (b t) i := by
    intro t
    simpa [i, secondEncoderLinear] using hchannels i hi t
  have hvalue := channel_decode_evaluate (K := K) V i
  have hslot := congrFun hvalue s
  calc
    V k = V (AspisR1.childIndex i s) := by
      have hidx : AspisR1.childIndex i s = k := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [i, s, AspisR1.childIndex,
          AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.parentIndex,
          AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.slotIndex]
        omega
      rw [hidx]
    _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
          (x0 i) (x1 i) (x2 i) (fun t => channels V t i) s := hslot.symm
    _ = AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Evaluate
          (x0 i) (x1 i) (x2 i) (fun t => secondEncoderLinear (b t) i) s := by
      congr 2
      funext t
      exact hchannels_i t
    _ = exactFinalEncoder (join b) k := by
      rw [exactFinal_join_radix4 (K := K) b k]

#print axioms x0_ne_zero
#print axioms x1_ne_zero
#print axioms x2_ne_zero
#print axioms inverse_products
#print axioms channel_decode_evaluate
#print axioms channel_encode_decode
#print axioms lane_join
#print axioms fold_join
#print axioms secondFoldRestoration

end AspisR1.SecondFoldRestoration

import R1FirstFold
import R1ParentSupport
import R1FoldCoefficientBridge
import Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplexCategory.Basic
import Wide.EncoderLinearity

/-! Pointwise restoration of the first-fold input on complete quartets above
any support where all four first-fold channels match the four encoded
messages. This is an algebraic implication only. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.FirstFoldRestoration

open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7
open AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation
open AspisV5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement
open AspisWide.Agreement
open AspisWide.InitialEncoder
open AspisWide.FinalEncoder
open AspisCircleGroupOrder

noncomputable section

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod P) K]

/-- Interleave the four final messages into the original first-fold message. -/
def join (a : Fin 4 → FinalMessage K) : InitialMessage K :=
  fun k => a (AspisR1.slotIndex (n := 256) k)
    (AspisR1.parentIndex (n := 256) k)

theorem coefficientLane_join (a : Fin 4 → FinalMessage K) (s : Fin 4) :
    coefficientLane 256 s (join a) = a s := by
  funext i
  rw [AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane_apply]
  change a (AspisR1.slotIndex (n := 256)
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s))
    (AspisR1.parentIndex (n := 256)
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s)) = a s i
  rw [show AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s =
    AspisR1.childIndex i s from rfl]
  simp only [AspisR1.slotIndex_childIndex, AspisR1.parentIndex_childIndex]

/-- Folding the interleaved message gives the released final message curve. -/
theorem fold_join (a : Fin 4 → FinalMessage K) (alpha : K) :
    AspisR1.FirstFold.foldMessage alpha (join a) =
      AspisWide.Agreement.exactFinalMessageCurve a alpha := by
  rw [AspisR1.FirstFold.foldMessage,
    AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge.coefficientFoldLayer_eq_primalFold
      (n := 256)]
  funext i
  simp only [AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold, join,
    AspisR1.slotIndex_childIndex, AspisR1.parentIndex_childIndex,
    AspisWide.Agreement.exactFinalMessageCurve, Finset.sum_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  ring

/-- On all child indices above `M`, the initial word is exactly the released
initial encoding of the interleaving of the four matching messages. -/
theorem restore (R : InitialWord K) (a : Fin 4 → FinalMessage K)
    (M : Finset (Fin 262144))
    (ha : M ⊆ jointAgreementSet exactFinalEncoder
      (AspisR1.FirstFold.channels R) a) :
    ∀ k ∈ AspisR1.fullQuartetSet M,
      R k = exactInitialEncoder (join a) k := by
  intro k hk
  let i : Fin 262144 := AspisR1.parentIndex (n := 262144) k
  let s : Fin 4 := AspisR1.slotIndex (n := 262144) k
  have hi_mem : AspisR1.parentIndex (n := 262144) k ∈ M := by
    exact AspisR1.parentIndex_mem_of_mem_fullQuartetSet
      (n := 262144) M hk
  have hmatch : ∀ t : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.FirstFold.channels R t i = exactFinalEncoder (a t) i := by
    have hset := ha hi_mem
    simpa only [jointAgreementSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] using hset
  have hencoded : ∀ t : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.FirstFold.channels (exactInitialEncoder (join a)) t i =
        exactFinalEncoder (a t) i := by
    intro t
    rw [AspisR1.FirstFold.encoded_channels,
      coefficientLane_join (K := K) a t]
  have hchannels :
      (fun t => AspisR1.FirstFold.channels R t i) =
      (fun t => AspisR1.FirstFold.channels (exactInitialEncoder (join a)) t i) := by
    funext t
    exact (hmatch t).trans (hencoded t).symm
  have hfibre :
      AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre R i =
      AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre (exactInitialEncoder (join a)) i := by
    apply (AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre_inverse i).2.injective
    simpa only [AspisR1.FirstFold.channels] using hchannels
  have hindex : AspisR1.childIndex i s = k := by
    change AspisR1.childIndex i s = k
    exact AspisR1.childIndex_parentIndex_slotIndex (n := 262144) k
  have hchild :
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s =
        AspisR1.childIndex i s := rfl
  calc
    R k = AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre R i s := by
      change R k = R (AspisR1.childIndex i s)
      rw [hindex]
    _ = AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre (exactInitialEncoder (join a)) i s :=
      congrFun hfibre s
    _ = exactInitialEncoder (join a) k := by
      rw [AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre, hchild, hindex]

#print axioms coefficientLane_join
#print axioms fold_join
#print axioms restore

end
end AspisR1.FirstFoldRestoration

R1FoldCoefficientBridge.text:
import R1RoundPairing
import R1FirstFold

/-! Identify the existing coefficient-layer fold with the primal fold used
by the checked round-pairing algebra. This is an algebraic identity, not a
runtime source correspondence result. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge

open scoped BigOperators
open AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem coefficientFoldValue_eq_sum (alpha : K) (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    coefficientFoldValue alpha v = ∑ s : Fin 4, alpha ^ s.val * v s := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp [coefficientFoldValue]

theorem coefficientFoldLayer_eq_primalFold {n : Nat}
    (alpha : K) (q : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    coefficientFoldLayer n alpha q = AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold alpha q := by
  funext i
  rw [coefficientFoldLayer_apply, coefficientFoldValue_eq_sum]
  unfold AspisR1.RoundPairing.primalFold
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  change alpha ^ s.val * q (AspisR1.childIndex i s) = _
  exact mul_comm _ _

theorem curveValue_eq_coefficientFoldValue
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (g : Fin 4 → D → K) (alpha : K) (i : D) :
    AspisV5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement.curveValue g alpha i =
      coefficientFoldValue alpha (fun s => g s i) := by
  simp only [AspisV5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement.curveValue,
    AspisV5FunctionalBatching.batchedDiscrepancy, coefficientFoldValue]
  ring

#print axioms coefficientFoldValue_eq_sum
#print axioms coefficientFoldLayer_eq_primalFold
#print axioms curveValue_eq_coefficientFoldValue
end AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge
end

R1UnifiedCanonicalLabels.text:
import R1ProgramLabelRestriction
import R1CanonicalByteAddress
import R1UnifiedSampler

/-! Every address asked by the finite R1 sampler program is produced by a
bounded `Addr.ofBytes` constructor. This proves the all-continuations label
premise for the sampler itself; it does not cover arbitrary adversary queries. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.UnifiedCanonicalLabels

open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex R0C.V3
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

variable {M Cv C : Type} {L : Nat}

private theorem squeeze_canonical (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) :
    CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical (squeezeA p s) :=
  CanonicalByteAddress.canonical_ofBytes _ _

private theorem advance_canonical (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State) :
    CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical (advanceA p s) :=
  CanonicalByteAddress.canonical_ofBytes _ _

private theorem absorb_canonical (p : Params M Cv L) (s : State)
    (l : Byte) (data : Bytes) (h : data.length ≤ p.D) :
    CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical (absorbA p s l data h) :=
  CanonicalByteAddress.canonical_ofBytes _ _

private theorem unified_absorb_canonical (p : Params M Cv L) (i : Nat)
    (P : UnifiedSampler.Prefix M Cv L) (m : M) :
    CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical (UnifiedSampler.absorb p i P m) := by
  exact absorb_canonical p (UnifiedSampler.stateOf p P) (p.lbl i) (p.enc m) (p.encLen m)

private theorem plain_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L) (a : Addr L) (i : Nat)
    (G : Chal Cv → C) (ha : CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical a) :
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (DuplexSamplers.plain p a i G).toProgram := by
  simp only [DuplexSamplers.plain, Sampler.toProgram, ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
  exact ⟨ha, fun s => ⟨squeeze_canonical p s,
    fun b => ⟨advance_canonical p s, fun x => trivial⟩⟩⟩

private theorem initial_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L) (init : Addr L)
    (begin : State → Addr L) (i : Nat) (G : Chal Cv → C)
    (hinit : CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical init)
    (hbegin : ∀ s, CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical (begin s)) :
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (DuplexSamplers.initial p init begin i G).toProgram := by
  simp only [DuplexSamplers.initial, Sampler.toProgram, ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
  exact ⟨hinit, fun s => ⟨hbegin s, fun a => ⟨squeeze_canonical p a,
    fun b => ⟨advance_canonical p a, fun x => trivial⟩⟩⟩⟩

private theorem reseeded_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L) (a : Addr L)
    (reseed : State → Addr L) (i : Nat) (G : Chal Cv → C)
    (ha : CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical a)
    (hreseed : ∀ s, CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical (reseed s)) :
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (DuplexSamplers.reseeded p a reseed i G).toProgram := by
  simp only [DuplexSamplers.reseeded, Sampler.toProgram, ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
  exact ⟨ha, fun s => ⟨squeeze_canonical p s,
    fun b => ⟨advance_canonical p s,
      fun x => ⟨hreseed x, fun y => trivial⟩⟩⟩⟩

private theorem query_chain_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L)
    (out : List State → List State → C) : ∀ n s bs xs,
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (QuerySampler.chain p out n s bs xs).toProgram := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro s bs xs; simp [QuerySampler.chain, Sampler.toProgram,
      ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro s bs xs
      simp only [QuerySampler.chain, Sampler.toProgram, ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
      exact ⟨squeeze_canonical p s, fun b =>
        ⟨advance_canonical p s, fun x => ih x (bs ++ [b]) (xs ++ [x])⟩⟩

private theorem query_sampler_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L) (a : Addr L)
    (G : AspisV8R19.Q22SamplerProgram.Result → C)
    (ha : CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical a) :
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (QuerySamplerBridge.sampler p a G).toProgram := by
  simp only [QuerySamplerBridge.sampler, Sampler.toProgram, ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
  exact ⟨ha, fun s => query_chain_allLabels p
    (fun bs xs => G (Q22.scanOut 8 Q22.q0 bs xs s)) 8 s [] []⟩

private theorem invalid_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L) :
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (UnifiedSampler.invalid p).toProgram := by
  simp only [UnifiedSampler.invalid, Sampler.toProgram, ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels]
  exact ⟨squeeze_canonical p p.iv, fun _ => trivial⟩

theorem samp_allLabels (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (i : Nat) (P : UnifiedSampler.Prefix M Cv L) (m : Message M) :
    ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (UnifiedSampler.samp p hD i P m).toProgram := by
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      cases m with
      | initial c1 =>
          change ProgramLabelRestriction.AllLabels CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
            (DuplexSamplers.initial p
              (PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1)
              (PublicInitFrame.row0 p hD) 0 TranscriptView.liftChallenge).toProgram
          apply initial_allLabels
          · exact CanonicalByteAddress.canonical_ofBytes _ _
          · intro s
            exact absorb_canonical p s 160 PublicInitFrame.emptyRecord hD
      | payload _ => exact invalid_allLabels p
  | succ j =>
      cases m with
      | initial _ => exact invalid_allLabels p
      | payload msg =>
          by_cases h26 : j + 1 = 26
          · simp only [UnifiedSampler.samp, h26, if_pos]
            apply reseeded_allLabels
            · exact unified_absorb_canonical p 26 P msg
            · intro s
              exact CanonicalByteAddress.canonical_ofBytes _ _
          · by_cases h31 : j + 1 = 31
            · simp only [UnifiedSampler.samp, h26, h31, if_neg, if_pos]
              exact query_sampler_allLabels p _ _ (unified_absorb_canonical p 31 P msg)
            · simp only [UnifiedSampler.samp, h26, h31, if_neg]
              exact plain_allLabels p _ _ _ (unified_absorb_canonical p (j + 1) P msg)

#print axioms samp_allLabels

end AspisR1.UnifiedCanonicalLabels
end
